```c
        uint32_t a1=MR32(c->esp+4u), a2=MR32(c->esp+8u), a3=MR32(c->esp+12u);
        if (!g_rec_esp0) g_rec_esp0 = c->esp;
        uint32_t esi_ = MR32(c->ecx+0x2cu) + a1*0x64u;
        uint32_t cnt_ = mem_is_committed(esi_+0x34) ? MR16(esi_+0x34) : 0xFFFFu;
        uint32_t ebx_ = (mem_is_committed(esi_+0x14)&&mem_is_committed(esi_))
                        ? (MR32(esi_+0x14) + MR32(esi_)) : 0;
        uint32_t idx0 = (ebx_ && mem_is_committed(ebx_)) ? MR16(ebx_) : 0xFFFFu;
        uint32_t s4   = mem_is_committed(esi_+4) ? MR32(esi_+4) : 0;
        uint32_t sbase= mem_is_committed(esi_)   ? MR32(esi_)   : 0;
        uint32_t eaxv = idx0*0x64u + s4;
        uint32_t e48  = mem_is_committed(eaxv+0x48) ? MR32(eaxv+0x48) : 0;
        uint32_t edi_ = e48 + sbase;
        uint32_t ediw = mem_is_committed(edi_) ? MR16(edi_) : 0xFFFFu;
        uint32_t pc   = mem_is_committed(eaxv+0xc) ? MR32(eaxv+0xc) : 0;
        uint32_t inner= (pc && mem_is_committed(pc+0x10)) ? MR32(pc+0x10) : 0;
        (void)a2;
        g_rec[g_rec_n % RECR] = (RecEnt){a1,a3 & 0xffffu,c->esp,g_rec_n,esi_,cnt_,idx0,s4,eaxv,e48,edi_,ediw,inner};
        g_rec_n++;
        uint32_t depth = (g_rec_esp0 > c->esp) ? (g_rec_esp0 - c->esp) : 0;
        if (depth > 0x400000u){       /* 4 MB yigin tuketimi = kacak ozyineleme */
            fprintf(stderr,"\n*** KACAK OZYINELEME: %u cagri, yigin %u KB tuketildi\n",
                    g_rec_n, depth/1024u);
            fprintf(stderr,"    son %d cagri (arg1, arg2, arg3, esp):\n", RECR);
            uint32_t start = g_rec_n > RECR ? g_rec_n - RECR : 0;
            for (uint32_t k=start;k<g_rec_n;k++){
                RecEnt *e=&g_rec[k % RECR];
                fprintf(stderr,"      #%-7u a1=%-4u disSayi=%-3u idx0=%-4u [esi+4]=0x%08x"
                               " eax=0x%08x [eax+0x48]=0x%08x edi=0x%08x [edi]=%-5u icSayi=%u\n",
                        e->cnt, e->a1, e->cntw, e->idx0, e->s4, e->eax, e->e48,
                        e->edi, e->edival, e->inner);
            }
            itrace_dump(12);
            if (g_watch_addr) watch_dump("ozyineleme aninda", 20);
            _exit(5);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ip == 0x0066888eu){
        /* movzx esi, word [edi+4] : tip/sinif anahtari */
        static int n=0;
        if (n<40){
            uint32_t e = c->edi;
            uint32_t cls = mem_is_committed(e+4) ? MR16(e+4) : 0xFFFFu;
            uint32_t t   = mem_is_committed(e)   ? MR16(e)   : 0xFFFFu;
            uint32_t el  = mem_is_committed(e+6) ? MR16(e+6) : 0xFFFFu;
            fprintf(stderr,"  [tip %2d] edi=0x%08x  [edi]=%-5u [edi+4]=%-5u [edi+6]=%-5u\n",
                    n, e, t, cls, el);
            n++;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ip == 0x0076115eu){                       /* __security_check_cookie girisi */
        uint32_t expect = MR32(0x0081a1d0u);
        if (c->ecx != expect){
            g_gs_fail++;
            if (g_gs_reported < 3){
                g_gs_reported++;
                uint32_t cookie_slot = c->ebp - 4u;
                fprintf(stderr,"\n*** /GS CEREZ HATASI ***\n");
                fprintf(stderr,"  ecx (yigin^donus) = 0x%08x\n", c->ecx);
                fprintf(stderr,"  beklenen (global) = 0x%08x\n", expect);
                fprintf(stderr,"  ebp               = 0x%08x\n", c->ebp);
                fprintf(stderr,"  CEREZ YUVASI      = 0x%08x  (deger 0x%08x)\n",
                        cookie_slot, MR32(cookie_slot));
                fprintf(stderr,"  donus adresi [ebp+4] = 0x%08x\n", MR32(c->ebp + 4u));
                fprintf(stderr,"  yuva ^ donus         = 0x%08x\n",
                        MR32(cookie_slot) ^ MR32(c->ebp + 4u));
                guest_backtrace(c, 8);
                if (g_watch_addr) watch_dump("cerez kontrolu basarisiz", 24);
            }
        }
    }
}


/* ---- fonksiyon kapsama tamponu ---------------------------------------- */
#define COV_SIZE 3676913u
uint32_t *g_cov = 0;
uint32_t g_last_fn = 0;
int      g_prof_on = 0;
static void __attribute__((constructor)) _cov_init(void){
    if (getenv("COVREPORT")){ g_cov = calloc(COV_SIZE, sizeof *g_cov); g_prof_on = 1; }
}
void cov_reset(void){
    if (g_cov) memset(g_cov, 0, (size_t)COV_SIZE * sizeof *g_cov);
}
void cov_report(const char *path){
    if (!g_cov) return;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (!f) return;
    unsigned long n = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < COV_SIZE; i++)
        if (g_cov[i]){ fprintf(f, "%08x %u\n", 0x00401000u + i, g_cov[i]); n++; }
    fclose(f);
    fprintf(stderr, "  kapsama: %lu fonksiyon calisti -> %s\n", n, path);
    /* EN COK CAGRILANLAR: "oyun ne yapiyor?" sorusunun dogrudan olcumu. */
    fprintf(stderr, "  --- EN COK CAGRILAN GUEST FONKSIYONLARI ---\n");
    for (int k = 0; k < 30; k++){
        uint32_t bi = 0, best = 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < COV_SIZE; i++)
            if (g_cov[i] > best){ best = g_cov[i]; bi = i; }
        if (!best) break;
        fprintf(stderr, "    %10u  sub_%08x\n", best, 0x00401000u + bi);
        g_cov[bi] = 0;
    }
}
```

`runtime/dispatch.c`:

```c
/* Dolayli cagri dispatch: guest adres -> lift edilmis native fonksiyon.
 * O(1) dogrudan indeks tablosu (.text buyuklugunde uint32 dizisi).      */
#include "cpu.h"
uint64_t g_icall_hits = 0;
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef void (*guest_fn)(CPU*);
extern const uint32_t g_fn_addr[];
extern const guest_fn g_fn_ptr[];
extern const uint32_t g_fn_count;

#define TEXT_BASE 0x00401000u
#define TEXT_SIZE 0x00381af1u

static uint32_t *g_idx;

/* istatistik */
uint64_t g_stat_indirect_ok = 0, g_stat_indirect_miss = 0, g_stat_unsupported = 0;
#define MISS_MAX 64
static uint32_t g_miss[MISS_MAX], g_miss_from[MISS_MAX]; static int g_miss_n = 0;
extern uint32_t g_watch_prev_ip;
static uint32_t g_unsup[MISS_MAX]; static int g_unsup_n = 0;

extern void (*g_backtrace_fn)(struct CPU*,int);
void guest_backtrace(CPU*,int);

void dispatch_init(void){
    if (g_idx) return;
    g_backtrace_fn = (void(*)(struct CPU*,int))guest_backtrace;
    g_idx = calloc(TEXT_SIZE, sizeof(uint32_t));
    if (!g_idx){ fprintf(stderr,"dispatch tablosu ayrilamadi\n"); exit(1); }
    uint32_t dup = 0, oob = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_fn_count; i++){
        uint32_t a = g_fn_addr[i];
        if (a - TEXT_BASE >= TEXT_SIZE){ oob++; continue; }
        if (g_idx[a - TEXT_BASE]) dup++;
        g_idx[a - TEXT_BASE] = i + 1;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "dispatch: %u fonksiyon kayitli (%u yinelenen, %u aralik disi), tablo %.1f MB\n",
            g_fn_count, dup, oob, TEXT_SIZE*4.0/1048576.0);
}

int  win32_call(CPU*, uint32_t);
int  run_generated(CPU*, uint32_t);
void genexec_report(void);
int  com_call(CPU*, uint32_t);
int  g_guest_exited = 0;

/* --- calisma zamani yamalari: dolayli cagri hedeflerini degistir ---
 * Yeniden uretim gerektirmeden (yalnizca dolayli cagrilan fonksiyonlar). */
#define PATCH_MAX 24
static struct { uint32_t addr; guest_fn fn; } g_patch[PATCH_MAX];
static int g_patch_n = 0;
void dispatch_patch(uint32_t a, guest_fn f){
    if (a >= 0xE0000000u){        /* dispatch_indirect'teki sira buna dayaniyor */
        fprintf(stderr,"dispatch_patch: adres %08x metin araliginin disinda, yok sayildi\n", a);
        return; }
    if (g_patch_n < PATCH_MAX){ g_patch[g_patch_n].addr=a; g_patch[g_patch_n].fn=f; g_patch_n++; }
}

void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t addr){
    /* Once UCUZ aralik testi.  COM vtable metotlari (0xE...) ve Win32
     * import kopruleri (0xF...) konuk metin araliginin cok ustunde, yani
     * asagidaki yama tablosuyla ASLA cakismaz -- yamalar hep .text
     * icindedir (dispatch_patch yalnizca konuk fonksiyon adresiyle
     * cagriliyor).  Eskiden her cagri once g_patch[] dizisini dogrusal
     * tariyordu; kosuda tek basina 377 milyon COM cagrisi var. */
    if (addr >= 0xE0000000u){
        if (addr < 0xF0000000u){ com_call(c, addr); return; }
        if (win32_call(c, addr - 0xF0000000u) < 0) g_guest_exited = 1;
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_patch_n; i++)
        if (g_patch[i].addr == addr){ g_stat_indirect_ok++; g_patch[i].fn(c); return; }
    /* EFXSTAT: D3DX efekt vtable cagrilarinin envanteri (d3dx_hle.c) */
    { extern int g_efx_stat; extern void efx_stat_note(CPU *c, uint32_t addr);
      if (g_efx_stat && addr - 0x650000u < 0x40000u) efx_stat_note(c, addr); }
    uint32_t off = addr - TEXT_BASE;
    if (off < TEXT_SIZE){
        uint32_t k = g_idx[off];
        if (k){
            /* ICALL=<adres>: o fonksiyona yapilan DOLAYLI cagrilari say ve
             * ilk birkacinda cagri zincirini dok.  Sanal cagrilar statik
             * grafla gorunmedigi icin gerekli. */
            static uint32_t want = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
            if (want == 0xFFFFFFFFu){ const char *e = getenv("ICALL");
                                      want = e ? (uint32_t)strtoul(e,0,0) : 0; }
            if (want && addr == want){
                extern uint64_t g_icall_hits; g_icall_hits++;
                { static uint32_t seen[256]; static int ns=0;
                  uint32_t h2 = MR32(c->esp+8);
                  int f3=0; for(int q=0;q<ns;q++) if(seen[q]==h2) f3=1;
                  if(!f3 && ns<256){ seen[ns++]=h2;
                    fprintf(stderr,"  [baglama] hash=0x%08X %s\n", h2,
                            h2==0x3EE7363Fu ? "  <<< WORLDVIEWPROJECTION" :
                           (h2==0x04191C37u ? "  <<< TEXTUREOFFSET" : "")); } }
                static int shown = 0;
                if (shown < 3){ shown++;
                    fprintf(stderr,"  [icall] 0x%08x cagrildi (arg1=%08x arg2=%08x arg3=%08x)\n",
                            addr, MR32(c->esp+4), MR32(c->esp+8), MR32(c->esp+12));
                    guest_backtrace(c, 10);
                }
            }
            g_stat_indirect_ok++; g_fn_ptr[k-1](c); return; }
    }
    /* Lift edilmis karsiligi yok.  Oyun bu adrese CALISMA ANINDA kod
     * uretmis olabilir (NFSU2'nin malzeme boru hatti bunu yogun yapar).
     * Kucuk bir x86 yorumlayicisiyla dene; bilinmeyen komutta guvenle
     * geri doner (esp'yi eski haline getirir) ve asagidaki tesise duser. */
    { static int gx = -1;
      if (gx < 0){ const char *e = getenv("GENEXEC"); gx = (e && *e=='0') ? 0 : 1; }
      if (gx && mem_is_committed(addr) && run_generated(c, addr)){
          g_stat_indirect_ok++; return;
      } }

    g_stat_indirect_miss++;
    /* Cagiran: donus adresi ZATEN YIGINDA (POP32'den once).  Eskiden
     * g_watch_prev_ip kullaniliyordu ama o yalnizca komut izleme aciksa
     * dolar, bu yuzden rapor hep 0x00000000 gosteriyordu. */
    { uint32_t ret = MR32(c->esp);
      if (g_miss_n < MISS_MAX){ g_miss_from[g_miss_n]=ret; g_miss[g_miss_n++]=addr; }
      static int shown = 0;
      if (shown < 5){ shown++;
          fprintf(stderr, "\n  [COZULEMEYEN DOLAYLI CAGRI] hedef=0x%08x  donus=0x%08x\n"
                  "      eax=%08x ecx=%08x edx=%08x ebx=%08x esi=%08x edi=%08x\n"
                  "      arg1=%08x arg2=%08x arg3=%08x\n",
                  addr, ret, c->eax, c->ecx, c->edx, c->ebx, c->esi, c->edi,
                  MR32(c->esp+4), MR32(c->esp+8), MR32(c->esp+12));
          /* Hedefteki baytlar: oyun calisma aninda KOD mu uretti (thunk),
           * yoksa isaretci mi bozuk?  Ayirt etmenin en hizli yolu. */
          if (mem_is_committed(addr+15)){
              fprintf(stderr, "      hedefteki 96 bayt:\n       ");
              for (int q = 0; q < 96; q++){
                  if (q && !(q & 15)) fprintf(stderr, "\n       ");
                  fprintf(stderr, " %02x", MR8(addr+q));
              }
              fprintf(stderr, "\n");
          } else fprintf(stderr, "      hedef commit EDILMEMIS (veri degil, cop isaretci)\n");
          guest_backtrace(c, 12);
      } }
    POP32(c->eip);            /* donus adresini temizle, cagriyi yut */
}

void unsupported_insn(CPU *c, uint32_t addr, const char *mn){
    (void)c; (void)mn;
    g_stat_unsupported++;
    if (g_unsup_n < MISS_MAX) g_unsup[g_unsup_n++] = addr;
}

void cpuid_shim(CPU *c){
    /* jenerik Pentium III benzeri: SSE evet, 3DNow hayir */
    switch (c->eax){
    case 0: c->eax=1; c->ebx=0x756e6547; c->edx=0x49656e69; c->ecx=0x6c65746e; break;
    case 1: c->eax=0x000006d8; c->ebx=0; c->ecx=0; c->edx=0x0383fbff; break;
    default: c->eax=c->ebx=c->ecx=c->edx=0; break;
    }
}
uint64_t rdtsc_shim(void){
    static uint64_t t = 0; return (t += 3000);
}

void dispatch_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr,"\n=== calisma zamani ===\n");
    fprintf(stderr,"  dolayli cagri  cozuldu : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)g_stat_indirect_ok);
    fprintf(stderr,"  dolayli cagri  cozulemedi: %llu\n", (unsigned long long)g_stat_indirect_miss);
    fprintf(stderr,"  desteklenmeyen komut     : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)g_stat_unsupported);
    genexec_report();
    if (g_miss_n){ fprintf(stderr,"  cozulemeyen dolayli cagrilar (hedef <- cagiran komut):\n");
        int shown=0;
        for(int i=0;i<g_miss_n && shown<12;i++){
            int dup=0; for(int j=0;j<i;j++) if(g_miss_from[j]==g_miss_from[i]) dup=1;
            if(dup) continue;
            fprintf(stderr,"    0x%08x  <-  0x%08x\n", g_miss[i], g_miss_from[i]); shown++; }
    }
    if (g_unsup_n){ fprintf(stderr,"  ilk trap adresleri      :"); for(int i=0;i<g_unsup_n && i<10;i++) fprintf(stderr," 0x%08x",g_unsup[i]); fprintf(stderr,"\n"); }
}

/* --- guest yigin izleyici: .text araligindaki donus adreslerini cozer --- */
static uint32_t nearest_fn(uint32_t a){
    uint32_t lo=0, hi=g_fn_count, best=0;
    while(lo<hi){ uint32_t m=(lo+hi)/2;
        if(g_fn_addr[m]<=a){ best=g_fn_addr[m]; lo=m+1; } else hi=m; }
    return best;
}
void guest_backtrace(CPU *c, int maxn){
    fprintf(stderr,"    guest yigin izi (esp=0x%08x):\n", c->esp);
    int shown=0;
    for (uint32_t k=0; k<2048 && shown<maxn; k++){
        uint32_t a = c->esp + 4u*k;
        if (!mem_is_committed(a)) continue;      /* haritalanmamis sayfayi atla */
        uint32_t v = MR32(a);
        if (v - TEXT_BASE < TEXT_SIZE){
            uint32_t f = nearest_fn(v);
            fprintf(stderr,"      [%2d] +0x%04x  donus 0x%08x   (sub_%08x + 0x%x)\n",
                    shown, k*4, v, f, v-f);
            shown++;
        }
    }
}

/* Hatali host PC'den uretilmis guest fonksiyonunu coz: g_fn_ptr host
 * adreslerini guest adresleriyle eslestirir; PC'nin altindaki en yakin
 * fonksiyon basi aranir. */
uint32_t guest_fn_from_host(const void *pc){
    uintptr_t p = (uintptr_t)pc, best = 0; uint32_t bestg = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_fn_count; i++){
        uintptr_t f = (uintptr_t)g_fn_ptr[i];
        if (f <= p && f > best){ best = f; bestg = g_fn_addr[i]; }
    }
    return bestg;
}
```

`runtime/dxrec.h`:

```h
/* D3DX HLE Asama 2: bir konuk fonksiyonunun yaptigi IDirect3DDevice9
 * cagrilarinin kaydi ve "simdi yapilsa etkisiz mi" denetimi.
 * Kayit com.c'de tutulur (cihaz durumunun kopyalari orada); kullanan
 * runtime/d3dx_hle.c.  Ayrintilar: D3DX_HLE.md, Asama 2.               */
#ifndef DXREC_H
#define DXREC_H
#include <stdint.h>


typedef struct {
    int16_t  mid;            /* com.c metot kimligi */
    uint16_t doff, dlen;     /* data[] icindeki sabit verisi */
    uint8_t  red;            /* kayit aninda etkisizdi */
    uint32_t a[3];           /* this'ten sonraki ilk 3 arguman */
} DxCall;

/* Kapasite kayit basina: durum kaydi 8 cagri / 256 bayt, gecis kaydi daha
 * buyuk.  call/data dizileri kaydi tasiyan yapinin icinde durur;
 * DXREC_INIT ile baglanir. */
typedef struct {
    uint8_t  kind;           /* DXREC_PASS / DXREC_STATE */
    uint8_t  ok;             /* 0: notlanamaz (desteklenmeyen cagri, ic ice, tasma, durum blogu) */
    uint8_t  allred;         /* kayit sirasinda her cagri etkisizdi */
    uint16_t ncall, maxcall;
    uint16_t ndata, maxdata;
    DxCall  *call;
    uint8_t *data;
} DxRec;
#define DXREC_INIT(r, calls, databuf) do{ (r)->call = (calls); (r)->data = (databuf); \
    (r)->maxcall = (uint16_t)(sizeof(calls)/sizeof((calls)[0])); \
    (r)->maxdata = (uint16_t)sizeof(databuf); (r)->ok = 0; (r)->ncall = (r)->ndata = 0; }while(0)

#define DXREC_PASS  1
#define DXREC_STATE 2
/* Gecis icinde durum kaydi normaldir.  Bir DURUM kaydinin icinde yeni bir
 * kayit baslarsa (ic ice uygulama = bilesik) distaki BUTUN kayitlar
 * gecersizlesir; ayni turden ic ice kayit da distakini gecersiz kilar. */
void dxrec_begin(DxRec *r, int kind);
void dxrec_append(const DxRec *src); /* atlanan bir durumun kayitli cagrilarini acik kayitlara ekle */
void dxrec_end(void);
int  dxrec_redundant(const DxRec *r);/* kaydedilen her cagri SIMDI etkisiz mi */
int  dxrec_sb_recording(void);
const char *dxrec_mid_name(int mid);       /* durum blogu kaydi acik mi (atlama yasak) */

#endif
```

`runtime/enhance.c`:

```c
/* Grafik iyilestirmeleri (yalnizca HD build).  Bkz. enhance.h, GRAFIK_ARASTIRMA.md.
 *
 * 1) YANSIMA COZUNURLUGU
 *    Oyun uc yansimayi ayri render hedeflerine ciziyor:
 *      yol yansimasi   320x240   (1080p'de yatayda 6x buyutuluyor)
 *      dikiz aynasi    256x256
 *      arac kup harita 128/yuz
 *    Hedefler CAGRI ADRESINDEN taniniyor (bizim exe, SHA 8f6a9ae2...).
 *    Topluluk modlarinin adresleri bu exe'de kayik; buradakiler kendi
 *    ayrıştırmamızdan:
 *      0x5BA0A7  CreateTexture(320,240,RT)   yol yansimasi
 *      0x5BA11D  CreateTexture(320,240,RT)   yol yansimasi bulanikligi
 *                                            (yalnizca yansima seviyesi 3)
 *      0x5BA1DD  CreateTexture([7FEE80],[7FEE84],RT)  dikiz aynasi
 *      0x5BA559  CreateCubeTexture([7FEE6C],RT)       arac cevre haritasi
 *    Z yuzeyleri (0x5BA0E9, 0x5BA21C, 0x5BA5AA) dokunmadan kalir: Metal Z
 *    dokusunu ilk kullanildigi hedefin boyutunda yaratiyor.
 *
 *    Ortam:  HDREFL=0       yansima iyilestirmesini kapat (A/B icin)
 *            HD_ROAD=0.5    yol yansimasi: geri tamponun kati.  2026-10-15
 *                           1.0 -> 0.5: 3024x1964 yarista 120 fps'i tutarken
 *                           ~2.5 W az (kare basina enerji -%17); goruntu farki
 *                           yok denecek kadar az (isin izleme acikken bu doku
 *                           yalnizca yedek ve bulanik).  Kup/ayna kucultmek ek
 *                           kazanc getirmedi.
 *            HD_MIRROR=1024 ayna kenari (piksel)
 *            HD_CUBE=512    kup yuzu kenari (piksel)
 *            HD_BLUR=0.5    yol yansimasi bulanikligi: 1 = oyunun kendi
 *                           genisligi, 0 = keskin (bkz. asagi)
 *
 * 2) YOL YANSIMASI BULANIKLIGI
 *    Oyun yansimayi ps 19 ile iki gecis bulaniklastiriyor (13->14->13):
 *    4 ornek, ofsetler 320 piksele gore UV'de sabit.  Doku 1920'ye
 *    buyuyunce ornekler 6 piksel aralikli dusuyor ve dikey cizgili desen
 *    cikiyordu.  Cozum: yansima hedeflerine mip zinciri, bulaniklik
 *    gecisinde L seviyesinden oku ve ornek ofsetlerini merkeze gore
 *    s = 2^L / olcek ile olcekle.  Boylece ornek araligi hep ~1 teksel:
 *      HD_BLUR=1 -> L = log2(olcek), s = 1: oyunun bulaniklik genisligi
 *      HD_BLUR=0 -> L = 0, s = 1/olcek: tam cozunurlukte ince bulaniklik
 *
 * 3) MSAA (kodu metal.m'de, "HD: ekran icin MSAA")
 *    HD_MSAA=4 (varsayilan; 2/8 da olur, 0/1 kapali).  Yalnizca EKRAN
 *    gecisleri cok ornekli; her gecis StoreAndMultisampleResolve ile
 *    drawable'a cozulur.  Z'nin cok ornekli ikizi tutulur ve derinligi de
 *    tek ornekli Z'ye COZULUR (HD_ZRESOLVE=0 kapatir): oyunun derinlik
 *    testli tam ekran dortgeni (ps 17 / vs 11, 1920x1080 hedefe) sahnenin
 *    derinligini gormek zorunda.  Cozulmeyince ekran disi hedefte Z testi
 *    yapan cizim sayisi kare basina ~11 olculdu.
 *
 * 4) SSR + yansima ayristirma (metal.m "HD: SSR", vsemu.c ps_to_msl_ex2,
 *    kamera: overrides.c sub_005c7ed0).  HD_SSR=0 kapali, HD_SSR_DEBUG=1.
 *    Ayrinti: GRAFIK_ARASTIRMA.md §8.
 *
 * 5) ISIN IZLEMELI YANSIMA (metal.m "RT cekirdegi" + "SABIT SAHNE ONBELLEGI",
 *    vsemu.c vs_to_msl'in vsk_N hesaplama cekirdegi).  macOS 13+.
 *    Yol ve araba pikselleri icin yansima isini gercek sahne geometrisine
 *    atilir; isabet oyunun kendi malzemesiyle golgelenir (doku, kose rengi,
 *    far isigi terimi, sis, alfa testi).  Iska -> oyunun kendi yansimasi.
 *      HD_RT=0         kapali (SSR'ye duser)
 *      HD_RT_SCALE=1..4 isin cozunurlugu boleni; verilmezse OTOMATIK (genislige
 *                      gore: 1080p 2, 2560/3024 3, 4K 4)
 *      HD_RT_CACHE=0   sabit sahne onbellegini kapat (kamera arkasi kaybolur)
 *      HD_RT_MAXD=600  isin menzili (dunya birimi ~ metre)
 *      HD_RT_LOD=0.05  uzakliga gore doku mip'i
 *      HD_RT_FIX=0     kose denetimini kapat (NaN / sonsuz / 100 km'den uzak
 *                      koseli ucgenler ivme yapisini zehirliyor: §11)
 *    Tani: HD_SSR_DEBUG=4 (yalniz yansima), HD_RT_LOG=1/2, HD_RT_DUMPTAB=<kare>,
 *    HD_RT_STRESS=<N>, HD_RT_STAGE/NOTEX/PLAIN, HD_RTPROBE.
 *    Ayrinti: GRAFIK_ARASTIRMA.md §9-§10.
 *
 * 6) GPU BUTCESI (metal.m "MSAA: gereksiz saklama / cozme", "SAHNEYI BOLEN ARA
 *    GECISI ERTELE").  Karede 5 cok ornekli ekran gecisi 1'e indirildi.
 *      HD_MSLAZY=0     tembel saklama/cozme kapali (eski davranis)
 *      HD_REORDER=0    ara gecis erteleme kapali
 *    Olcum (iki build'de): GPUWIN=a,b  PASSPROF=N [PASSPROF_MODE=1]
 *    yalniz HD: HD_COMP=0  HD_RT_AB=1.   Ayrinti: GRAFIK_ARASTIRMA.md §11.   */
#include "enhance.h"
#if NFS_ENHANCED
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define RET_ROAD       0x005BA0A7u
#define RET_ROAD_BLUR  0x005BA11Du
#define RET_MIRROR     0x005BA1DDu
#define RET_CUBE       0x005BA559u

static int    g_init, g_refl = 1;
static double g_road = 0.5, g_blur = 0.5;
static uint32_t g_mirror = 1024, g_cube = 512;
static uint32_t g_hits[4];
static uint32_t g_last_w[4], g_last_h[4];

static uint32_t clampu(double v){
    if (v < 16.0) return 16u;
    if (v > 8192.0) return 8192u;
    return (uint32_t)(v + 0.5);
}

static void enh_init(void){
    if (g_init) return;
    g_init = 1;
    const char *e;
    if ((e = getenv("HDREFL"))   && *e == '0') g_refl = 0;
    if ((e = getenv("HD_ROAD"))   && *e) g_road   = atof(e);
    if ((e = getenv("HD_MIRROR")) && *e) g_mirror = clampu(atof(e));
    if ((e = getenv("HD_CUBE"))   && *e) g_cube   = clampu(atof(e));
    if ((e = getenv("HD_BLUR"))   && *e) g_blur   = atof(e);
    if (g_blur < 0.0) g_blur = 0.0;
    if (g_blur > 1.0) g_blur = 1.0;
    if (g_road <= 0.0) g_road = 0.5;
    fprintf(stderr, "[HD] yansima: %s  yol=%.2fx geri tampon  bulaniklik=%.2f  ayna=%u  kup=%u\n",
            g_refl ? "ACIK" : "KAPALI", g_road, g_blur, g_mirror, g_cube);
}

const char *enh_build_name(void){ return "HD"; }
float enh_blur(void){ enh_init(); return (float)g_blur; }

int enh_rt_size(uint32_t ret, uint32_t bb_w, uint32_t bb_h,
                uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h){
    enh_init();
    if (!g_refl) return ENH_NONE;
    int k, kind;
    uint32_t nw, nh;
    switch (ret){
    case RET_ROAD: case RET_ROAD_BLUR:
        /* Beklenen boyut degilse (baska bir surum/yama) dokunma. */
        if (*w != 320u || *h != 240u) return ENH_NONE;
        k  = (ret == RET_ROAD) ? 0 : 1; kind = ENH_ROAD;
        nw = clampu(bb_w * g_road); nh = clampu(bb_h * g_road);
        break;
    case RET_MIRROR:
        if (*w != 256u || *h != 256u) return ENH_NONE;
        k = 2; kind = ENH_MIRROR; nw = nh = g_mirror;
        break;
    case RET_CUBE:
        if (*w != 128u) return ENH_NONE;
        k = 3; kind = ENH_CUBE; nw = nh = g_cube;
        break;
    default:
        return ENH_NONE;
    }
    if (g_hits[k] < 3 || g_last_w[k] != nw || g_last_h[k] != nh){
        static const char *nm[4] = { "yol yansimasi", "yol bulanikligi",
                                     "dikiz aynasi", "kup haritasi" };
        fprintf(stderr, "[HD] %s %ux%u -> %ux%u\n", nm[k], *w, *h, nw, nh);
    }
    g_hits[k]++; g_last_w[k] = nw; g_last_h[k] = nh;
    *w = nw; *h = nh;
    return kind;
}

/* Ana gorunumun (kimlik 1) matrislerini Metal'e kare verisi olarak ver. */
void enh_view_setup(uint32_t id, const float *m, uint32_t cam){
    (void)cam;
    /* VIEWLOG=1: her gorunum kimliginin gorunum matrisi (3x3 + konum),
     * kimlik basina 4000. cagridan sonra bir kez.  Kup yuzu kameralarinin
     * eksenlerini okumak icin. */
    { static int vl = -1; static unsigned cnt[32]; static unsigned char done[32];
      if (vl < 0) vl = getenv("VIEWLOG") ? 1 : 0;
      if (vl && id < 32u && !done[id] && ++cnt[id] > 4000u){ done[id] = 1;
          fprintf(stderr, "[gorunum %u] sag=(%.3f %.3f %.3f) y=(%.3f %.3f %.3f) ileri=(%.3f %.3f %.3f) P00=%.3f P11=%.3f\n",
                  id, m[0], m[4], m[8], m[1], m[5], m[9], m[2], m[6], m[10], m[16], m[21]); } }
    /* Kup harita yuzu kameralari (gorunum 16..21) dunya eksenlerine DEGIL
     * baska bir cerceveye hizali (olculdu).  Kup ornekleme vektorunu dunyaya
     * cevirmek icin yuz kameralarinin ileri yonleri: kup +x = gorunum 17,
     * +y = gorunum 18, +z = gorunum 21 (olculdu: arabada sag/geri/yukari;
     * HD_SSR_DEBUG=3 normal uyum testiyle dogrulandi). */
    static float cube_b[9] = { 1,0,0, 0,1,0, 0,0,1 };
    if (id == 17u || id == 18u || id == 21u){
        int a = (id == 17u) ? 0 : (id == 18u) ? 1 : 2;
        cube_b[a*3] = m[2]; cube_b[a*3+1] = m[6]; cube_b[a*3+2] = m[10];
        return;
    }
    if (id != 1u) return;
    void metal_hd_set_camera(const float *m48, float k, const float *cube9);
    float com_aspfix(void);
    metal_hd_set_camera(m, com_aspfix(), cube_b);
}

void enh_report(void){
    if (!g_init) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "[HD] yansima hedefleri: yol=%u bulaniklik=%u ayna=%u kup=%u"
            " (son: yol %ux%u, ayna %u, kup %u)\n",
            g_hits[0], g_hits[1], g_hits[2], g_hits[3],
            g_last_w[0], g_last_h[0], g_last_w[2], g_last_w[3]);
}
#endif /* NFS_ENHANCED */
```

`runtime/fileio.c`:

```c
/* Guest dosya G/C -> POSIX.  Windows yollarini oyun dizinine esler,
 * buyuk/kucuk harf duyarsiz cozumleme yapar.                          */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>
static uint64_t now_ns_io(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}

void mem_commit(uint32_t,uint32_t);

static char g_root[1024] = ".";
static char g_cwd_rel[512] = "";           /* oyun icindeki gecerli dizin */
uint64_t g_file_open=0, g_file_fail=0, g_file_read=0, g_bytes_read=0;
uint64_t g_overlapped_reads=0;
static int g_empty_next = 0;

void fileio_set_root(const char *exe_path){
    strncpy(g_root, exe_path, sizeof g_root - 1);
    char *slash = strrchr(g_root, '/');
    if (slash) *slash = 0; else strcpy(g_root, ".");
    fprintf(stderr,"dosya: oyun kok dizini = %s\n", g_root);
}

/* Windows yolunu gercek yola cevir.
 *   "C:\\NFSU2\\TRACKS\\X.BUN" | "TRACKS\\X.BUN" | ".\\X" -> <kok>/TRACKS/X.BUN
 * Sanal oyun dizini "C:\\NFSU2" oldugu icin o onek atilir.
 * Bilesenler buyuk-kucuk harf duyarsiz cozumlenir.                     */
/* Yazma amacli acilislarda eksik ust dizinleri olustur (Windows'ta oyun
 * bunlari ayrica yaratiyor; bizde yolun tamami hazir olmali). */
static void mkparents(const char *path){
    char tmp[1024]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", path);
    for (char *q = tmp + 1; *q; q++){
        if (*q != '/') continue;
        *q = 0; mkdir(tmp, 0755); *q = '/';
    }
}

static int resolve_in(const char *root, const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz){
    char rel[1024]; size_t k=0;
    const char *p = win;
    if (p[0] && p[1]==':') p += 2;                       /* surucu harfi   */
    while (*p=='\\' || *p=='/') p++;
    if (!strncasecmp(p,"NFSU2",5) && (p[5]=='\\'||p[5]=='/'||p[5]==0)){
        p += 5; while (*p=='\\'||*p=='/') p++;           /* sanal kok      */
    }
    while (p[0]=='.' && (p[1]=='\\'||p[1]=='/')) p += 2;
    for (; *p && k<sizeof rel-1; p++) rel[k++] = (*p=='\\') ? '/' : *p;
    rel[k]=0;
    if (!rel[0]){ snprintf(out,outsz,"%s",root); return 1; }

    snprintf(out, outsz, "%s/%s", root, rel);
    struct stat st;
    if (stat(out, &st)==0) return 1;

    /* bilesen bilesen buyuk-kucuk harf duyarsiz */
    char cur[1024]; snprintf(cur, sizeof cur, "%s", root);
    char tmp[1024]; snprintf(tmp,sizeof tmp,"%s",rel);
    char *save=0; int missing=0;
    for (char *tok=strtok_r(tmp,"/",&save); tok; tok=strtok_r(0,"/",&save)){
        if (missing){ size_t l=strlen(cur); snprintf(cur+l,sizeof cur-l,"/%s",tok); continue; }
        char cand[1024]; snprintf(cand,sizeof cand,"%s/%s",cur,tok);
        if (stat(cand,&st)==0){ snprintf(cur,sizeof cur,"%s",cand); continue; }
        DIR *d = opendir(cur); int found=0;
        if (d){ struct dirent *e;
            while ((e=readdir(d))){
                if (!strcasecmp(e->d_name, tok)){
                    snprintf(cand,sizeof cand,"%s/%s",cur,e->d_name);
                    found=1; break; } }
            closedir(d); }
        if (found) snprintf(cur,sizeof cur,"%s",cand);
        else { snprintf(cand,sizeof cand,"%s/%s",cur,tok);
               snprintf(cur,sizeof cur,"%s",cand); missing=1; }
    }
    snprintf(out,outsz,"%s",cur);
    return !missing;
}

/* --- yazma koku (kayit katmani) ----------------------------------------
 * Oyun kayitlarini ve profillerini KENDI klasorune yazar.  Veri .app'in
 * icine gomuluyken oraya yazmak paketin imzasini bozar; ayrica uygulama
 * guncellenince kayitlar silinir.  Yazma koku ayarliysa:
 *   - yazma / olusturma / silme her zaman yazma kokune gider,
 *   - okuma once yazma kokune, yoksa oyun kokune bakar,
 *   - dizin listesi ikisinin birlesimidir.
 * Ayarli degilse (terminalden ya da verisi disarida olan paket) her sey
 * eskisi gibi tek kokte kalir. */
static char g_wroot[1024] = "";
void fileio_set_write_root(const char *dir){
    if (!dir || !*dir){ g_wroot[0] = 0; return; }
    snprintf(g_wroot, sizeof g_wroot, "%s", dir);
    mkparents(g_wroot); mkdir(g_wroot, 0755);
    fprintf(stderr,"dosya: kayit dizini = %s\n", g_wroot);
}
/* Okuma: yazma kokunde varsa orasi, yoksa oyun koku. */
static int resolve(const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz){
    if (g_wroot[0]){
        char w[1024];
        if (resolve_in(g_wroot, win, w, sizeof w) && strcmp(w, g_wroot) != 0){
            snprintf(out, outsz, "%s", w); return 1; }
    }
    return resolve_in(g_root, win, out, outsz);
}
/* Yazma: yazma koku varsa HER ZAMAN orasi. */
static int resolve_w(const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz){
    return resolve_in(g_wroot[0] ? g_wroot : g_root, win, out, outsz);
}
static int copy_file(const char *a, const char *b){
    FILE *fa = fopen(a, "rb"); if (!fa) return 0;
    mkparents(b);
    FILE *fb = fopen(b, "wb"); if (!fb){ fclose(fa); return 0; }
    char bufr[65536]; size_t k;
    while ((k = fread(bufr, 1, sizeof bufr, fa)) > 0) fwrite(bufr, 1, k, fb);
    fclose(fb); fclose(fa); return 1;
}
/* Kirpmadan yazilacak bir dosya yalnizca oyun kokunde duruyorsa once
 * yazma kokune kopyala; yoksa oyun bos bir dosyanin uzerine yazar. */
static void copy_up(const char *win, const char *wpath){
    if (!g_wroot[0]) return;
    struct stat st; if (stat(wpath, &st) == 0) return;
    char src[1024];
    if (resolve_in(g_root, win, src, sizeof src) && stat(src, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode))
        copy_file(src, wpath);
}

/* --- handle tablosu --- */
#define FH_BASE 0x00900000u
#define FH_MAX  256
typedef struct { int fd; int empty; int used; char path[512]; DIR *dir; char pat[128];
                 DIR *dir2; char path1[512]; } FH;   /* dir2: oyun koku (kayit katmani etkinken) */
static FH g_fh[FH_MAX];
static uint32_t fh_new(void){
    for (int i=1;i<FH_MAX;i++) if(!g_fh[i].used){ memset(&g_fh[i],0,sizeof g_fh[i]);
        g_fh[i].used=1; g_fh[i].fd=-1; return FH_BASE+(uint32_t)i; }
    return 0;
}
static FH *fh_get(uint32_t h){
    if (h<FH_BASE || h>=FH_BASE+FH_MAX) return 0;
    FH *f=&g_fh[h-FH_BASE]; return f->used?f:0;
}
int fileio_is_handle(uint32_t h){ return fh_get(h)!=0; }

static uint32_t A(CPU *c,int i){ return MR32(c->esp + 4u*(uint32_t)i); }
#define GS(a) ((const char*)(g_mem + (uint32_t)(a)))
#define INVALID_HANDLE 0xFFFFFFFFu

/* Dizin taramasinda siradaki adi ver: once yazma koku, sonra oyun koku. */
static int find_next(FH *f, char *nm, size_t nsz){
    struct dirent *e;
    if (f->dir){
        while ((e = readdir(f->dir))){
            if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
            snprintf(nm, nsz, "%s", e->d_name); return 1; }
    }
    if (f->dir2){
        while ((e = readdir(f->dir2))){
            if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
            if (f->path1[0]){               /* yazma kokunde zaten verildi */
                char p[1024]; struct stat st;
                snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", f->path1, e->d_name);
                if (stat(p, &st) == 0) continue; }
            snprintf(nm, nsz, "%s", e->d_name); return 1; }
    }
    return 0;
}

int fileio_call(CPU *c, const char *n, uint32_t *out){
    uint32_t r = 0;
    if (!strcmp(n,"CreateFileA")){
        uint32_t pn=A(c,0), access=A(c,1), disp=A(c,4);
        char real[1024];
        int flags;
        if (disp==2 /*CREATE_ALWAYS*/ || disp==1 /*CREATE_NEW*/) flags=O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC;
        else if (disp==4 /*OPEN_ALWAYS*/) flags=O_RDWR|O_CREAT;
        else flags = (access & 0x40000000u) ? O_RDWR : O_RDONLY;
        int ok;
        if (flags != O_RDONLY){
            ok = resolve_w(GS(pn), real, sizeof real);
            if (!(flags & O_TRUNC)) copy_up(GS(pn), real);
        } else ok = resolve(GS(pn), real, sizeof real);
        if (flags & O_CREAT) mkparents(real);
        /* Dil eki geri dusumu: bu surumde film yolunda "_fr.vp6" soneki
         * gomulu ama klasorde "_en" dosyalari var.  Istenen yoksa
         * "_en" ve eksiz surumu dene.                                   */
        struct stat _st;
        if (!(flags & O_CREAT) && stat(real, &_st) != 0){
            char alt[1024]; const char *dot = strrchr(real, '.');
            if (dot && dot - real > 3){
                size_t base = (size_t)(dot - real);
                const char *sfx[] = { "_en", "", "_dn", "_du", "_sw" };
                for (int q = 0; q < 5; q++){
                    /* mevcut dil ekini (varsa) kaldir */
                    size_t cut = base;
                    if (base >= 3 && real[base-3] == '_') cut = base - 3;
                    snprintf(alt, sizeof alt, "%.*s%s%s",
                             (int)cut, real, sfx[q], dot);
                    if (stat(alt, &_st) == 0){
                        if (getenv("VERBOSE") || getenv("FILELIST"))
                            fprintf(stderr,"  [dosya] dil geri dusumu: \"%s\" -> \"%s\"\n",
                                    real, alt);
                        snprintf(real, sizeof real, "%s", alt);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        /* NOMOVIES=1: video dosyalarini yok say.  VP6 kod cozucusu yok;
         * oyun videoyu oynatmaya calisip beklerse orada takiliyor. */
        int fd;
        { const char *ext = strrchr(real, '.');
          const char *nm2 = getenv("NOMOVIES");
          int movie_mode = (nm2 && *nm2 && *nm2 != '0') ? atoi(nm2) : 0;
          /* mod 3: yalnizca "blank" filmini atla (gercek filmler oynasin) */
          const char *bn2 = strrchr(real, '/'); bn2 = bn2 ? bn2+1 : real;
          if (movie_mode == 3 && !strncasecmp(bn2, "blank", 5)) fd = -1;
          else if (movie_mode == 1 && ext &&

    }
    else return 0;
    *out = r;
    return 1;
}

void fileio_report(void){
    if (g_overlapped_reads)
        fprintf(stderr,"  dosya: %llu asenkron (overlapped) okuma\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_overlapped_reads);

            (unsigned long long)g_file_open,(unsigned long long)g_file_fail,
            (unsigned long long)g_file_read,(double)g_bytes_read/1048576.0);
}
```

`runtime/genexec.c`:

```c
/* Guest'in CALISMA ANINDA URETTIGI x86 kodunu calistir.
 *
 * Statik rekompilasyonun asil kör noktasi: oyun yigina duz x86 yaziyor ve
 * oradan cagiriyor; o adresler icin uretilmis C karsiligimiz yok.  NFSU2'nin
 * malzeme/render durum boru hatti bunu yogun kullaniyor -- olculdu: bir
 * oturumda 17.000'den fazla cagri, hepsi sub_00725520 icindeki
 * `call [eax+8]` uzerinden.  Uretilen blok tipik olarak sudur:
 *
 *     push esi                       ; 0x105fdbe4 gibi bir yigin adresi
 *     mov  esi,[esp+8]               ; arg1 = malzeme nesnesi
 *     push esi
 *     call sub_0071feef              ; .text'teki KAYITLI kucuk erisimci
 *     add  esi,0x14
 *     ...
 *     mov  [esi+0xa0],eax  ...  mov [esi+0x150],eax
 *
 * Cagri hedefleri gercek lifted fonksiyonlar, yani onlari dogrudan
 * dispatch_indirect'e devredebiliyoruz.  Bu cagrilarin yutulmasi yuksek
 * detay ayarlarinda cokmeye yol aciyordu.
 *
 * TASARIM ILKESI: bilinmeyen bir bayt gorursek SESSIZCE DEVAM ETMEYIZ.
 * Durur, esp'yi geri alir ve raporlariz -- yanlis calismaktansa gorunur
 * kalsin.  Ayni sekilde her bellek islemi commit kontrolunden gecer;
 * bozuk isaretciyle host'u cokertmek yerine bail ederiz.                */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

extern uint8_t *g_mem;
void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t addr);
int  mem_is_committed(uint32_t a);

uint64_t g_gen_calls = 0, g_gen_insns = 0, g_gen_bail = 0;
static uint32_t g_gen_bop = 0, g_gen_bpc = 0;
static uint32_t g_gen_bail_ops[16]; static int g_gen_bail_n = 0;

#define BAIL(pc_,op_) do{ g_gen_bail++; g_gen_bop=(op_); g_gen_bpc=(pc_); \
        { int _d=0; for(int _q=0;_q<g_gen_bail_n;_q++) if(g_gen_bail_ops[_q]==(op_)) _d=1; \
          if(!_d && g_gen_bail_n<16) g_gen_bail_ops[g_gen_bail_n++]=(op_); } \
        goto bail; }while(0)

/* commit kontrollu erisim; basarisizsa bail */
#define CHK(a_,n_) do{ if(!mem_is_committed(a_) || !mem_is_committed((a_)+(n_)-1)) \
                         BAIL(pc, 0xFFFFFFFEu); }while(0)

typedef struct { int is_reg; int reg; uint32_t ea; int len; } Opnd;

/* ModRM (+SIB +disp) coz.  len = modrm'den itibaren tuketilen bayt.      */
static Opnd modrm(CPU *c, uint32_t p, int *rf){
    Opnd o = {0,0,0,0};
    uint8_t m = MR8(p);
    int mod = m >> 6, rm = m & 7;
    *rf = (m >> 3) & 7;
    int len = 1; uint32_t base = 0;
    if (mod == 3){ o.is_reg = 1; o.reg = rm; o.len = 1; return o; }
    if (rm == 4){                                   /* SIB */
        uint8_t sib = MR8(p + 1); len++;
        int sc = sib >> 6, ix = (sib >> 3) & 7, bs = sib & 7;
        if (bs == 5 && mod == 0){ base = MR32(p + len); len += 4; }
        else base = c->r[bs];
        if (ix != 4) base += c->r[ix] << sc;
    } else if (rm == 5 && mod == 0){ base = MR32(p + 1); len += 4; }
    else base = c->r[rm];
    if      (mod == 1){ base += (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int8_t)MR8(p + len); len += 1; }
    else if (mod == 2){ base += MR32(p + len); len += 4; }
    o.ea = base; o.len = len; return o;
}

int run_generated(CPU *c, uint32_t entry){
    uint32_t pc = entry, esp0 = c->esp;
    g_gen_calls++;
    for (int budget = 0; budget < 200000; budget++){
        if (!mem_is_committed(pc)) BAIL(pc, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
        uint8_t op = MR8(pc);
        int osz16 = 0;
        if (op == 0x66){ osz16 = 1; pc++; op = MR8(pc); }   /* operand boyutu 16 */
        g_gen_insns++;
        int rf; Opnd o;
        uint32_t a, b, r;

        switch (op){
        /* ---- yigin ---- */
        case 0x50: case 0x51: case 0x52: case 0x53:
        case 0x54: case 0x55: case 0x56: case 0x57:
            PUSH32(c->r[op-0x50]); pc++; continue;
        case 0x58: case 0x59: case 0x5A: case 0x5B:
        case 0x5C: case 0x5D: case 0x5E: case 0x5F:
            POP32(c->r[op-0x58]); pc++; continue;
        case 0x68: PUSH32(MR32(pc+1)); pc += 5; continue;                    /* push imm32 */
        case 0x6A: PUSH32((uint32_t)(int32_t)(int8_t)MR8(pc+1)); pc += 2; continue;
        case 0x9C: PUSH32(0x202u | (c->cf) | (c->pf<<2) | (c->zf<<6)
                          | (c->sf<<7) | (c->of<<11)); pc++; continue;       /* pushfd */
        case 0x9D: { uint32_t f; POP32(f);
                     c->cf=f&1; c->pf=(f>>2)&1; c->zf=(f>>6)&1;
                     c->sf=(f>>7)&1; c->of=(f>>11)&1; pc++; continue; }

        /* ---- mov ---- */
        case 0x8B: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            if (o.is_reg) c->r[rf] = c->r[o.reg];
            else { CHK(o.ea,4); if (osz16) c->r[rf]=(c->r[rf]&0xFFFF0000u)|MR16(o.ea);
                   else c->r[rf]=MR32(o.ea); }
            pc += 1+o.len; continue;
        case 0x89: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            if (o.is_reg){ if (osz16) c->r[o.reg]=(c->r[o.reg]&0xFFFF0000u)|(c->r[rf]&0xFFFFu);
                           else c->r[o.reg]=c->r[rf]; }
            else { CHK(o.ea,4); if (osz16) MR16(o.ea)=(uint16_t)c->r[rf]; else MR32(o.ea)=c->r[rf]; }
            pc += 1+o.len; continue;
        case 0x8A: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);            /* mov r8, r/m8 */
            a = o.is_reg ? ((o.reg<4)?(c->r[o.reg]&0xFFu):((c->r[o.reg-4]>>8)&0xFFu))
                         : ({ CHK(o.ea,1); (uint32_t)MR8(o.ea); });
            if (rf<4) c->r[rf]=(c->r[rf]&~0xFFu)|a; else c->r[rf-4]=(c->r[rf-4]&~0xFF00u)|(a<<8);
            pc += 1+o.len; continue;
        case 0x88: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);            /* mov r/m8, r8 */
            a = (rf<4)?(c->r[rf]&0xFFu):((c->r[rf-4]>>8)&0xFFu);
            if (o.is_reg){ if (o.reg<4) c->r[o.reg]=(c->r[o.reg]&~0xFFu)|a;
                           else c->r[o.reg-4]=(c->r[o.reg-4]&~0xFF00u)|(a<<8); }
            else { CHK(o.ea,1); MR8(o.ea)=(uint8_t)a; }
            pc += 1+o.len; continue;
        case 0xB0: case 0xB1: case 0xB2: case 0xB3:
        case 0xB4: case 0xB5: case 0xB6: case 0xB7: {                        /* mov r8, imm8 */
            int k = op-0xB0; a = MR8(pc+1);
            if (k<4) c->r[k]=(c->r[k]&~0xFFu)|a; else c->r[k-4]=(c->r[k-4]&~0xFF00u)|(a<<8);
            pc += 2; continue; }
        case 0xB8: case 0xB9: case 0xBA: case 0xBB:
        case 0xBC: case 0xBD: case 0xBE: case 0xBF:                          /* mov r32, imm32 */
            if (osz16){ c->r[op-0xB8]=(c->r[op-0xB8]&0xFFFF0000u)|MR16(pc+1); pc += 3; }
            else { c->r[op-0xB8] = MR32(pc+1); pc += 5; }
            continue;
        case 0xC6: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf); if (rf) BAIL(pc,op);
            a = MR8(pc+1+o.len);
            if (o.is_reg){ if (o.reg<4) c->r[o.reg]=(c->r[o.reg]&~0xFFu)|a;
                           else c->r[o.reg-4]=(c->r[o.reg-4]&~0xFF00u)|(a<<8); }
            else { CHK(o.ea,1); MR8(o.ea)=(uint8_t)a; }
            pc += 1+o.len+1; continue;
        case 0xC7: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf); if (rf) BAIL(pc,op);
            if (osz16){ a = MR16(pc+1+o.len);
                if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=(c->r[o.reg]&0xFFFF0000u)|a;
                else { CHK(o.ea,2); MR16(o.ea)=(uint16_t)a; }
                pc += 1+o.len+2; }
            else { a = MR32(pc+1+o.len);
                if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=a; else { CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea)=a; }
                pc += 1+o.len+4; }
            continue;
        case 0xA1: a = MR32(pc+1); CHK(a,4); c->eax = MR32(a); pc += 5; continue;
        case 0xA3: a = MR32(pc+1); CHK(a,4); MR32(a) = c->eax; pc += 5; continue;
        case 0x8D: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf); if (o.is_reg) BAIL(pc,op);
            c->r[rf] = o.ea; pc += 1+o.len; continue;

        /* ---- ALU: r/m32,r32 (op) ve r32,r/m32 (op+2) ---- */
        case 0x01: case 0x09: case 0x11: case 0x19:
        case 0x21: case 0x29: case 0x31: case 0x39:
        case 0x03: case 0x0B: case 0x13: case 0x1B:
        case 0x23: case 0x2B: case 0x33: case 0x3B: {
            int dir = (op & 2) != 0;                 /* 1: hedef yazmac  */
            int fn  = (op >> 3) & 7;
            o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            uint32_t rm = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
            a = dir ? c->r[rf] : rm;
            b = dir ? rm       : c->r[rf];
            switch (fn){
            case 0: r=a+b; FLAGS_ADD(a,b,r,32); break;
            case 1: r=a|b; FLAGS_LOG(r,32); break;
            case 2: { uint32_t ci=c->cf; r=a+b+ci; FLAGS_ADC(a,b,r,ci,32); } break;
            case 3: { uint32_t ci=c->cf; r=a-b-ci; FLAGS_SBB(a,b,r,ci,32); } break;
            case 4: r=a&b; FLAGS_LOG(r,32); break;
            case 5: r=a-b; FLAGS_SUB(a,b,r,32); break;
            case 6: r=a^b; FLAGS_LOG(r,32); break;
            default: r=a-b; FLAGS_SUB(a,b,r,32); pc += 1+o.len; continue;  /* cmp: yazma yok */
            }
            if (dir) c->r[rf]=r; else if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=r; else MR32(o.ea)=r;
            pc += 1+o.len; continue; }

        /* ---- grup1: 0x83 imm8-isaretli, 0x81 imm32 ---- */
        case 0x81: case 0x83: {
            o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            int imm8 = (op == 0x83);
            b = imm8 ? (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int8_t)MR8(pc+1+o.len) : MR32(pc+1+o.len);
            a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
            switch (rf){
            case 0: r=a+b; FLAGS_ADD(a,b,r,32); break;
            case 1: r=a|b; FLAGS_LOG(r,32); break;
            case 2: { uint32_t ci=c->cf; r=a+b+ci; FLAGS_ADC(a,b,r,ci,32); } break;
            case 3: { uint32_t ci=c->cf; r=a-b-ci; FLAGS_SBB(a,b,r,ci,32); } break;
            case 4: r=a&b; FLAGS_LOG(r,32); break;
            case 5: r=a-b; FLAGS_SUB(a,b,r,32); break;
            case 6: r=a^b; FLAGS_LOG(r,32); break;
            default: r=a-b; FLAGS_SUB(a,b,r,32);                        /* cmp */
                     pc += 1+o.len+(imm8?1:4); continue;
            }
            if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=r; else MR32(o.ea)=r;
            pc += 1+o.len+(imm8?1:4); continue; }

        /* ---- test / inc / dec ---- */
        case 0x85: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
            r = a & c->r[rf]; FLAGS_LOG(r,32); pc += 1+o.len; continue;
        case 0xA9: r = c->eax & MR32(pc+1); FLAGS_LOG(r,32); pc += 5; continue;
        case 0x40: case 0x41: case 0x42: case 0x43:
        case 0x44: case 0x45: case 0x46: case 0x47:
            { uint32_t cf0=c->cf; a=c->r[op-0x40]; r=a+1; FLAGS_ADD(a,1u,r,32);
              c->cf=cf0; c->r[op-0x40]=r; } pc++; continue;
        case 0x48: case 0x49: case 0x4A: case 0x4B:
        case 0x4C: case 0x4D: case 0x4E: case 0x4F:
            { uint32_t cf0=c->cf; a=c->r[op-0x48]; r=a-1; FLAGS_SUB(a,1u,r,32);
              c->cf=cf0; c->r[op-0x48]=r; } pc++; continue;

        /* ---- kaydirma ---- */
        case 0xC1: case 0xD1: case 0xD3: {
            o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            int extra = (op==0xC1) ? 1 : 0;
            uint32_t sh = (op==0xC1) ? (MR8(pc+1+o.len)&31u)
                        : (op==0xD1) ? 1u : (c->ecx & 31u);
            a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
            switch (rf){
            case 4: case 6: r = sh ? (a << sh) : a; if(sh) c->cf=(a>>(32-sh))&1; break; /* shl */
            case 5: r = sh ? (a >> sh) : a;         if(sh) c->cf=(a>>(sh-1))&1; break;  /* shr */
            case 7: r = sh ? (uint32_t)((int32_t)a >> sh) : a;
                    if(sh) c->cf=((int32_t)a>>(sh-1))&1; break;                          /* sar */
            default: BAIL(pc,op);
            }
            if (sh){ c->zf=(r==0); c->sf=(r>>31)&1; c->pf=parity8(r); }
            if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=r; else MR32(o.ea)=r;
            pc += 1+o.len+extra; continue; }

        /* ---- grup3 (0xF7) ---- */
        case 0xF7: {
            o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
            switch (rf){
            case 0: r = a & MR32(pc+1+o.len); FLAGS_LOG(r,32);
                    pc += 1+o.len+4; continue;                                   /* test */
            case 2: r = ~a; break;                                               /* not  */
            case 3: r = 0u-a; FLAGS_SUB(0u,a,r,32); break;                       /* neg  */
            case 4: { uint64_t p=(uint64_t)c->eax*(uint64_t)a;                   /* mul  */
                      c->eax=(uint32_t)p; c->edx=(uint32_t)(p>>32);
                      c->cf=c->of=(c->edx!=0); pc += 1+o.len; continue; }
            case 5: { int64_t p=(int64_t)(int32_t)c->eax*(int64_t)(int32_t)a;    /* imul */
                      c->eax=(uint32_t)p; c->edx=(uint32_t)((uint64_t)p>>32);
                      c->cf=c->of=((int64_t)(int32_t)c->eax!=p); pc += 1+o.len; continue; }
            case 6: { if(!a) BAIL(pc,op);                                        /* div  */
                      uint64_t n=((uint64_t)c->edx<<32)|c->eax;
                      c->eax=(uint32_t)(n/a); c->edx=(uint32_t)(n%a);
                      pc += 1+o.len; continue; }
            case 7: { if(!a) BAIL(pc,op);                                        /* idiv */
                      int64_t n=(int64_t)(((uint64_t)c->edx<<32)|c->eax);
                      c->eax=(uint32_t)(n/(int32_t)a); c->edx=(uint32_t)(n%(int32_t)a);
                      pc += 1+o.len; continue; }
            default: BAIL(pc,op);
            }
            if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=r; else MR32(o.ea)=r;
            pc += 1+o.len; continue; }

        /* ---- imul imm ---- */
        case 0x69: case 0x6B: {
            o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
            b = (op==0x6B) ? (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int8_t)MR8(pc+1+o.len) : MR32(pc+1+o.len);
            int64_t p = (int64_t)(int32_t)a * (int64_t)(int32_t)b;
            c->r[rf] = (uint32_t)p; c->cf = c->of = ((int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)p != p);
            pc += 1+o.len+((op==0x6B)?1:4); continue; }

        /* ---- kosullu atlama ---- */
        case 0x70: case 0x71: case 0x72: case 0x73: case 0x74: case 0x75: case 0x76: case 0x77:
        case 0x78: case 0x79: case 0x7A: case 0x7B: case 0x7C: case 0x7D: case 0x7E: case 0x7F: {
            int t; switch (op & 0xF){
            case 0x0:t=CC_O;break;  case 0x1:t=CC_NO;break; case 0x2:t=CC_B;break;  case 0x3:t=CC_AE;break;
            case 0x4:t=CC_E;break;  case 0x5:t=CC_NE;break; case 0x6:t=CC_BE;break; case 0x7:t=CC_A;break;
            case 0x8:t=CC_S;break;  case 0x9:t=CC_NS;break; case 0xA:t=CC_P;break;  case 0xB:t=CC_NP;break;
            case 0xC:t=CC_L;break;  case 0xD:t=CC_GE;break; case 0xE:t=CC_LE;break; default:t=CC_G;break; }
            pc += 2; if (t) pc += (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int8_t)MR8(pc-1);
            continue; }
        case 0xE9: pc += 5 + MR32(pc+1); continue;
        case 0xEB: pc += 2 + (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int8_t)MR8(pc+1); continue;

        /* ---- 0x0F ikili ---- */
        case 0x0F: {
            uint8_t o2 = MR8(pc+1);
            if (o2 >= 0x80 && o2 <= 0x8F){                       /* jcc rel32 */
                int t; switch (o2 & 0xF){
                case 0x0:t=CC_O;break;  case 0x1:t=CC_NO;break; case 0x2:t=CC_B;break;  case 0x3:t=CC_AE;break;
                case 0x4:t=CC_E;break;  case 0x5:t=CC_NE;break; case 0x6:t=CC_BE;break; case 0x7:t=CC_A;break;
                case 0x8:t=CC_S;break;  case 0x9:t=CC_NS;break; case 0xA:t=CC_P;break;  case 0xB:t=CC_NP;break;
                case 0xC:t=CC_L;break;  case 0xD:t=CC_GE;break; case 0xE:t=CC_LE;break; default:t=CC_G;break; }
                uint32_t rel = MR32(pc+2); pc += 6; if (t) pc += rel; continue; }
            if (o2 >= 0x90 && o2 <= 0x9F){                       /* setcc r/m8 */
                int t; switch (o2 & 0xF){
                case 0x0:t=CC_O;break;  case 0x1:t=CC_NO;break; case 0x2:t=CC_B;break;  case 0x3:t=CC_AE;break;
                case 0x4:t=CC_E;break;  case 0x5:t=CC_NE;break; case 0x6:t=CC_BE;break; case 0x7:t=CC_A;break;
                case 0x8:t=CC_S;break;  case 0x9:t=CC_NS;break; case 0xA:t=CC_P;break;  case 0xB:t=CC_NP;break;
                case 0xC:t=CC_L;break;  case 0xD:t=CC_GE;break; case 0xE:t=CC_LE;break; default:t=CC_G;break; }
                o = modrm(c,pc+2,&rf);
                if (o.is_reg){ if (o.reg<4) c->r[o.reg]=(c->r[o.reg]&~0xFFu)|(uint32_t)t;
                               else c->r[o.reg-4]=(c->r[o.reg-4]&~0xFF00u)|((uint32_t)t<<8); }
                else { CHK(o.ea,1); MR8(o.ea)=(uint8_t)t; }
                pc += 2+o.len; continue; }
            if (o2 == 0xB6 || o2 == 0xB7 || o2 == 0xBE || o2 == 0xBF){   /* movzx/movsx */
                int wide = (o2 & 1), sx = (o2 >= 0xBE);
                o = modrm(c,pc+2,&rf);
                if (o.is_reg) a = wide ? (c->r[o.reg]&0xFFFFu)
                                       : ((o.reg<4)?(c->r[o.reg]&0xFFu):((c->r[o.reg-4]>>8)&0xFFu));
                else { CHK(o.ea, wide?2:1); a = wide ? MR16(o.ea) : MR8(o.ea); }
                c->r[rf] = sx ? (wide ? (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)a
                                      : (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int8_t)a) : a;
                pc += 2+o.len; continue; }
            if (o2 == 0xAF){                                     /* imul r32, r/m32 */
                o = modrm(c,pc+2,&rf);
                a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
                int64_t p = (int64_t)(int32_t)c->r[rf] * (int64_t)(int32_t)a;
                c->r[rf] = (uint32_t)p; c->cf = c->of = ((int64_t)(int32_t)(uint32_t)p != p);
                pc += 2+o.len; continue; }
            if (o2 == 0x1F){ o = modrm(c,pc+2,&rf); pc += 2+o.len; continue; }   /* nop */
            BAIL(pc, 0x0F00u | o2); }

        /* ---- grup5 (0xFF) ---- */
        case 0xFF: {
            o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf);
            switch (rf){
            case 0: case 1: {                                    /* inc/dec r/m32 */
                a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
                uint32_t cf0=c->cf;
                if (rf==0){ r=a+1; FLAGS_ADD(a,1u,r,32); } else { r=a-1; FLAGS_SUB(a,1u,r,32); }
                c->cf=cf0;
                if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=r; else MR32(o.ea)=r;
                pc += 1+o.len; continue; }
            case 2: {                                            /* call r/m32 */
                uint32_t t = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
                uint32_t next = pc+1+o.len;
                PUSH32(next); dispatch_indirect(c, t); pc = next; continue; }   /* bkz. asagi */
            case 4: {                                            /* jmp r/m32 */
                uint32_t t = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
                pc = t; continue; }
            case 6: {                                            /* push r/m32 */
                a = o.is_reg ? c->r[o.reg] : ({ CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea); });
                PUSH32(a); pc += 1+o.len; continue; }
            default: BAIL(pc,op);
            } }
        case 0x8F: o = modrm(c,pc+1,&rf); if (rf) BAIL(pc,op);   /* pop r/m32 */
            { uint32_t v; POP32(v);
              if (o.is_reg) c->r[o.reg]=v; else { CHK(o.ea,4); MR32(o.ea)=v; } }
            pc += 1+o.len; continue;

        /* ---- cagri / donus ---- */
        case 0xE8: {
            uint32_t next = pc + 5, t = next + MR32(pc+1);
            PUSH32(next);
            dispatch_indirect(c, t);
            /* donus noktasi = itilen adres (c->eip DEGIL): lift edilmis ret
             * RETEIP=0 ile c->eip'e yazmiyor; model zaten degistirilmis donus
             * adreslerini yok sayiyor, lift edilmis cagiran da hep 'next'te devam eder. */
            pc = next; continue; }
        case 0xC3: POP32(c->eip); return 1;
        case 0xC2: { uint16_t n = MR16(pc+1); POP32(c->eip); c->esp += n; return 1; }
        case 0x90: pc++; continue;

        default: BAIL(pc,op);
        }
    }
    BAIL(pc, 0xFFFFFFFDu);                 /* butce asimi */
bail:
    c->esp = esp0;                         /* cagiranin donus adresi tekrar tepede */
    return 0;
}

void genexec_report(void){
    if (!g_gen_calls) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "  uretilen guest kod: %llu cagri, %llu komut",
            (unsigned long long)g_gen_calls, (unsigned long long)g_gen_insns);
    if (g_gen_bail){
        fprintf(stderr, ", %llu BASARISIZ (son: 0x%02x @0x%08x; gorulen:",
                (unsigned long long)g_gen_bail, g_gen_bop, g_gen_bpc);
        for (int i = 0; i < g_gen_bail_n; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %02x", g_gen_bail_ops[i]);
        fprintf(stderr, ")");
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "\n");
}
```

```h
/* com.c (guest tarafi) ile metal.m (cizim tarafi) arasindaki ortak kose bicimi.
 * Kose shader'i CPU'da calistirildigi icin buraya gelen konumlar KIRPMA
 * UZAYINDA (clip space) olur; perspektif bolmesini rasterlestirici yapar. */
#ifndef GFX_H
#define GFX_H
/* DIKKAT: doku koordinatlari asama basina DORT bilesen tasir.
 * Onceden yalnizca .xy tasiniyordu; oysa oyunun kose gölgelendiricileri
 * PROJEKSIYONLU koordinat uretiyor (olculdu: oT1.x/y/z = dot(v0, c4..c6),
 * oT1.w = r0.x).  z/w atilinca yol/araba yansimalari cizgi cizgi ve
 * karanlik cikiyordu. */
typedef struct {
    float x, y, z, w;      /* kirpma uzayi */
    float r, g, b, a;      /* oD0 - diffuse */
    float r1,g1,b1,a1;     /* oD1 - specular */
    float t[4][4];         /* oT0..oT3, tam dort bilesen */
} TVert;

void metal_draw_tv(const TVert *tv, unsigned nverts, unsigned prim, unsigned tex);
#endif
```

`runtime/mem.c`:

```c
/* Guest bellek: 4 GB rezerve (PROT_NONE), kullanilan bolgeler commit edilir. */
#include <errno.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
void (*g_backtrace_fn)(struct CPU*,int) = 0;   /* dispatch.c kurar */
CPU *g_cur_cpu = 0;

uint8_t *g_mem = 0;
uint32_t g_image_base = 0x400000u, g_res_dir_va = 0, g_res_dir_size = 0;

/* izleme durumu: her derlemede tanimli olmali (debug.c opsiyonel) */
uint32_t g_itrace[ITRACE_SIZE];
uint64_t g_itrace_n = 0;
uint32_t g_watch_addr = 0, g_watch_val = 0, g_watch_prev_ip = 0;
void (*g_itrace_dump_fn)(int) = 0;      /* debug.c kurar */
void (*g_report_fn)(void) = 0;          /* boot.c kurar */
__attribute__((weak)) void watch_report_change(uint32_t ip, uint32_t o, uint32_t n){
    (void)ip;(void)o;(void)n;
}
static uint64_t g_committed = 0;
/* commit edilen 16 KB sayfalarin bitmap'i (4 GB / 16 KB = 262144 bit = 32 KB) */
uint8_t g_cbits[1u<<15] = {0};
/* Govde artik cpu.h'ta satir ici (uc komut).  Ayri bir cagri olarak
 * profilde konuk thread'in %1.45'iydi -- is degil, cagri masrafi. */


void mprot_arm(uint32_t);
void mem_init(void){
    if (g_mem) return;
    g_mem = mmap(0, GSZ, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON|MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    if (g_mem == MAP_FAILED){ perror("mmap 4GB"); exit(1); }
}

void mem_commit(uint32_t addr, uint32_t size){
    uint64_t lo = addr & ~0x3FFFull;                    /* 16 KB sayfa */
    uint64_t hi = ((uint64_t)addr + size + 0x3FFF) & ~0x3FFFull;
    if (hi > 0x100000000ull) hi = 0x100000000ull;
    if (mprotect(g_mem + lo, hi - lo, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE) != 0){
        fprintf(stderr,"mem_commit 0x%08x+%u basarisiz\n", addr, size); exit(1);
    }
    for (uint64_t a2 = lo; a2 < hi; a2 += 0x4000ull){
        uint32_t pg = (uint32_t)(a2 >> 14);
        g_cbits[pg>>3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (pg&7));
    }
    g_committed += hi - lo;
    /* WATCHADDR=<adres>: o adres commit edilir edilmez watchpoint kur.
     * Boylece ilk yazan bile yakalanir. */
    { static int wa_done = 0;
      const char *wa = getenv("WATCHADDR");
      if (wa && !wa_done){
          uint32_t t = (uint32_t)strtoul(wa, 0, 0);
          if ((uint64_t)t >= lo && (uint64_t)t < hi){ wa_done = 1; mprot_arm(t); }
      } }
}
uint64_t mem_committed(void){ return g_committed; }

/* Guest'in commit edilmemis bolgeye erisimini teshis et */
static volatile int g_in_handler = 0;
/* --- yazma yakalama: bir guest sayfasini salt-okunur yapip yazani bul ---
 * Watchpoint enstrumantasyonu olmadan "bu bellege kim yaziyor?" sorusunu
 * cevaplar: yazma SIGSEGV uretir, hatali host PC'den uretilmis fonksiyon
 * (dolayisiyla guest fonksiyonu) cozulur.                                */
uint8_t *g_mprot_page = 0;
static size_t g_mprot_sz = 0;
static int g_mprot_hits = 0;
static uint32_t g_mprot_target = 0;      /* ilgilendigimiz tam adres */
static volatile int g_mprot_found = 0;   /* hedefe yazan bulundu */
static int      g_mprot_persist = 0;     /* her karede yeniden kur */
/* dispatch.c saglar; tek basina linklenen test kosumlarinda zayif varsayilan */
__attribute__((weak)) uint32_t guest_fn_from_host(const void *pc){ (void)pc; return 0; }

/* Korunan sayfa 16 KB ve cok yogun: ilk yabanci yazma korumayi dusuruyor.
 * Ayri bir thread surekli yeniden kurar, boylece hedefe yazan yakalanir. */
static void *mprot_rearm_thread(void *a0){
    (void)a0;
    for (;;){
        /* g_mprot_page kurulu olsa bile yeniden koru: araya giren bir
         * mem_commit korumayi sessizce kaldirmis olabilir. */
        if (g_mprot_target && !g_mprot_found){
            size_t ps = (size_t)getpagesize();
            uint8_t *pg = (uint8_t*)((uintptr_t)(g_mem + g_mprot_target) & ~(uintptr_t)(ps-1));
            if (mprotect(pg, ps, PROT_READ) == 0){ g_mprot_page = pg; g_mprot_sz = ps; }
        }
        struct timespec ts = {0, 50 * 1000};    /* 50 us */
        nanosleep(&ts, 0);
    }
    return 0;
}

void mprot_arm(uint32_t guest_addr){
    /* Apple Silicon'da sayfa 16 KB; hizalama sistem degerinden alinmali. */
    size_t ps = (size_t)getpagesize();
    uint8_t *pg = (uint8_t*)((uintptr_t)(g_mem + guest_addr) & ~(uintptr_t)(ps - 1));
    if (mprotect(pg, ps, PROT_READ) != 0){
        fprintf(stderr,"mprot: kurulamadi (%s)\n", strerror(errno)); return;
    }
    g_mprot_page = pg; g_mprot_sz = ps; g_mprot_target = guest_addr;
    g_mprot_persist = getenv("MPROT_PERSIST") ? 1 : 0;
    if (getenv("MPROT_HARD")){
        static pthread_t th; static int started = 0;
        if (!started){ started = 1; pthread_create(&th, 0, mprot_rearm_thread, 0); }
    }
    fprintf(stderr,"mprot: guest 0x%08x sayfasi salt-okunur (yazani yakalamak icin)\n",
            guest_addr);
}

/* Kare basinda korumayi yeniden kur (tek seferlik yakalama yetmiyorsa). */
void mprot_rearm(void){
    if (!g_mprot_persist || g_mprot_page || !g_mprot_target) return;
    size_t ps = (size_t)getpagesize();
    uint8_t *pg = (uint8_t*)((uintptr_t)(g_mem + g_mprot_target) & ~(uintptr_t)(ps - 1));
    if (mprotect(pg, ps, PROT_READ) == 0){ g_mprot_page = pg; g_mprot_sz = ps; }
}

static void segv(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *uc){
    (void)sig;
    /* korunan sayfaya yazma mi? */
    if (g_mprot_page){
        uint8_t *fa = (uint8_t*)si->si_addr;
        if (fa >= g_mprot_page && fa < g_mprot_page + g_mprot_sz){
            void *pc = 0;
#if defined(__aarch64__)
            ucontext_t *u = (ucontext_t*)uc;
            if (u && u->uc_mcontext) pc = (void*)(uintptr_t)u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc;
#endif
            uint32_t gfn = pc ? guest_fn_from_host(pc) : 0;
            uint32_t ga = (uint32_t)(fa - g_mem);
            int interesting = !g_mprot_target ||
                (ga >= g_mprot_target && ga < g_mprot_target + 64u);
            if (getenv("MPROT_ANY")) interesting = 1;   /* mekanizma testi */
            if (interesting && g_mprot_hits < 12){
                g_mprot_hits++;
                fprintf(stderr,"mprot: HEDEFE YAZMA guest 0x%08x  guest fonksiyon=sub_%08x\n",
                        ga, gfn);
                if (g_mprot_hits >= 6) g_mprot_found = 1;
            }
            mprotect(g_mprot_page, g_mprot_sz, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE);
            g_mprot_page = 0;           /* tek seferlik */
            return;                      /* komut yeniden calissin */
        }
    }
    if (g_in_handler){ fprintf(stderr,"\n*** isleyici icinde ikinci hata - cikiliyor\n"); _exit(4); }
    g_in_handler = 1;
    /* Hataya neden olan GUEST FONKSIYONU: host PC'den cozulur.  Yigin izi
     * yalnizca cagiranlari verir; hata tam olarak nerede oldu, bu soyler. */
    { void *fpc = 0;
#if defined(__aarch64__)
      ucontext_t *u2 = (ucontext_t*)uc;
      if (u2 && u2->uc_mcontext) fpc = (void*)(uintptr_t)u2->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc;
#endif
      uint32_t ffn = fpc ? guest_fn_from_host(fpc) : 0;
      if (ffn) fprintf(stderr,"\n*** HATA GUEST FONKSIYONU: sub_%08x\n", ffn);
    }
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t*)si->si_addr;
    if (p >= g_mem && p < g_mem + GSZ)
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** GUEST BELLEK HATASI: guest adres 0x%08llx (haritalanmamis)\n",
                (unsigned long long)(p - g_mem));
    else
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** HOST SEGV: %p (guest alani disi - muhtemelen HOST YIGIN TASMASI:"
                       " guest kodunda sonsuz ozyineleme)\n", p);
    { extern uint32_t g_watch_prev_ip; extern uint64_t g_itrace_n;
      if (g_itrace_n) fprintf(stderr,"    HATAYA NEDEN OLAN GUEST KOMUTU: 0x%08x\n", g_watch_prev_ip); }
    if (g_cur_cpu){
        CPU *c = (CPU*)g_cur_cpu;
        fprintf(stderr,"    eax=%08x ecx=%08x edx=%08x ebx=%08x\n", c->eax,c->ecx,c->edx,c->ebx);
        fprintf(stderr,"    esp=%08x ebp=%08x esi=%08x edi=%08x  df=%u\n", c->esp,c->ebp,c->esi,c->edi,c->df);
        fprintf(stderr,"    fs_base=%08x tid=%u   [ebp+8]=%08x [ebp+4]=%08x\n",
                c->fs_base,
                (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x24u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24u) : 0u,
                mem_is_committed(c->ebp+8u) ? MR32(c->ebp+8u) : 0xDEADu,
                mem_is_committed(c->ebp+4u) ? MR32(c->ebp+4u) : 0xDEADu);
    }
    if (g_cur_cpu && g_backtrace_fn) g_backtrace_fn(g_cur_cpu, 12);
    if (g_itrace_dump_fn && getenv("ITRACE")) g_itrace_dump_fn(atoi(getenv("ITRACE")));
    if (g_report_fn) g_report_fn();
    _exit(3);
}
/* sigaltstack THREAD BASINA kurulur: her guest thread'i kendi sinyal
 * yiginini kurmali, yoksa yigin tasmasinda isleyici de coker.          */
void mem_altstack_install(void){
    size_t sz = (size_t)SIGSTKSZ * 8;
    void *p = malloc(sz);
    if (!p) return;
    stack_t ss; ss.ss_sp = p; ss.ss_size = sz; ss.ss_flags = 0;
    sigaltstack(&ss, 0);
}
void mem_fault_handler_install(void){
    mem_altstack_install();
    struct sigaction sa; memset(&sa,0,sizeof sa);
    sa.sa_sigaction = segv; sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_ONSTACK;
    sigaction(SIGSEGV,&sa,0); sigaction(SIGBUS,&sa,0);
}

int mem_load_pe(const char *path){
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if(!f){ perror(path); return -1; }
    fseek(f,0,SEEK_END); long sz=ftell(f); fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *buf = malloc(sz);
    if (fread(buf,1,sz,f)!=(size_t)sz){ fclose(f); free(buf); return -1; }
    fclose(f);
    uint32_t e_lfanew = *(uint32_t*)(buf+0x3c);
    uint8_t *nt = buf + e_lfanew;
    if (*(uint32_t*)nt != 0x00004550u){ fprintf(stderr,"PE imzasi yok\n"); free(buf); return -1; }
    uint16_t nsec  = *(uint16_t*)(nt+6);
    uint16_t optsz = *(uint16_t*)(nt+20);
    uint32_t base  = *(uint32_t*)(nt+24+28);
    uint32_t imgsz = *(uint32_t*)(nt+24+56);
    /* DataDirectory[2] = RESOURCE */
    { /* PE32: DataDirectory opsiyonel basligin 96. baytinda; RESOURCE = indeks 2 */
      uint32_t dd = 24 + 96 + 2*8;
      uint32_t rva = *(uint32_t*)(nt + dd);
      uint32_t sz  = *(uint32_t*)(nt + dd + 4);
      g_image_base = base; g_res_dir_va = rva ? base + rva : 0; g_res_dir_size = sz; }
    uint8_t *sh    = nt + 24 + optsz;
    mem_init();
    mem_commit(base, imgsz);                 /* tum image araligi */
    for (int i=0;i<nsec;i++){
        uint8_t *s = sh + i*40;
        char nm[9]={0}; memcpy(nm,s,8);
        uint32_t vsize=*(uint32_t*)(s+8), va=*(uint32_t*)(s+12);
        uint32_t rsize=*(uint32_t*)(s+16), roff=*(uint32_t*)(s+20);
        uint32_t n = rsize < vsize ? rsize : vsize;
        memcpy(g_mem + base + va, buf + roff, n);
        fprintf(stderr,"  yuklendi %-9s -> 0x%08x  %u bayt\n", nm[0]?nm:"<isimsiz>", base+va, n);
    }
    free(buf);
    fprintf(stderr,"  image 0x%08x .. 0x%08x   kaynak dizini 0x%08x (%u bayt)\n",
            base, base+imgsz, g_res_dir_va, g_res_dir_size);
    return 0;
}

```

`runtime/metal.m`:

```m
/* D3D9 -> Metal koprusu (1. asama: pencere + Clear/Present)
 *
 * macOS'ta pencere ANA thread'de olmali. Guest zaten ayri bir thread'de
 * calistigi icin uygun: ana thread NSApplication dongusunu surer, guest
 * thread'i cizim komutlarini kuyruga yazar.                              */
#import <Cocoa/Cocoa.h>
#import <QuartzCore/CAMetalLayer.h>

/* getenv() her cagrida ortam dizisini TARAR ve kilit alir.  Cizim basina
 * calisan yollarda (ornegin SetVertexShaderConstantF icindeki "PDLIST"
 * kontrolu &&-zincirinin ILK terimiydi) olculebilir maliyeti var:
 * profilde getenv+__findenv_locked konuk thread'in %3'unu yiyordu.
 * Ortam degiskenleri kosu boyunca degismez -> bir kez coz, sakla. */
#define ENVC(nm_) ({ static const char *_ev_; static int _ei_; \
                     if (!_ei_){ _ei_ = 1; _ev_ = getenv(nm_); } _ev_; })

#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include "enhance.h"
#include "perflog.h"
#include <stdatomic.h>

static NSWindow        *g_win;

static CAMetalLayer    *g_layer;

static id<MTLTexture>   g_capture;   /* kare yakalama icin okunabilir kopya */

/* --- kare dokumu: DUMPFRAME=100,300 ile secilen kareleri PNG yazar --------
 * Ekranda ne oldugunu tahmin etmek yerine dogrudan gorebilmek icin.        */
static int   g_dump_want[16];
static int   g_dump_n;
static char  g_dump_dir[512];

static void dump_init(void){
    const char *e = ENVC("DUMPFRAME");
    if (!e || !*e) return;
    const char *d = ENVC("DUMPDIR");
    snprintf(g_dump_dir, sizeof g_dump_dir, "%s", d && *d ? d : "/tmp");
    for (const char *p = e; *p && g_dump_n < 16; ){
        while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        g_dump_want[g_dump_n++] = atoi(p);
        while (*p && *p != ',') p++;
    }
}
static int dump_wanted(long f){
    for (int i = 0; i < g_dump_n; i++) if (g_dump_want[i] == (int)f) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static void dump_texture(id<MTLTexture> t, long frame){
    NSUInteger w = t.width, h = t.height, stride = w * 4;
    void *buf = malloc(stride * h);
    if (!buf) return;
    [t getBytes:buf bytesPerRow:stride fromRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0,0,w,h) mipmapLevel:0];
    CGColorSpaceRef cs = CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB();
    /* Metal BGRA8Unorm -> CG: 32-bit little endian + premultiplied first */
    CGContextRef cg = CGBitmapContextCreate(buf, w, h, 8, stride, cs,
        kCGImageAlphaNoneSkipFirst | kCGBitmapByteOrder32Little);
    if (cg){
        CGImageRef img = CGBitmapContextCreateImage(cg);
        char path[640];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/nfsu2_kare_%04ld.png", g_dump_dir, frame);
        CFStringRef sp = CFStringCreateWithCString(NULL, path, kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
        CFURLRef url = CFURLCreateWithFileSystemPath(NULL, sp, kCFURLPOSIXPathStyle, false);
        CGImageDestinationRef dst =
            CGImageDestinationCreateWithURL(url, CFSTR("public.png"), 1, NULL);
        if (dst){ CGImageDestinationAddImage(dst, img, NULL);
                  CGImageDestinationFinalize(dst); CFRelease(dst); }
        CFRelease(url); CFRelease(sp); CGImageRelease(img); CGContextRelease(cg);
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: kare %ld yazildi -> %s\n", frame, path);
    }
    CGColorSpaceRelease(cs); free(buf);
}
static id<MTLDevice>    g_dev;
static id<MTLCommandQueue> g_queue;

/* Guest thread'in yazdigi, ana thread'in okudugu kare durumu */
static _Atomic float    g_clear_r = 0.f, g_clear_g = 0.f, g_clear_b = 0.f;
static _Atomic int      g_frame_pending = 0;
/* Kim kimi bekliyor?  Kare suresi = konuk CPU + ana thread'in alma
 * gecikmesi + vsync.  Ucunu ayirmadan hangisini optimize edecegimizi
 * bilemeyiz. */
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_wait_present_ns = 0;  /* konuk: onceki kare alinsin diye */
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_wait_drawable_ns = 0; /* ana: nextDrawable (vsync) */
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_wait_frame_ns = 0;    /* ana: kare hazir olsun diye */

static _Atomic long     g_tex_created   = 0, g_tex_uploaded = 0;
static _Atomic int      g_should_quit   = 0;

/* --- fare durumu: on yuz fareyle geziliyor (DIMOUSESTATE2) --------------
 * DirectInput goreli hareket ister; mutlak konumu da GetCursorPos icin
 * saklıyoruz. */
static _Atomic int g_mouse_x = 640, g_mouse_y = 360;
/* --- sunum geometrisi --------------------------------------------------
 * Cizim yuzeyi PIKSEL, pencere icerigi NOKTA cinsindendir; Retina'da bu
 * ikisi 2 kat farklidir.  Ikisini birbirine esit saymak iki ayri hataya
 * yol aciyordu: (1) 1280x960'lik yuzey 2560x1836 piksellik alana
 * buyutulup her piksel yeniden orneklendigi icin goruntu bulaniklasiyor,
 * (2) fare noktalari piksel sanildigi icin imlec kayiyordu. */
static _Atomic int g_draw_w = 1280, g_draw_h = 720;   /* cizim  - piksel */
static _Atomic int g_cont_w = 1280, g_cont_h = 720;   /* icerik - nokta  */
/* Oyunun SANDIGI cozunurluk.  Retina olceginde cizim yuzeyinden kucuk
 * (oyun 1280x960 sanirken yuzey 2448x1836); imlec bu uzayda olmali. */
static _Atomic int g_game_w = 1280, g_game_h = 720;
/* --- tam ekran ----------------------------------------------------------
 * Tam ekranda cizim yuzeyi EKRANIN piksel boyutuna (ve oranina) cikar;
 * oyunun 4:3 istegi kirpma uzayinda Hor+ ile duzeltilir (res_pick/aspfix).
 * Gecis sirasinda boyut ancak oyunun Reset'iyle degisebildigi icin
 * com_request_reset() cihaz kaybi uretir.  g_fs_pw/ph: tam ekran icerik
 * alani (piksel), girildiginde AppKit'ten olculur. */
static _Atomic int g_fs = 0, g_fs_pw = 0, g_fs_ph = 0;
/* Arayuz (ortografik) HUDFIX ile merkeze gore aspfix kadar daraltiliyor;
 * fare de o alana eslenmeli.  x10000 tamsayi. */
static _Atomic int g_ui_asp = 10000;
void metal_set_ui_aspect(float a){
    if (!(a > 0.05f && a <= 1.0f)) a = 1.0f;
    atomic_store(&g_ui_asp, (int)lroundf(a * 10000.f));
}
void com_request_reset(void);
static _Atomic int g_mouse_dx = 0, g_mouse_dy = 0, g_mouse_dz = 0;
static _Atomic unsigned g_mouse_btn = 0;

void metal_mouse_add(int dx, int dy){                 /* sentetik hareket (test) */
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_mouse_dx, dx); atomic_fetch_add(&g_mouse_dy, dy); }
void metal_fill_mouse(unsigned char *dst, unsigned n){
    if (n < 20) return;
    int dx = atomic_exchange(&g_mouse_dx, 0);
    int dy = atomic_exchange(&g_mouse_dy, 0);
    int dz = atomic_exchange(&g_mouse_dz, 0);
    unsigned b = atomic_load(&g_mouse_btn);
    memcpy(dst + 0, &dx, 4);
    memcpy(dst + 4, &dy, 4);
    memcpy(dst + 8, &dz, 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) dst[12 + i] = (b >> i) & 1u ? 0x80 : 0x00;
}
void metal_get_cursor(int *x, int *y){
    /* MOUSEAT=<x>,<y>[@<kare>,<x>,<y>]: imleci oyun uzayinda sabitle (test) */
    { const char *e = ENVC("MOUSEAT");
      if (e && *e){ int ax = 0, ay = 0, f2 = 0, bx = 0, by = 0;
          int n2 = sscanf(e, "%d,%d@%d,%d,%d", &ax, &ay, &f2, &bx, &by);
          if (n2 == 5 && atomic_load(&g_frames_drawn) >= f2){ ax = bx; ay = by; }
          if (x) *x = ax; if (y) *y = ay; return; } }
    if (x) *x = atomic_load(&g_mouse_x);
    if (y) *y = atomic_load(&g_mouse_y);
}
/* Oyunun sandigi pencere boyutu (GetClientRect/GetWindowRect).  Oyun
 * GetCursorPos'u bu dikdortgene gore kendi arayuz uzayina olcekliyor;
 * sabit 1280x720 donulurken 1280x960'ta imlec dikeyde 1.33 kat asagi
 * kayiyordu (olculdu: MOUSEAT). */
void metal_game_size(unsigned *w, unsigned *h){
    if (w) *w = (unsigned)atomic_load(&g_game_w);
    if (h) *h = (unsigned)atomic_load(&g_game_h);
}
void metal_set_game_size(unsigned w, unsigned h){
    if (!w || !h || w > 8192u || h > 8192u) return;
    atomic_store(&g_game_w, (int)w); atomic_store(&g_game_h, (int)h);
}
/* Goruntunun pencerede kapladigi alan (nokta).  Icerige EN-BOY KORUNARAK
 * oturtuldugu icin (kCAGravityResizeAspect) tam ekranda kenarlarda siyah
 * bant olusur.  0 donerse geometri henuz bilinmiyor. */
static int shown_rect(double *ox, double *oy, double *vw, double *vh){
    double dw = atomic_load(&g_draw_w), dh = atomic_load(&g_draw_h);
    double cw = atomic_load(&g_cont_w), ch = atomic_load(&g_cont_h);
    if (dw < 1.0 || dh < 1.0 || cw < 1.0 || ch < 1.0) return 0;
    double k = fmin(cw / dw, ch / dh);           /* nokta / cizim pikseli */
    *vw = dw * k; *vh = dh * k;
    *ox = (cw - *vw) * 0.5; *oy = (ch - *vh) * 0.5;
    return 1;
}
/* Pencere noktasi -> OYUNUN cozunurluk uzayi (cizim yuzeyi degil: Retina
 * olceginde oyun 1280x960 sanirken yuzey 2448x1836).  Bandi hesaba katar;
 * Y ters cevrilir: AppKit alt-sol, oyun ust-sol. */
static void mouse_from_point(double px, double py, int *gx, int *gy){
    double ox, oy, vw, vh;
    double lw = atomic_load(&g_game_w), lh = atomic_load(&g_game_h);
    double ch = atomic_load(&g_cont_h);
    if (!shown_rect(&ox, &oy, &vw, &vh) || lw < 1.0 || lh < 1.0){
        *gx = (int)px; *gy = (int)py; return; }
    { double a = atomic_load(&g_ui_asp) / 10000.0;   /* arayuz ortada, daraltilmis */
      ox += vw * (1.0 - a) * 0.5; vw *= a; }
    double x = (px - ox) / vw * lw;
    double y = (ch - py - oy) / vh * lh;
    if (x < 0.0) x = 0.0; else if (x > lw - 1.0) x = lw - 1.0;
    if (y < 0.0) y = 0.0; else if (y > lh - 1.0) y = lh - 1.0;
    *gx = (int)x; *gy = (int)y;
}
/* DirectInput goreli hareketi.  Eskiden pencere NOKTASI = oyun pikseli
 * oldugu icin nokta deltasi oldugu gibi gidiyordu.  Pencere artik oyunun
 * cozunurlugunden bagimsiz boyutlandigi icin ayni hissi koruyacak sekilde
 * olcekliyoruz: goruntunun bir ucundan otekine gitmek yine oyun genisligi
 * kadar hareket uretir.  (Olceksiz halde NFSNATIVE=0'da pencere yarim
 * boyutta oldugu icin imlec yarim hizda kaliyordu.) */
static void mouse_delta_scale(double *sx, double *sy){
    double ox, oy, vw, vh;
    double lw = atomic_load(&g_game_w), lh = atomic_load(&g_game_h);
    *sx = *sy = 1.0;
    if (!shown_rect(&ox, &oy, &vw, &vh) || lw < 1.0 || lh < 1.0) return;
    vw *= atomic_load(&g_ui_asp) / 10000.0;
    *sx = lw / vw; *sy = lh / vh;
}

/* --- klavye durumu: DirectInput'un okuyacagi 256 baytlik tablo --- */
static _Atomic unsigned char g_keys[256];

/* macOS sanal tus kodu -> DirectInput DIK_* tarama kodu */
static unsigned char mac_to_dik(unsigned short kc){
    switch (kc){
    case 0x00: return 0x1E; /* A */   case 0x01: return 0x1F; /* S */
    case 0x02: return 0x20; /* D */   case 0x03: return 0x21; /* F */
    case 0x04: return 0x23; /* H */   case 0x05: return 0x22; /* G */
    case 0x06: return 0x2C; /* Z */   case 0x07: return 0x2D; /* X */
    case 0x08: return 0x2E; /* C */   case 0x09: return 0x2F; /* V */
    case 0x0B: return 0x30; /* B */   case 0x0C: return 0x10; /* Q */
    case 0x0D: return 0x11; /* W */   case 0x0E: return 0x12; /* E */
    case 0x0F: return 0x13; /* R */   case 0x10: return 0x15; /* Y */
    case 0x11: return 0x14; /* T */   case 0x1F: return 0x18; /* O */
    case 0x20: return 0x16; /* U */   case 0x22: return 0x17; /* I */
    case 0x23: return 0x19; /* P */   case 0x25: return 0x26; /* L */
    case 0x26: return 0x24; /* J */   case 0x28: return 0x25; /* K */
    case 0x2D: return 0x31; /* N */   case 0x2E: return 0x32; /* M */
    case 0x12: return 0x02; case 0x13: return 0x03; case 0x14: return 0x04;
    case 0x15: return 0x05; case 0x17: return 0x06; case 0x16: return 0x07;
    case 0x1A: return 0x08; case 0x1C: return 0x09; case 0x19: return 0x0A;
    case 0x1D: return 0x0B;                        /* 1..0 */
    case 0x24: return 0x1C; /* Return  -> DIK_RETURN */
    case 0x30: return 0x0F; /* Tab     */
    case 0x31: return 0x39; /* Space   */
    case 0x33: return 0x0E; /* Delete  -> BACK */
    case 0x35: return 0x01; /* Escape  */
    case 0x7B: return 0xCB; /* Left    */
    case 0x7C: return 0xCD; /* Right   */
    case 0x7D: return 0xD0; /* Down    */
    case 0x7E: return 0xC8; /* Up      */
    case 0x38: return 0x2A; /* Shift   */
    case 0x3B: return 0x1D; /* Control */
    default:   return 0;
    }
}
/* Guest tarafi: DirectInput klavye durumunu doldur */

/* ---------------- cizim komut kuyrugu ----------------
 * Guest thread cizimleri buraya biriktirir; ana thread Present'te encode eder. */
```
