```m
                              for (const char *q = dt; q && *q; ){
                                  while (*q==',' || *q==' ') q++;
                                  if (!*q) break;
                                  unsigned tn = (unsigned)strtoul(q, 0, 0);
                                  dump_one_texture(tn, fno_pre*1000 + tn);
                                  while (*q && *q != ',') q++; } }
                        }
                        (void)fno;
                    }
                }
                /* Kare hazir olana kadar UYU (yoklama degil).  4 ms'lik
                 * ust sinir yalnizca NSEvent kuyrugunu bosaltmak icin:
                 * kare gelince cond_signal aninda uyandiriyor. */
                { struct timespec ts, _f0, _f1; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&_f0);
                  clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
                  ts.tv_nsec += 4L * 1000 * 1000;
                  if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L){ ts.tv_sec++; ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L; }
                  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_qlock);
                  if (g_ready < 0) pthread_cond_timedwait(&g_rcond, &g_qlock, &ts);
                  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_qlock);
                  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&_f1);
                  atomic_fetch_add(&g_wait_frame_ns,
                    (unsigned long long)(_f1.tv_sec-_f0.tv_sec)*1000000000ull
                    + (unsigned long long)_f1.tv_nsec - (unsigned long long)_f0.tv_nsec); }
            }
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: bos kare atlandi = %ld\n", g_skip_empty);
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: tampon halkasi: %lu karede onceki kare hala GPU'daydi "
                "(tek tamponla ezilirdi), %lu kez bos takim beklendi (toplam %.1f ms)\n",
                atomic_load(&g_fb_overlap), atomic_load(&g_fb_wait),
                (double)atomic_load(&g_fb_wait_ns) / 1e6);
        { NSUInteger v = 0, r = 0, k = 0;
          for (int i = 0; i < NFB; i++){ v += g_fb_vb[i].length; r += g_fb_rvb[i].length; k += g_fb_kb[i].length; }
          fprintf(stderr, "metal: tampon halkasi boyu (%d takim toplami): kose %.1f MB + ham kose %.1f MB + sabit %.1f MB, %lu kez buyudu\n",
                  NFB, v / 1048576.0, r / 1048576.0, k / 1048576.0, atomic_load(&g_fb_grow)); }
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: kose/indis havuzu: %.1f MB (dolu %.1f MB), %lu yansi canli, %lu kuruldu (%.1f MB kopya), %lu dustu, tablo dolu %lu\n",
                g_pool ? g_pool.length / 1048576.0 : 0.0, g_pool_top / 1048576.0, g_mir_live, g_mir_build,
                g_mir_bytes / 1048576.0, g_mir_drop, g_mir_full);
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: komut tamponu hatasi: %lu kare\n", atomic_load(&g_cb_err));
        { unsigned long n = atomic_load(&g_enc_late);
          fprintf(stderr, "metal: kodlama 60 ms'yi asti (eskiden kodlanan tampona takas olurdu): %lu kez", n);
          for (unsigned long q = 0; q < n && q < 8; q++) fprintf(stderr, "%s%ld", q ? "," : "  kareler: ", g_enc_late_f[q]);
          fprintf(stderr, "\n"); }
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: Reset sonrasi birakilan render hedefi: %lu (sonradan kullanilan: doku %lu, hedef %lu)\n",
                g_rt_freed, g_freed_use_smp, g_freed_use_tgt);
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: Z yuzeyi: %llu gecis Z'siz, %llu gecis boyut uyumsuz (karalama)\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_z_null, (unsigned long long)g_z_mismatch);
        fprintf(stderr, "metal: pencere kapandi (%ld kare cizildi)\n",
                atomic_load(&g_frames_drawn));
    }
}

void metal_budget_report(void){

    fprintf(stderr, "[HD] yol bulanikligi: %llu cizim, %llu mip uretimi\n",

            "%llu saklanmadi, %llu kez temizlemeden yukleme istendi ama ornekler kayipti (0 olmali)\n",

            atomic_load(&g_hd_mszst), atomic_load(&g_hd_mszskip), atomic_load(&g_hd_mszlost));

            (double)atomic_load(&g_pass_n)/(double)fr,
            (double)atomic_load(&g_draw_n)/(double)fr);
```

`runtime/overrides.c`:

```c
/* Lift edilmis fonksiyonlarin runtime sarmalayicilari.
 *
 * D3DX efekt parametre agaci CEVRIMLI ayristiriliyor (dugum 0 -> 6 -> 4..8 -> 6)
 * ve dugum dizisi kapasitesinin (8) bir fazlasi (indeks 8) isteniyor.
 * Kok neden hala acik (bkz. PROJECT.md). Burada iki koruma var:
 *   1) dizi sinirlari: kapasiteyi asan indekste guvenle don
 *   2) ziyaret kumesi: bir ust-seviye yuruyuste her dugum en fazla bir kez
 * Boylece yuruyus sonlanir ve oyun ilerleyebilir.                         */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "enhance.h"

void guest_backtrace(CPU*,int);

uint64_t g_cycle_break = 0, g_oob_node = 0, g_depth_guard = 0;
static uint64_t guard_total = 0, guard_cap = 0;
static CPU *g_guard_cpu = 0;

#define HEAP_LO 0x10000000u
#define HEAP_HI 0x2F000000u

/* Bir guest adresini iceren heap blogunu bul (baslik: +0 boyut, +4 imza) */
static int block_of(uint32_t addr, uint32_t *ubeg, uint32_t *uend){
    if (addr < HEAP_LO || addr >= HEAP_HI) return 0;
    for (uint32_t p = (addr & ~15u); p >= HEAP_LO; p -= 16u){
        if (!mem_is_committed(p+4)) return 0;
        if (MR32(p+4) == 0xA110C8EDu){
            uint32_t sz = MR32(p), beg = p + 16u, end = beg + sz;
            if (addr >= beg && addr < end){ *ubeg = beg; *uend = end; return 1; }
            return 0;
        }
        if (p < 16u) break;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void guard_hit(void){
    if (!guard_cap){ const char *e = getenv("GUARD_CAP");
                     guard_cap = e ? (uint64_t)atoll(e) : 2000000ull; }
    if (guard_total == 5000 && g_guard_cpu && getenv("GUARD_BT")){
        fprintf(stderr,"\n=== 5000. koruma isabetinde cagri zinciri ===\n");
        guest_backtrace(g_guard_cpu, 14);
    }
    if (++guard_total > guard_cap){
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** KORUMA TAVANI (%llu) - efekt sistemi ilerleyemiyor.\n",
                (unsigned long long)guard_cap);
        { extern uint32_t g_watch_addr; extern void watch_dump(const char*,int);
          if (g_watch_addr) watch_dump("koruma tavani", 20); }
        { extern void (*g_report_fn)(void); if (g_report_fn) g_report_fn(); }
        _exit(6);
    }
}

/* --- ortak: dugum dizisi sinir + ziyaret kontrolu -------------------- */
typedef struct { uint64_t bits[8]; uint32_t tab; } VisSet;   /* 512 dugum */

/* Agac korumasi ARTIK VARSAYILAN OLARAK KAPALI.
 * Cevrimli ayristirma aslinda CPU emulasyonu hatalarindan kaynaklaniyordu
 * (x87 yuvarlamasi, SSE genisligi, adc/sbb tasimasi...).  Onlar duzeldikten
 * sonra yuruyus kendiliginden sonlaniyor; koruma yalnizca GUARD_ON=1 ile
 * acilir ve o zaman gecerli dugumleri de kesip agaci bozar.              */
static int g_guard_off = -1;
static int guard_off(void){
    if (g_guard_off < 0) g_guard_off = getenv("GUARD_ON") ? 0 : 1;
    return g_guard_off;
}

static int node_guard(CPU *c, uint32_t a1, int depth, VisSet *vs){
    if (guard_off()) return 0;
    uint32_t tab = c->ecx + 0x2cu;
    if (!mem_is_committed(tab)) return 0;
    uint32_t arr = MR32(tab), beg, end;
    if (block_of(arr, &beg, &end)){
        uint32_t cap = (end - arr) / 0x64u;
        if (a1 >= cap){ g_oob_node++; guard_hit(); return 1; }
    }
    if (depth == 0){                       /* ust-seviye: kumeyi sifirla */
        for (int i=0;i<8;i++) vs->bits[i]=0;
        vs->tab = arr;
    }
    if (arr == vs->tab && a1 < 512u){
        uint64_t *w = &vs->bits[a1 >> 6]; uint64_t b = 1ull << (a1 & 63);
        if (*w & b){ g_cycle_break++; guard_hit(); return 1; }
        *w |= b;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* --- sub_0066aa3f(a1, a2) : asil agac yuruyucusu, ret 8, HRESULT ----- */
void sub_0066aa3f_orig(CPU *c);
static _Thread_local int d_aa3f = 0;
static _Thread_local VisSet vs_aa3f;

/* Efekt parametre agacinin dugum dizisini dok (tani).
 * Dugum: 0x64 bayt.  +0x04 dizi tabani, +0x18/+0x1a alt dugum indeksleri
 * (0xFFFF = yok), +0x58 tur etiketi.                                     */
static void dump_nodes(CPU *c){
    uint32_t tab = c->ecx + 0x2cu;
    if (!mem_is_committed(tab)) return;
    uint32_t arr = MR32(tab), beg, end;
    if (!block_of(arr, &beg, &end)){ fprintf(stderr,"  [agac] dizi 0x%08x blok disi\n", arr); return; }
    uint32_t cap = (end - arr) / 0x64u;
    fprintf(stderr,"  [agac] dizi=0x%08x kapasite=%u (blok %08x..%08x)\n", arr, cap, beg, end);
    /* ham dokum: dugum yapisini anlamak icin */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cap && i < 4; i++){
        uint32_t n = arr + i*0x64u;
        if (!mem_is_committed(n+0x63)) break;
        fprintf(stderr,"    dugum[%u] ham @%08x:\n", i, n);
        for (int rw = 0; rw < 0x64; rw += 16){
            fprintf(stderr,"      +%02x:", rw);
            for (int q = 0; q < 16 && rw+q < 0x64; q++)
                fprintf(stderr," %02x", MR8(n+rw+q));
            fprintf(stderr,"   ");
            for (int q = 0; q < 16 && rw+q < 0x64; q++){
                uint8_t ch = MR8(n+rw+q);
                fputc((ch>=32&&ch<127)?ch:'.', stderr);
            }
            fprintf(stderr,"\n");
        }
        /* +0 ve +4 nereyi gosteriyor? */
        for (int f = 0; f <= 4; f += 4){
            uint32_t ptr = MR32(n+f);
            if (ptr && mem_is_committed(ptr+31)){
                fprintf(stderr,"      [+%d]->%08x:", f, ptr);
                for (int q=0;q<24;q++) fprintf(stderr," %02x", MR8(ptr+q));
                fprintf(stderr,"   ");
                for (int q=0;q<24;q++){ uint8_t ch=MR8(ptr+q);
                    fputc((ch>=32&&ch<127)?ch:'.', stderr); }
                fprintf(stderr,"\n");
            }
        }
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cap && i < 64; i++){
        uint32_t n = arr + i*0x64u;
        if (!mem_is_committed(n+0x5C)) break;
        uint32_t nameptr = MR32(n);
        char nm[40]; nm[0]=0;
        if (nameptr && mem_is_committed(nameptr)){
            for (int k=0;k<32;k++){ uint8_t ch=MR8(nameptr+k);
                if (!ch || ch<32 || ch>126){ nm[k]=0; break; } nm[k]=(char)ch; nm[k+1]=0; }
        }
        fprintf(stderr,"    [%2u] ad=0x%08x '%s' taban=0x%08x alt18=%5u alt1a=%5u tur=0x%08x\n",
                i, nameptr, nm, MR32(n+4),
                MR16(n+0x18), MR16(n+0x1a), MR32(n+0x58));
    }
}

/* Ozyineleme zinciri: (dugum indeksi, dizi tabani) ciftleri.
 * Cevrimi somut gormek icin derinlik esigi asilinca dokulur. */
static _Thread_local uint32_t chain_idx[160], chain_arr[160];
static int chain_dumped = 0;

void sub_0066aa3f(CPU *c){
    uint32_t a1 = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    g_guard_cpu = c;
    { static int dumped = 0;
      if (!dumped && getenv("TREEDUMP")){ dumped = 1; dump_nodes(c); } }
    if (getenv("WALKLOG")){
        static int nlog = 0;
        if (nlog < 60){ nlog++;
            uint32_t tabp = c->ecx + 0x2cu;
            uint32_t arr = mem_is_committed(tabp) ? MR32(tabp) : 0;
            uint32_t esi = arr + a1*0x64u;
            if (mem_is_committed(esi+0x35))
                fprintf(stderr,"    [yuru] derinlik=%2d a1=%-5u dugum=%08x "
                        "alt18=%5u alt1a=%5u sayi=%u taban=%08x\n",
                        d_aa3f, a1, esi, MR16(esi+0x18), MR16(esi+0x1a),
                        MR16(esi+0x34), MR32(esi+4));
            else
                fprintf(stderr,"    [yuru] derinlik=%2d a1=%-5u dugum=%08x ERISILEMEZ\n",
                        d_aa3f, a1, esi);
        }
    }
    if (d_aa3f < 160){ chain_idx[d_aa3f] = a1;
        chain_arr[d_aa3f] = mem_is_committed(c->ecx+0x2c) ? MR32(c->ecx+0x2c) : 0; }
    if (!chain_dumped && d_aa3f >= 40 && getenv("CHAIN")){
        chain_dumped = 1;
        fprintf(stderr,"  [zincir] ozyineleme derinligi %d, (indeks@dizi):\n", d_aa3f);
        for (int q = 0; q <= d_aa3f && q < 160; q++){
            fprintf(stderr," %u@%08x", chain_idx[q], chain_arr[q]);
            if ((q % 8) == 7) fprintf(stderr,"\n");
        }
        fprintf(stderr,"\n");
    }
    if (node_guard(c, a1, d_aa3f, &vs_aa3f)){
        POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 8u; c->eax = 0;   /* S_OK */
        return;
    }
    if (d_aa3f >= 128){ g_depth_guard++; guard_hit();
        POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 8u; c->eax = 0; return; }
    d_aa3f++;
    sub_0066aa3f_orig(c);
    d_aa3f--;
}

/* --- sub_0065ae35(a1, a2, a3) : yardimci yuruyucu, ret 0xc ---------- */
void sub_0065ae35_orig(CPU *c);
static _Thread_local int d_ae35 = 0;
static _Thread_local VisSet vs_ae35;

void sub_0065ae35(CPU *c){
    uint32_t a1 = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    g_guard_cpu = c;
    if (node_guard(c, a1, d_ae35, &vs_ae35)){
        POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 12u; c->eax = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (d_ae35 >= 128){ g_depth_guard++; guard_hit();
        POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 12u; c->eax = 0; return; }
    d_ae35++;
    sub_0065ae35_orig(c);
    d_ae35--;
}

/* --- sub_006e2be0(list, b, c): listeyi gezip her ogeyi serbest birakir ---
 * Ilk arguman NULL gelebiliyor (Windows'ta olmayan bir durum). Orijinal kod
 * null kontrolu yapmadigi icin coker; guvenle donuyoruz.                 */
void sub_006e2be0(CPU *c);                     /* uretilen orijinal */
uint64_t g_null_list = 0, g_e2be0_calls = 0;
static void wrap_6e2be0(CPU *c){
    uint32_t a1 = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    g_e2be0_calls++;
    if (a1 == 0 || !mem_is_committed(a1 + 4u)){
        g_null_list++;
        POP32(c->eip);                          /* ret (cdecl: cagiran temizler) */
        return;
    }
    sub_006e2be0(c);
}


/* --- sub_006623ea: efekt parametre degerini shader sabit blokuna kopyalar ---
 * __thiscall, 7 yigin argumani.  Yiginin duzeni (cagiran 0x00669710):
 *   [esp+04] a1  -> *(a1)=kaynak veri, *(a1+4)=tur tanimlayicisi
 *   [esp+08] a2  = hedef (sabit blogu icinde)
 *   [esp+0c] a3  = D3DXPARAMETER_TYPE (1=BOOL 2=INT 3=FLOAT)
 *   [esp+10] a4  = satir sayisi
 *   [esp+14] a5  = sutun sayisi
 * WVP matrisinin neden eksik yazildigini gormek icin girdi/cikti dokulur. */
void sub_006623ea_orig(CPU *c);
uint64_t g_copy_calls = 0;

void sub_006623ea(CPU *c){
    uint32_t a1 = MR32(c->esp + 4u),  dst = MR32(c->esp + 8u);
    uint32_t ty = MR32(c->esp + 12u), rows = MR32(c->esp + 16u);
    uint32_t cols = MR32(c->esp + 20u);
    uint32_t src = (a1 && mem_is_committed(a1+7)) ? MR32(a1) : 0;
    uint32_t td  = (a1 && mem_is_committed(a1+7)) ? MR32(a1+4) : 0;
    uint32_t cls = (td && mem_is_committed(td+7)) ? MR32(td+4) : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    g_copy_calls++;
    /* FE efektinin sabit blogu 80 bayt; yalnizca ona yazan kopyalari izle */
    static int n = 0;
    int is80 = 0;
    { uint32_t b1, e1;
      if (block_of(dst, &b1, &e1) && (e1 - b1) == 80u) is80 = 1; }
    int show = 0;   /* kopya SONRASI karar verilecek */
    (void)show;
    /* MPROTSRC=1: FE efektinin WVP deger alanina KIM yaziyor?
     * Kopya kaynagi belli olunca sayfayi salt-okunur yapip yakalariz. */
    if (is80 && src && getenv("MPROTSRC")){
        static int armed3 = 0;
        uint32_t b2, e2;
        if (!armed3 && block_of(dst, &b2, &e2) && dst == b2){
            armed3 = 1;
            void mprot_arm(uint32_t);
            fprintf(stderr,"  [kopya] WVP kaynagi %08x -- sayfa korumaya alindi\n", src);
            mprot_arm(src);
        }
    }
    sub_006623ea_orig(c);
    /* Yalnizca 80 baytlik FE blokuna ANLAMLI bir deger yazan kopyalari dok */
    if (getenv("COPYLOG") && is80 && n < 14 && dst && mem_is_committed(dst+63)){
        int meaningful = 0;
        for (int q=0;q<16;q++){
            float fv = MRF32(dst + 4*q);
            if (fv != 0.f && fabsf(fv) > 1e-6f && fabsf(fv) < 1e6f) meaningful = 1;
        }
        if (meaningful){ n++;
            uint32_t bb, ee; block_of(dst, &bb, &ee);
            fprintf(stderr,"  [kopya %llu] a2=%u sinif=%d kaynak=%08x hedef=%08x"
                    " (blok %08x ofset %d)\n",
                    (unsigned long long)g_copy_calls, ty, (int)cls, src, dst,
                    bb, (int)(dst - bb));
            if (src && mem_is_committed(src+63)){
                fprintf(stderr,"      kaynak:");
                for (int r2=0;r2<4;r2++)
                    fprintf(stderr," [%.4g %.4g %.4g %.4g]", MRF32(src+r2*16),
                            MRF32(src+r2*16+4), MRF32(src+r2*16+8), MRF32(src+r2*16+12));
                fprintf(stderr,"\n");
            }
            fprintf(stderr,"      hedef :");
            for (int r2=0;r2<4;r2++)
                fprintf(stderr," [%.4g %.4g %.4g %.4g]", MRF32(dst+r2*16),
                        MRF32(dst+r2*16+4), MRF32(dst+r2*16+8), MRF32(dst+r2*16+12));
            fprintf(stderr,"\n");
            guest_backtrace(c, 8);
        }
    }
}

void overrides_install(void){
    void dispatch_patch(uint32_t, void(*)(CPU*));
    dispatch_patch(0x006e2be0u, wrap_6e2be0);
}

void overrides_report(void){
    if (g_e2be0_calls)
        fprintf(stderr,"  sub_006e2be0: %llu cagri, %llu NULL liste atlandi\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_e2be0_calls,(unsigned long long)g_null_list);
    if (g_cycle_break || g_oob_node || g_depth_guard)
        fprintf(stderr,"  agac korumasi: cevrim %llu, sinir disi %llu, derinlik %llu\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_cycle_break,
                (unsigned long long)g_oob_node,
                (unsigned long long)g_depth_guard);
}

/* --- sub_0050d510: oyunun HATA AYIKLAMA printf'i -----------------------
 * Perakende derlemede "xor eax,eax; ret" olarak bosaltilmis, yani motorun
 * tum ic gunlugu cope gidiyor: ön yüz paket gecisleri, mesaj kuyrugu,
 * "Joy Event" giris dagitimi...  Burada yakalayip yazdiriyoruz.
 * cdecl, degisken argumanli: bicim = [esp+4], argumanlar [esp+8]'den.  */
uint32_t g_fe_mgr = 0;   /* ön yüz paket yoneticisi (yakalanan) */
void sub_0050d510_orig(CPU *c);

static const char *gstr(uint32_t p){
    if (!p || !mem_is_committed(p)) return "(null)";
    return (const char *)(g_mem + p);
}
void sub_0050d510(CPU *c){
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0){ const char *e = getenv("GAMELOG"); on = (e && *e && *e != '0'); }
    if (on){
        uint32_t fp = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
        if (fp && mem_is_committed(fp)){
            const char *f = (const char *)(g_mem + fp);
            uint32_t ap = c->esp + 8u;          /* sonraki varargs slotu */
            char out[1024]; size_t o = 0;
            for (const char *q = f; *q && o < sizeof out - 8; q++){
                if (*q != '%'){ out[o++] = *q; continue; }
                q++;
                if (*q == '%'){ out[o++] = '%'; continue; }
                /* bayrak/genislik/kesinlik alanlarini atla */
                while (*q && (strchr("-+ #0", *q) || (*q >= '0' && *q <= '9') ||
                              *q == '.' || *q == 'l' || *q == 'h')) q++;
                char cv = *q;
                if (!cv) break;
                char tmp[256];
                if (cv == 's'){
                    uint32_t sp = mem_is_committed(ap+3) ? MR32(ap) : 0; ap += 4;
                    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", gstr(sp));
                } else if (cv == 'c'){
                    uint32_t v = mem_is_committed(ap+3) ? MR32(ap) : 0; ap += 4;
                    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%c", (int)(v & 0xFFu));
                } else if (cv == 'f' || cv == 'g' || cv == 'e'){
                    uint64_t lo = mem_is_committed(ap+7) ? ((uint64_t)MR32(ap) |
                                  ((uint64_t)MR32(ap+4) << 32)) : 0; ap += 8;
                    double dv; memcpy(&dv, &lo, 8);
                    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%g", dv);
                } else {
                    uint32_t v = mem_is_committed(ap+3) ? MR32(ap) : 0; ap += 4;
                    if (cv == 'x') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%x", v);
                    else if (cv == 'X') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%X", v);
                    else if (cv == 'u') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%u", v);
                    else if (cv == 'p') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%08x", v);
                    else snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%d", (int)v);
                }
                for (const char *t2 = tmp; *t2 && o < sizeof out - 2; t2++) out[o++] = *t2;
            }
            out[o] = 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "  [oyun] %s%s", out,
                    (o && out[o-1] == '\n') ? "" : "\n");
            /* SwitchFEngPackages icinde ebx = ön yüz paket yoneticisi
             * ("this").  printf tam o noktada cagriliyor, yani isaretciyi
             * burada bedavaya yakaliyoruz; gecisi zorlamak icin gerekli. */
            if (!strncmp(out, "SwitchFEngPackages", 18)) g_fe_mgr = c->ebx;
            /* Ekran gecisini KIM tetikliyor?  Basarili bir gecisin cagri
             * zinciri, splash'te neyin eksik oldugunu gosterir. */
            { const char *bt = getenv("GAMELOG_BT");
              static int nbt = 0;
              if (bt && *bt && nbt < 4 && !strncmp(out, bt, strlen(bt))){
                  nbt++; guest_backtrace(c, 16); } }
        }
    }
    sub_0050d510_orig(c);
}


/* --- Yagmuru zorla (FORCERAIN) --------------------------------------------
 * Oyun havayi yaris basinda rastgele seciyor (olculdu: ~8 kosuda 1 yagmur);
 * yagmura ozgu bir sorunu ayiklamak icin tekrar uretilebilir yagmur gerek.
 * Rain::Update = sub_0061f130 (__thiscall, ecx = eView+0x64'teki Rain*):
 *   Rain+0x5094 hedef yagis (0..1), +0x1f0 o anki siddet (hedefe kayar),
 *   +0x509c bulut siddeti.  Hedef her karede sub_0061e390 ile hesaplanir
 *   ("Rain" bolge nesnesi 0x8a1f28 etkinse); etkin degilse eski hedef kalir.
 * FORCERAIN=1 hedefi 1.0 yapar, FORCERAIN=2 hedefi 0 yapar (hep kuru).
 * FORCERAIN=3 yagmursuz KAPALI gokyuzu (+0x509c ve hedefi +0x5098 = 0;
 * 1.0 = acik gokyuzu), FORCERAIN=4 kapali gokyuzu + yagmur.
 * Degisken verilmezse davranis AYNEN oyununki.  Iki build'de de var.      */
static int force_rain(void){
    static int fr = -1;
    if (fr < 0){ const char *e = getenv("FORCERAIN"); fr = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
    return fr;
}
void sub_0061e390_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0061e390(CPU *c){
    sub_0061e390_orig(c);
    int fr = force_rain();
    if (fr == 1 || fr == 4) ST(0) = 1.0; else if (fr == 2 || fr == 3) ST(0) = 0.0;
}
void sub_0061f130_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0061f130(CPU *c){
    uint32_t rain = c->ecx;
    int fr = force_rain();
    if (fr && rain && mem_is_committed(rain + 0x50a3u))
        MRF32(rain + 0x5094u) = (fr == 1 || fr == 4) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    sub_0061f130_orig(c);
    if (fr >= 3 && rain && mem_is_committed(rain + 0x50a3u)){
        MRF32(rain + 0x5098u) = 0.0f; MRF32(rain + 0x509cu) = 0.0f; }
}

/* --- Gokyuzu gecisini zorla (FORCETOD) ------------------------------------
 * sub_0060fab0 = gunun-saati / gokyuzu durum makinesi (oyun durumu 6 iken
 * her kare).  Dunya sayaci 0x7fb718 (sn) uzerinden 300 sn'lik dongu:
 * (int)sayac % 300 == 60 ve durum 0x8a1c8c == 0 ise durum 2'ye gecer ve
 * gokyuzu gecisi (skymorph.efx: gun batimi -> gece) baslar.  Test kosulari
 * ~60 sn surdugu icin bu gecise ancak ara sira denk geliniyordu (olculdu:
 * ~8 kosuda 1) ve HD build o durumda cok yavasliyordu.
 * FORCETOD=1 gecisi ilk firsatta tetikler; FORCETOD=<kare sayisi> o kadar
 * cagridan sonra.  Verilmezse davranis AYNEN oyununki.  Iki build'de var. */
void sub_0060fab0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0060fab0(CPU *c){
    static int ft = -1, done = 0; static long calls = 0;
    if (ft < 0){ const char *e = getenv("FORCETOD"); ft = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
    if (ft > 0 && !done && MR32(0x8654a4u) == 6u && MR32(0x8a1c78u) != 0u && ++calls >= ft &&
        MR32(0x8a1c8cu) == 0u){
        static int st = -1;
        if (st < 0){ const char *e = getenv("FORCETOD_STATE"); st = e ? atoi(e) : 2; if (st < 1 || st > 4) st = 2; }
        MR32(0x8a1c8cu) = (uint32_t)st; done = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[FORCETOD] gokyuzu durumu %d'ye zorlandi (cagri %ld)\n", st, calls);
    }
    sub_0060fab0_orig(c);
}

/* --- sub_005c7ed0: gorunum basina kamera/projeksiyon kurulumu ------------
 * __thiscall(ecx = matris yapisi, [esp+4] = eView*), ret 0x10.
 *   eView+0x04 = gorunum kimligi (1 ana, 3 dikiz aynasi, 4 yol yansimasi)
 *   eView+0x40 = Camera*  (CameraParams: +0xbc NearZ, +0xc0 FarZ, +0xc4 FOV)
 *   ecx+0x00 gorunum matrisi, +0x40 projeksiyon, +0x80 ikisinin carpimi
 * Oyun SetTransform'a yalnizca birim matris veriyor; kamera ancak buradan
 * okunabiliyor.  Davranis DEGISMEZ: yalnizca adres yakalanir ve (HD build'de)
 * ana gorunumun matrisleri kareye islenir.  Orijinal build'de enh_view_setup
 * bos bir satir-ici fonksiyon.                                             */
void sub_005c7ed0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_005c7ed0(CPU *c){
    uint32_t plat = c->ecx, view = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    sub_005c7ed0_orig(c);
    if (view && plat && mem_is_committed(view + 0x43u) && mem_is_committed(plat + 0xbfu))
        enh_view_setup(MR32(view + 4u), (const float *)(g_mem + plat),
                       MR32(view + 0x40u));
}
```

`runtime/perflog.c`:

```c
/* PERFLOG=<dizin>: GERCEK oyun oturumu kaydi (kullanici oynarken).
 *
 * Otomatik test kosulari (AUTOSEQ yarisi) birebir karsilastirma icin; bu kayit
 * ise kullanicinin kendi oynadigi oturumda (hizli surus, efektler, kaza, menu)
 * yukun NEREDE ve NE ZAMAN olustugunu gormek icin.  Dusuk yuklu:
 *
 *   konuk.csv   konuk kare basina: duvar/CPU suresi, kare sinirlayici uykusu
 *               (bos pay), Present beklemesi, COM/Win32 cagrilari, derleme ve
 *               doku olaylari
 *   render.csv  ana thread kare basina: kare araligi, nextDrawable beklemesi,
 *               kodlama suresi, cizim/kose sayisi
 *   gpu.csv     kare basina GPU suresi (tamamlanma isleyicisinden)
 *   saniye.csv  saniyede bir: surec enerjisi (CPU, P cekirdek), komut/cevrim,
 *               GPU kullanimi, termal durum
 *   thread.csv  saniyede bir: thread basina kullanici/sistem suresi (birikimli)
 *   ornek.bin   1 ms'de bir konuk thread'i, 4 ms'de bir ana thread'i: PC + cerceve
 *               zinciri (thread_suspend -> durum -> resume; kilit alinmaz)
 *   sembol.txt  ana ikili disindaki PC'lerin dladdr adlari (sistem kutuphaneleri)
 *   ekran/      2 sn'de bir kucuk ekran goruntusu (metal.m, arka planda yazilir)
 *   meta.txt    ikili yolu, kaydirma, saat esleme (powermetrics icin)
 *
 * Cozumleme: tools/oturum_analiz.py <dizin>.  Kayit betigi: tools/oturum.sh. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <pthread/qos.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/event.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>
#include <libproc.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#include "perflog.h"

int g_perflog = 0;
_Atomic int g_pl_thumb_req = 0;
char g_pl_dir[900];

static uint64_t t0_us;
static FILE *f_konuk, *f_render, *f_gpu, *f_sec, *f_thr, *f_samp;
static pthread_mutex_t g_gpu_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static _Atomic uint64_t ev_n[PL_NEV], ev_ns[PL_NEV], ev_b[PL_NEV];

static uint64_t mono_us(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
}
uint64_t perflog_now_us(void){ return mono_us() - t0_us; }

void perflog_event(int k, uint64_t ns, uint64_t bytes){
    if (!g_perflog || k < 0 || k >= PL_NEV) return;
    atomic_fetch_add(&ev_n[k], 1ull);
    atomic_fetch_add(&ev_ns[k], ns);
    atomic_fetch_add(&ev_b[k], bytes);
}

/* ---- ornekleyici ---- */
typedef struct { mach_port_t port; uint64_t lo, hi; } PlThr;
static PlThr th_konuk, th_render;
static _Atomic uint32_t g_gframe;

static void thr_register(PlThr *t){
    pthread_t me = pthread_self();
    uint64_t hi = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pthread_get_stackaddr_np(me);
    uint64_t sz = (uint64_t)pthread_get_stacksize_np(me);
    t->lo = hi - sz; t->hi = hi;
    t->port = mach_thread_self();
}

#define PL_DEPTH 28
typedef struct { uint64_t t_us; uint32_t gframe; uint8_t role, n; uint16_t pad; } PlRec;

/* ana ikili disindaki PC'ler (sistem kutuphaneleri) icin kucuk tablo */
#define PL_SYS 4096
static uint64_t pl_sys[PL_SYS]; static int pl_sysn;
static uint64_t img_lo, img_hi;

static void sys_note(uint64_t pc){
    if (pc >= img_lo && pc < img_hi) return;
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)((pc >> 2) * 2654435761u) & (PL_SYS - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < PL_SYS; i++, h = (h + 1) & (PL_SYS - 1)){
        if (pl_sys[h] == pc) return;
        if (!pl_sys[h]){ if (pl_sysn < PL_SYS * 3 / 4){ pl_sys[h] = pc; pl_sysn++; } return; }
    }
}

static void pl_sample(PlThr *t, int role){
    uint64_t st[PL_DEPTH]; int n = 0;
    if (thread_suspend(t->port) != KERN_SUCCESS) return;
    arm_thread_state64_t s; mach_msg_type_number_t cnt = ARM_THREAD_STATE64_COUNT;
    if (thread_get_state(t->port, ARM_THREAD_STATE64, (thread_state_t)&s, &cnt) == KERN_SUCCESS){
        uint64_t pc = (uint64_t)arm_thread_state64_get_pc(s);
        uint64_t lr = (uint64_t)arm_thread_state64_get_lr(s);
        uint64_t fp = (uint64_t)arm_thread_state64_get_fp(s);
        st[n++] = pc; st[n++] = lr;
        /* askidayken yalnizca ham bellek okumasi: kilit/malloc YOK */
        while (n < PL_DEPTH && fp >= t->lo && fp + 16 <= t->hi && !(fp & 7)){
            uint64_t nfp = ((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)fp)[0], ret = ((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)fp)[1];
            if (!ret) break;
            st[n++] = ret;
            if (nfp <= fp) break;
            fp = nfp;
        }
    }
    thread_resume(t->port);
    if (!n) return;
    PlRec r = { perflog_now_us(), atomic_load(&g_gframe), (uint8_t)role, (uint8_t)n, 0 };
    fwrite(&r, sizeof r, 1, f_samp);
    fwrite(st, sizeof(uint64_t), (size_t)n, f_samp);
    sys_note(st[0]);
}

/* Diger tum thread'ler (Metal/sistem/ses/konuk yan thread'leri) 10 ms'de bir:
 * rol 2, gframe alani yerine thread kimligi (thread.csv ile eslesir).  Yigin
 * siniri bilinmedigi icin yalniz PC + LR (hangi cagrida/beklemede oldugu). */
static void pl_sample_others(void){
    thread_act_array_t list; mach_msg_type_number_t nl = 0;
    if (task_threads(mach_task_self(), &list, &nl) != KERN_SUCCESS) return;
    mach_port_t self = mach_thread_self();
    for (mach_msg_type_number_t i = 0; i < nl; i++){
        mach_port_t th = list[i];
        if (th != self && th != th_konuk.port && th != th_render.port){
            struct thread_identifier_info ii; mach_msg_type_number_t c2 = THREAD_IDENTIFIER_INFO_COUNT;
            uint64_t tid = 0;
            if (thread_info(th, THREAD_IDENTIFIER_INFO, (thread_info_t)&ii, &c2) == KERN_SUCCESS) tid = ii.thread_id;
            uint64_t st[2]; int n = 0;
            if (thread_suspend(th) == KERN_SUCCESS){
                arm_thread_state64_t s; mach_msg_type_number_t cnt = ARM_THREAD_STATE64_COUNT;
                if (thread_get_state(th, ARM_THREAD_STATE64, (thread_state_t)&s, &cnt) == KERN_SUCCESS){
                    st[n++] = (uint64_t)arm_thread_state64_get_pc(s);
                    st[n++] = (uint64_t)arm_thread_state64_get_lr(s);
                }
                thread_resume(th);
            }
            if (n){
                PlRec r = { perflog_now_us(), (uint32_t)tid, 2, (uint8_t)n, 0 };
                fwrite(&r, sizeof r, 1, f_samp); fwrite(st, sizeof(uint64_t), (size_t)n, f_samp);
                sys_note(st[0]); sys_note(st[1]);
            }
        }
        mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(), th);
    }
    mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(), self);
    vm_deallocate(mach_task_self(), (vm_address_t)list, nl * sizeof(thread_act_t));
}

static void write_syms(void){
    char p[1024]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/sembol.txt", g_pl_dir);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "w"); if (!f) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < PL_SYS; i++){
        if (!pl_sys[i]) continue;
        Dl_info di;
        if (dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)pl_sys[i], &di) && di.dli_sname){
            const char *im = di.dli_fname ? strrchr(di.dli_fname, '/') : NULL;
            fprintf(f, "%llx %s %s\n", (unsigned long long)pl_sys[i], di.dli_sname, im ? im + 1 : "?");
        } else fprintf(f, "%llx ? ?\n", (unsigned long long)pl_sys[i]);
    }
    fclose(f);
}

/* ---- saniyelik ---- */
int metal_thermal_state(void);
static void pl_second(void){
    uint64_t t = perflog_now_us();
    struct rusage_info_v6 r; memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    proc_pid_rusage(getpid(), RUSAGE_INFO_V6, (rusage_info_t *)&r);
    struct task_power_info_v2 p; memset(&p, 0, sizeof p);
    mach_msg_type_number_t pn = TASK_POWER_INFO_V2_COUNT;
    task_info(mach_task_self(), TASK_POWER_INFO_V2, (task_info_t)&p, &pn);
    fprintf(f_sec, "%.3f,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%d,%llu\n", t / 1e3,
            (unsigned long long)r.ri_energy_nj, (unsigned long long)r.ri_penergy_nj,
            (unsigned long long)r.ri_instructions, (unsigned long long)r.ri_cycles,
            (unsigned long long)r.ri_pinstructions, (unsigned long long)r.ri_pcycles,
            (unsigned long long)r.ri_user_time, (unsigned long long)r.ri_system_time,
            (unsigned long long)r.ri_user_ptime, (unsigned long long)r.ri_system_ptime,
            (unsigned long long)p.gpu_energy.task_gpu_utilisation, metal_thermal_state(),
            (unsigned long long)r.ri_phys_footprint);
    thread_act_array_t list; mach_msg_type_number_t nl = 0;
    if (task_threads(mach_task_self(), &list, &nl) == KERN_SUCCESS){
        for (mach_msg_type_number_t i = 0; i < nl; i++){
            struct thread_extended_info xi; mach_msg_type_number_t c1 = THREAD_EXTENDED_INFO_COUNT;
            struct thread_identifier_info ii; mach_msg_type_number_t c2 = THREAD_IDENTIFIER_INFO_COUNT;
            if (thread_info(list[i], THREAD_EXTENDED_INFO, (thread_info_t)&xi, &c1) == KERN_SUCCESS &&
                thread_info(list[i], THREAD_IDENTIFIER_INFO, (thread_info_t)&ii, &c2) == KERN_SUCCESS){
                const char *rol = list[i] == th_konuk.port ? "KONUK" : list[i] == th_render.port ? "ANA" : "";
                for (char *q = xi.pth_name; *q; q++) if (*q == ',') *q = ';';
                fprintf(f_thr, "%.3f,%llu,%s,%s,%llu,%llu\n", t / 1e3, (unsigned long long)ii.thread_id,
                        rol, xi.pth_name, (unsigned long long)xi.pth_user_time,
                        (unsigned long long)xi.pth_system_time);
            }
            mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(), list[i]);
        }
        vm_deallocate(mach_task_self(), (vm_address_t)list, nl * sizeof(thread_act_t));
    }
    fflush(f_sec); fflush(f_thr); fflush(f_samp);
    if (f_konuk) fflush(f_konuk);
    if (f_render) fflush(f_render);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gpu_lock); if (f_gpu) fflush(f_gpu); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gpu_lock);
}

static void *pl_thread(void *a){
    (void)a;
    pthread_setname_np("perflog");
    int kq = kqueue();
    struct kevent ev;
    EV_SET(&ev, 1, EVFILT_TIMER, EV_ADD, NOTE_NSECONDS | NOTE_CRITICAL, 1000000, 0);   /* 1 ms */
    kevent(kq, &ev, 1, NULL, 0, NULL);
    uint64_t tick = 0, next_sec = 1000000, next_sym = 30000000, next_thumb = 2000000;
    for (;;){
        struct kevent out;
        if (kevent(kq, NULL, 0, &out, 1, NULL) < 1) continue;
        tick++;
        if (th_konuk.port) pl_sample(&th_konuk, 0);
        if ((tick & 3) == 0 && th_render.port) pl_sample(&th_render, 1);
        if (tick % 10 == 5) pl_sample_others();
        uint64_t t = perflog_now_us();
        if (t >= next_sec){ next_sec = t + 1000000; pl_second(); }
        if (t >= next_thumb){ next_thumb = t + 2000000; atomic_store(&g_pl_thumb_req, 1); }
        if (t >= next_sym){ next_sym = t + 30000000; write_syms(); }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static FILE *pl_open(const char *nm, const char *hdr){
    char p[1024]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", g_pl_dir, nm);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "w");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    setvbuf(f, NULL, _IOFBF, 1 << 20);
    if (hdr) fprintf(f, "%s\n", hdr);
    return f;
}

static void pl_exit(void){
    if (!g_perflog) return;
    pl_second();
    write_syms();
    fprintf(stderr, "perflog: kayit kapandi -> %s\n", g_pl_dir);
}

__attribute__((constructor)) static void perflog_init(void){
    const char *e = getenv("PERFLOG");
    if (!e || !*e) return;
    snprintf(g_pl_dir, sizeof g_pl_dir, "%s", e);
    mkdir(g_pl_dir, 0755);
    char ek[1024]; snprintf(ek, sizeof ek, "%s/ekran", g_pl_dir); mkdir(ek, 0755);
    t0_us = mono_us();
    f_konuk  = pl_open("konuk.csv", "t_ms,gkare,duvar_us,cpu_us,uyku_us,present_bekle_us,com,win32,"
                                    "vs_n,ps_n,pso_n,derleme_us,doku_n,doku_kb,doku_us");
    f_render = pl_open("render.csv", "t_ms,kare,aralik_us,drawable_bekle_us,kodlama_us,cizim,kose,dusen,doku_farkli");
    f_gpu    = pl_open("gpu.csv", "kare,t_ms,gpu_us");
    f_sec    = pl_open("saniye.csv", "t_ms,enerji_nj,penerji_nj,komut,cevrim,pkomut,pcevrim,"
                                     "kull_t,sis_t,pkull_t,psis_t,gpu_kullanim,termal,bellek");
    f_thr    = pl_open("thread.csv", "t_ms,tid,rol,ad,kull_ns,sis_ns");
    f_samp   = pl_open("ornek.bin", NULL);
    if (!f_konuk || !f_render || !f_gpu || !f_sec || !f_thr || !f_samp){
        fprintf(stderr, "perflog: %s yazilamiyor, kayit KAPALI\n", g_pl_dir); return; }
    /* ana ikili: PC -> sembol icin yol ve kaydirma; saat esleme */
    const struct mach_header_64 *mh = (const struct mach_header_64 *)_dyld_get_image_header(0);
    intptr_t slide = _dyld_get_image_vmaddr_slide(0);
    img_lo = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mh;
    {   /* __TEXT boyutu */
        const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(mh + 1);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mh->ncmds; i++){
            const struct load_command *lc = (const struct load_command *)p;
            if (lc->cmd == LC_SEGMENT_64){
                const struct segment_command_64 *sg = (const struct segment_command_64 *)p;
                if (!strcmp(sg->segname, "__TEXT")) img_hi = img_lo + sg->vmsize;
            }
            p += lc->cmdsize;
        }
    }
    struct timeval tv; gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    FILE *m = pl_open("meta.txt", NULL);
    if (m){
        fprintf(m, "ikili %s\nkaydirma %lld\nmetin %llx %llx\n", _dyld_get_image_name(0),
                (long long)slide, (unsigned long long)img_lo, (unsigned long long)img_hi);
        fprintf(m, "baslangic_epoch_us %llu\n", (unsigned long long)tv.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)tv.tv_usec);
        fprintf(m, "zaman_tabani %u %u\n", tb.numer, tb.denom);
#if NFS_ENHANCED
        fprintf(m, "build HD\n");
#else
        fprintf(m, "build normal\n");
#endif
        const char *keys[] = { "NFSRES", "NFSFULL", "SPINSLEEP", "PACE60", "HD_RT", "HD_MSAA", NULL };
        for (int i = 0; keys[i]; i++){ const char *v = getenv(keys[i]); if (v) fprintf(m, "env %s=%s\n", keys[i], v); }
        fclose(m);
    }
    g_perflog = 1;
    atexit(pl_exit);
    pthread_t th; pthread_attr_t at; pthread_attr_init(&at);
    pthread_attr_set_qos_class_np(&at, QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE, 0);
    pthread_create(&th, &at, pl_thread, NULL); pthread_detach(th);
    fprintf(stderr, "perflog: oturum kaydi ACIK -> %s\n", g_pl_dir);
}

/* ---- konuk kare (Present sonrasi, konuk thread) ---- */
extern uint64_t g_com_calls, g_win32_calls;
uint64_t spin_slept_us(void);
unsigned long long metal_wait_present_ns(void);
long metal_frames_dropped(void);
void perflog_guest_frame(void){
    static uint64_t lw, lc, ls, lp, lcom, lw32, le[PL_NEV][3];
    static int first = 1;
    if (first){ first = 0; thr_register(&th_konuk); }
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, &ts);
    uint64_t cpu = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    uint64_t w = perflog_now_us(), sl = spin_slept_us(), pw = metal_wait_present_ns() / 1000ull;
    uint64_t e[PL_NEV][3];
    for (int k = 0; k < PL_NEV; k++){ e[k][0] = atomic_load(&ev_n[k]); e[k][1] = atomic_load(&ev_ns[k]); e[k][2] = atomic_load(&ev_b[k]); }
    uint32_t gf = atomic_fetch_add(&g_gframe, 1u) + 1u;
    if (lw){
        uint64_t der_ns = (e[PL_VS][1] - le[PL_VS][1]) + (e[PL_PS][1] - le[PL_PS][1]) + (e[PL_PSO][1] - le[PL_PSO][1]);
        fprintf(f_konuk, "%.3f,%u,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu\n",
                w / 1e3, gf, (unsigned long long)(w - lw), (unsigned long long)(cpu - lc),
                (unsigned long long)(sl - ls), (unsigned long long)(pw - lp),
                (unsigned long long)(g_com_calls - lcom), (unsigned long long)(g_win32_calls - lw32),
                (unsigned long long)(e[PL_VS][0] - le[PL_VS][0]), (unsigned long long)(e[PL_PS][0] - le[PL_PS][0]),
                (unsigned long long)(e[PL_PSO][0] - le[PL_PSO][0]), (unsigned long long)(der_ns / 1000ull),
                (unsigned long long)(e[PL_TEX][0] - le[PL_TEX][0]),
                (unsigned long long)((e[PL_TEXUP][2] - le[PL_TEXUP][2]) / 1024ull),
                (unsigned long long)((e[PL_TEXUP][1] - le[PL_TEXUP][1]) / 1000ull));
    }
    lw = w; lc = cpu; ls = sl; lp = pw; lcom = g_com_calls; lw32 = g_win32_calls;
    memcpy(le, e, sizeof le);
}

/* ---- ana thread kare (commit sonrasi) ---- */
void perflog_render_frame(long fno, unsigned ntex, uint64_t drawable_ns, uint64_t encode_ns, unsigned draws, unsigned verts){
    static uint64_t lw; static int first = 1;
    if (first){ first = 0; thr_register(&th_render); }
    uint64_t w = perflog_now_us();
    fprintf(f_render, "%.3f,%ld,%llu,%llu,%llu,%u,%u,%ld,%u\n", w / 1e3, fno,
            (unsigned long long)(lw ? w - lw : 0), (unsigned long long)(drawable_ns / 1000ull),
            (unsigned long long)(encode_ns / 1000ull), draws, verts, metal_frames_dropped(), ntex);
    lw = w;
}

/* ---- GPU tamamlanma (Metal tamamlanma thread'i) ---- */
void perflog_gpu(long fno, double gpu_ns){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gpu_lock);
    if (f_gpu) fprintf(f_gpu, "%ld,%.3f,%.1f\n", fno, perflog_now_us() / 1e3, gpu_ns / 1e3);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gpu_lock);
}
```

`runtime/res.c`:

```c
/* PE kaynak dizini (.rsrc) - FindResource / LoadResource / LockResource */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <ctype.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

extern uint32_t g_image_base, g_res_dir_va, g_res_dir_size;

/* IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY: +12 NumberOfNamedEntries, +14 NumberOfIdEntries, girisler +16'dan */
/* IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY: +0 Name/Id, +4 OffsetToData (bit31 = alt dizin) */
/* IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY:      +0 OffsetToData(RVA), +4 Size, +8 CodePage        */

static int name_eq(uint32_t name_rva, const char *want){
    uint32_t p = g_res_dir_va + (name_rva & 0x7FFFFFFFu);
    uint32_t len = MR16(p);
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<len;i++){
        uint32_t ch = MR16(p + 2u + 2u*i);
        unsigned char w = (unsigned char)want[i];
        if (!w) return 0;
        if (toupper((int)ch) != toupper((int)w)) return 0;
    }
    return want[len] == 0;
}

/* dir icinde ara; want_str NULL ise want_id kullanilir. Bulunursa giris ofsetini dondurur. */
static uint32_t dir_find(uint32_t dir, const char *want_str, uint32_t want_id, uint32_t *is_dir){
    uint32_t nnamed = MR16(dir + 12), nid = MR16(dir + 14);
    uint32_t base = dir + 16;
    if (want_str){
        for (uint32_t i=0;i<nnamed;i++){
            uint32_t e = base + 8u*i;
            uint32_t nm = MR32(e);
            if (!(nm & 0x80000000u)) continue;
            if (name_eq(nm, want_str)){
                uint32_t off = MR32(e+4);
                *is_dir = (off & 0x80000000u) ? 1u : 0u;
                return g_res_dir_va + (off & 0x7FFFFFFFu);
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<nid;i++){
        uint32_t e = base + 8u*(nnamed + i);
        if (MR32(e) != want_id) continue;
        uint32_t off = MR32(e+4);
        *is_dir = (off & 0x80000000u) ? 1u : 0u;
        return g_res_dir_va + (off & 0x7FFFFFFFu);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ilk cocugu al (dil seviyesi icin) */
static uint32_t dir_first(uint32_t dir, uint32_t *is_dir){
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)MR16(dir+12) + (uint32_t)MR16(dir+14);
    if (!n) return 0;
    uint32_t off = MR32(dir + 16 + 4);
    *is_dir = (off & 0x80000000u) ? 1u : 0u;
    return g_res_dir_va + (off & 0x7FFFFFFFu);
}

uint64_t g_res_found = 0, g_res_missed = 0;

/* lpName/lpType: yuksek word 0 ise tamsayi kimlik, degilse guest string isaretcisi */
uint32_t res_find(uint32_t lpName, uint32_t lpType, int wide){
    if (!g_res_dir_va) return 0;
    char nbuf[128], tbuf[128];
    const char *ns = 0, *ts = 0; uint32_t nid = 0, tid = 0;

    if (lpType > 0xFFFFu){
        if (wide){ uint32_t k=0; while(k<127 && MR16(lpType+2u*k)){ tbuf[k]=(char)MR16(lpType+2u*k); k++; } tbuf[k]=0; }
        else     { uint32_t k=0; while(k<127 && MR8(lpType+k)){ tbuf[k]=(char)MR8(lpType+k); k++; } tbuf[k]=0; }
        ts = tbuf;
    } else tid = lpType;

    if (lpName > 0xFFFFu){
        if (wide){ uint32_t k=0; while(k<127 && MR16(lpName+2u*k)){ nbuf[k]=(char)MR16(lpName+2u*k); k++; } nbuf[k]=0; }
        else     { uint32_t k=0; while(k<127 && MR8(lpName+k)){ nbuf[k]=(char)MR8(lpName+k); k++; } nbuf[k]=0; }
        ns = nbuf;
    } else nid = lpName;

    uint32_t isd = 0;
    uint32_t td = dir_find(g_res_dir_va, ts, tid, &isd);
    if (!td || !isd){ g_res_missed++; return 0; }
    uint32_t nd = dir_find(td, ns, nid, &isd);
    if (!nd){ g_res_missed++; return 0; }
    uint32_t leaf = nd;
    if (isd){ leaf = dir_first(nd, &isd); if (!leaf || isd){ g_res_missed++; return 0; } }
    g_res_found++;
    { static int shown=0; if(getenv("VERBOSE") && shown<8){ shown++;
        uint32_t da = g_image_base + MR32(leaf), sz = MR32(leaf+4);
        fprintf(stderr,"  [kaynak] tip=%s%u ad=%s -> VA 0x%08x boyut %u  ilk: %02x %02x %02x %02x (imza %s)\n",
                ts?"":"#", ts?0u:tid, ns?ns:"(id)", da, sz,
                MR8(da),MR8(da+1),MR8(da+2),MR8(da+3),
                MR32(da)==0xFEFF0901u?"EFEKT OK":"?" ); } }
    return leaf;                      /* IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY adresi = HRSRC */
}
uint32_t res_data(uint32_t hrsrc){ return hrsrc ? g_image_base + MR32(hrsrc) : 0; }
uint32_t res_size(uint32_t hrsrc){ return hrsrc ? MR32(hrsrc + 4) : 0; }

void res_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr,"  kaynak: %llu bulundu, %llu bulunamadi\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_res_found,(unsigned long long)g_res_missed);
}
```
