`runtime/win32.c`:

```c
/* Asama 3 tohumu: boot icin gerekli Win32 API alt kumesi + kalanlar icin izleme. */
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include "enhance.h"
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <setjmp.h>

/* getenv() her cagrida ortam dizisini TARAR ve kilit alir.  Cizim basina
 * calisan yollarda (ornegin SetVertexShaderConstantF icindeki "PDLIST"
 * kontrolu &&-zincirinin ILK terimiydi) olculebilir maliyeti var:
 * profilde getenv+__findenv_locked konuk thread'in %3'unu yiyordu.
 * Ortam degiskenleri kosu boyunca degismez -> bir kez coz, sakla. */
#define ENVC(nm_) ({ static const char *_ev_; static int _ei_; \
                     if (!_ei_){ _ei_ = 1; _ev_ = getenv(nm_); } _ev_; })

jmp_buf g_exit_jmp;
int g_exit_code = 0;
int g_exit_armed = 0;

typedef struct { uint32_t iat; const char*dll; const char*name; int nargs; } ImpEnt;
extern const ImpEnt g_imp[]; extern const uint32_t g_imp_count;
void mem_commit(uint32_t,uint32_t);
void guest_backtrace(CPU*,int);
int win32_ext_call(CPU*, const char*, uint32_t*);
void guest_fair_yield(void);
int fileio_call(CPU*, const char*, uint32_t*);
void fileio_report(void);
uint64_t win32_ext_threads(void);
uint64_t win32_ext_threads_exited(void);
uint32_t com_direct3dcreate9(void);
uint32_t com_directinput8create(uint32_t);
uint32_t com_directsoundcreate(uint32_t);
void com_init(void);
int g_bt_on = 0;

#define IMP_MAGIC 0xF0000000u

/* --- guest heap: baslikli bump ayirici (HeapSize/ReAlloc icin boyut saklar) --- */
#define HEAP_BASE 0x10000000u
#define HEAP_MAX  0x2F000000u
#define HDR 16u
/* ---- HIBRIT sanal saat -------------------------------------------------
 * Denenenler:
 *   (a) cagri basina sabit artis -> zaman duzensiz, animasyonlar bozuk
 *   (b) gercek monotonik saat    -> emulator yavas oldugu icin oyun her
 *       karede devasa "gecen sure" gorup telafi dongusune giriyor (20->1 fps)
 *   (c) yalnizca kare basina 16.67 ms -> kare temposu dogru AMA kare
 *       sunmadan zamani bekleyen kod (video oynatici) SONSUZ DONGUYE
 *       giriyor: olcum, timeGetTime 231 milyon kez cagrildi.
 *   (d) SECILEN: kare basina 16.67 ms + saat cok kez sorgulanip hic kare
 *       gelmiyorsa yavasca ilerlet.  Boylece hem tempo dogru kalir hem de
 *       zaman bekleyen dongulerin ilerlemesi garanti olur.             */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_vclock_base  = 0;   /* kare basindaki sanal zaman */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_vclock_creep = 0;   /* mesgul-bekleme telafisi    */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_real_base    = 0;   /* o karenin gercek zamani    */
static _Atomic uint32_t g_vclock_polls = 0;

static uint64_t real_us(void){
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
}

/* Sanal saat.
 * Kareler ARASINDA tam 16.667 ms ilerler: animasyon hizi emulatorun
 * hizindan bagimsiz kalir.  Kare ICINDE ise gercek zamanla orantili,
 * duzgun akar -- cunku oyun kare suresini saati kare icinde IKI KEZ
 * ornekleyip farkini alarak olcuyor (0x005812e5).  Tek hamlede atlayan
 * eski saat ona "kare sifir surdu" dedirtiyor, bu yuzden on yuz tiki
 * [0x8651a8] hic artmiyor ve tum animasyonlar/zamanli gecisler donuyordu. */
/* Sanal zamanin gercek zamana oranini olc: saat degisiklikleri oyunu
 * hizlandirmasin (daha once 2.01 kati kosmustu). */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_vt_last = 0, g_rt_start = 0, g_vt_start = 0;
void vclock_report(void){
    uint64_t v0 = atomic_load(&g_vt_start), r0 = atomic_load(&g_rt_start);
    uint64_t v1 = atomic_load(&g_vt_last),  r1 = real_us();
    if (!r0 || r1 <= r0) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "  sanal saat        : %.3f x gercek zaman (%.1f sn sanal / %.1f sn gercek)\n",
            (double)(v1 - v0) / (double)(r1 - r0),
            (double)(v1 - v0)/1e6, (double)(r1 - r0)/1e6);
}
void vclock_tick(void){
    uint64_t cr = atomic_exchange(&g_vclock_creep, 0ull);
    uint64_t now = real_us();
    /* Kare basina ilerleme.
     *   VCLOCK=fixed : her kare tam 16.667 ms (eski davranis).  Emulator
     *                  60 fps'in altina dusunce OYUN AGIR CEKIM olur --
     *                  ve muzik de oyunun saatinden calindigi icin
     *                  perdesi duser.  Kullanicinin duydugu "fps dusunce
     *                  muzik yavasliyor" tam olarak buydu (olculdu: 50 fps'te
     *                  sanal/gercek = 0.885, yani ~2 yarim ses pes).
     *   VCLOCK=real  : GERCEK gecen sure (varsayilan).  Oyun da muzik de
     *                  gercek zamanda akar.  Telafi dongusune girmemesi
     *                  icin kare basina artis 50 ms ile sinirli. */
    { static _Atomic int mode = -1;
      int m = atomic_load(&mode);
      if (m < 0){ const char *e = ENVC("VCLOCK");
                  m = (e && *e == 'f') ? 0 : 1; atomic_store(&mode, m); }
      uint64_t rb = atomic_load(&g_real_base);
      uint64_t step = 16667ull;
      if (m && rb && now > rb){
          step = now - rb;
          if (step < 4000ull)  step = 4000ull;    /* 250 fps ustu: kirp */
          if (step > 50000ull) step = 50000ull;   /* devasa dt -> telafi dongusu */
      }
      atomic_fetch_add(&g_vclock_base, step + cr); }
    atomic_store(&g_real_base, now);
    atomic_store(&g_vclock_polls, 0);
    { uint64_t v = atomic_load(&g_vclock_base);
      if (!atomic_load(&g_rt_start)){ atomic_store(&g_rt_start, real_us());
                                      atomic_store(&g_vt_start, v); }
      atomic_store(&g_vt_last, v); }
}

uint64_t host_us(void){
    uint64_t base = atomic_load(&g_vclock_base);
    uint64_t rb   = atomic_load(&g_real_base);
    uint64_t now  = real_us();
    uint64_t d    = (now > rb) ? (now - rb) : 0ull;
    /* Kare ICI ilerlemenin tavani.  16 ms COK DARDI: bir karede 16 ms'den
     * fazla OYUN zamani bekleyen kod (yaris oncesi ara sahne) tavana
     * carpiyor ve ancak asagidaki emniyet valfiyle (200 ms sonra) ilerleyebiliyordu
     * -> her kare zorunlu olarak ~235 ms surdu (4.6 fps, olculdu).
     * Tavani tamamen kaldirmak da olmaz: oyun gercekten gecen sureyi gorup
     * telafi dongusune giriyor.  Uc kare butcesi iyi bir orta yol. */
    { static _Atomic uint64_t maxd = 0;
      uint64_t m = atomic_load(&maxd);
      if (!m){ const char *e = ENVC("VCLOCK_MAXD");
               m = (e && *e) ? (uint64_t)strtoull(e,0,0) : 50000ull;
               if (m < 16000ull) m = 16000ull;
               atomic_store(&maxd, m); }
      if (d > m) d = m; }

    /* Kare uretmeden saati donup bekleyen dongulere karsi emniyet valfi.
     *
     * DIKKAT: eskiden olcut ANKET SAYISIYDI (kare basina >2000 sorgu ->
     * her 64 sorguda 400 us, >20000'de 2 ms...).  Yogun bir yaris
     * karesinde 20 binden fazla saat sorgusu NORMALDIR; bu, kare basina
     * ~100 ms sahte zaman ekliyordu.  Olculdu: gercek 1.01 sn'de sanal
     * 2.04 sn (oran 2.01) -- ara sahneler ve yaris iki kat hizli
     * kosuyordu.  Artik olcut GERCEK ZAMAN: yalnizca kare 200 ms'den
     * uzun surduyse (yani gercekten takildiysa) devreye girer ve kare
     * basina en fazla 100 ms ekler. */
    uint32_t n = atomic_fetch_add(&g_vclock_polls, 1);
    uint64_t stalled = (now > rb) ? (now - rb) : 0ull;      /* kirpilmamis */
    /* Emniyet valfi: esik 200 ms -> 60 ms, adim 2 ms -> 4 ms.  Tavan
     * yukseldigi icin bu yol artik yalnizca GERCEK takilmalarda calisir. */
    if (stalled > 60000ull && (n & 15u) == 15u){
        if (atomic_load(&g_vclock_creep) < 200000ull)
            atomic_fetch_add(&g_vclock_creep, 4000ull);
    }
    return base + d + atomic_load(&g_vclock_creep);
}
uint32_t host_ms(void){ return (uint32_t)(host_us() / 1000ull) + 1000u; }
uint64_t host_qpc(void){ return host_us(); }

static uint32_t heap_ptr = HEAP_BASE;
static uint64_t g_alloc_fail = 0;
static uint32_t galloc(uint32_t n, int zero){
    uint32_t need = (n + HDR + 15u) & ~15u;
    if (heap_ptr + need > HEAP_MAX || need < n){ g_alloc_fail++; return 0; }
    uint32_t p = heap_ptr; heap_ptr += need;
    mem_commit(p, need);
    MR32(p) = n;                       /* kullanici boyutu */
    MR32(p+4) = 0xA110C8EDu;           /* imza             */
    uint32_t u = p + HDR;
    if (zero) memset(g_mem + u, 0, n);
    return u;
}
static uint32_t gsize(uint32_t u){
    if (!u || u < HEAP_BASE + HDR || u >= HEAP_MAX) return 0;
    if (MR32(u - HDR + 4) != 0xA110C8EDu) return 0;
    return MR32(u - HDR);
}
uint32_t win32_block_size(uint32_t u){ return gsize(u); }
uint32_t win32_heap_used(void){ return heap_ptr - HEAP_BASE; }

/* --- izleme --- */
typedef struct { uint32_t calls; uint32_t unimpl; } ImpStat;
static ImpStat *stat_;
static uint32_t trace_n = 0, trace_max = 0;
void win32_set_trace_max(uint32_t v){ trace_max = v; }
static uint32_t unimpl_first = 0xffffffffu;
static const char *unimpl_name = 0;
uint64_t g_win32_calls = 0, g_win32_unimpl = 0;

static uint32_t tls_slot[128]; static int tls_next = 0;
static uint32_t g_cmdline = 0;
static uint64_t tick0;

static uint32_t ARG(CPU*c,int i){ return MR32(c->esp + 4u*(uint32_t)i); }  /* ret adresi POP edildikten sonra */

/* QPCWHO=1: QueryPerformanceCounter'i kim (thread, donus adresi, bir ust
 * cerceve) cagiriyor.  120 fps'te kare basina ~21 bin cagri goruldu (60 fps
 * PACE60'ta ~2 bin): zamana bagli bir bekleme dongusu.  Cagri GIL altinda,
 * tablo kilitsiz. */
typedef struct { uint32_t tid, ra, ra2; uint64_t n; } QpcWho;
static QpcWho g_qw[128];
static void qpc_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr, "\n=== QPCWHO: QueryPerformanceCounter cagiranlar ===\n");
    for (int k = 0; k < 128; k++){
        int b = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) if (g_qw[i].n && (b < 0 || g_qw[i].n > g_qw[b].n)) b = i;
        if (b < 0 || k >= 24) break;
        fprintf(stderr, "  %12llu  thread %5u  donus 0x%08x  ust 0x%08x\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_qw[b].n, g_qw[b].tid, g_qw[b].ra, g_qw[b].ra2);
        g_qw[b].n = 0;
    }
}
/* ---- Oyunun kare bekleme dongusu: donme yerine uyku ----
 * sub_0057eae0 (0x57eb5e..0x57eb8e), kare suresi dt hedefin altindaysa:
 *     start = GetTicks(); hedef = (X - dt) * k;
 *     do { gecen = Fark(start, GetTicks()); } while (gecen < hedef);
 * GetTicks = sub_0043bdf0 = QPC >> [0x8284e4]; Fark = sub_0043be20 =
 * (now - start) * 2^S * [0x828028] saniye.  Dongu yalnizca saate bakiyor;
 * 120 fps'te kare basina ~19 bin QPC ve oyun thread'inin TUM bos zamani
 * (kare basina 8.2 ms CPU, %98) burada yaniyordu: D3DX'te kazanilan her
 * ms buraya gidiyor, guc degismiyordu.
 * Donguden gelen QPC'de (donus 0x43bdfe, onu cagiran 0x57eb79) kalan
 * sure oyunun kendi formuluyle hesaplanir ve (kalan - pay) kadar uyunur;
 * son pay yine donerek beklenir.  Cikis kosulu ve saat ayni oldugu icin
 * oyunun zamanlamasi degismez, yalnizca CPU bos kalir.  Uyku kevent
 * NOTE_CRITICAL ile (guest_sleep_ns): nanosleep ortalama 447 us gec
 * uyaniyordu, kevent 41 us (%98'i <= 200 us).
 * SPINSLEEP=<pay us> (varsayilan 200), SPINSLEEP=0 kapatir.
 * Yigin: POP32 sonrasi [esp+0xc] = 0x57eb79, E = esp+0x14 (0057eae0'nun
 * yerel taban), hedef float [E+0xc] = [esp+0x20], start = EBX. */
static int g_spin_pay = -1;
static uint64_t g_spin_n, g_spin_us, g_spin_gec[7];   /* gec uyanma: <=25,50,100,200,400,800,>800 us */
static void spin_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr, "\n=== SPINSLEEP: kare bekleme dongusu %llu kez uyudu, toplam %.2f sn (pay %d us) ===\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_n, g_spin_us / 1e6, g_spin_pay);
    fprintf(stderr, "  gec uyanma: <=25us %llu  <=50 %llu  <=100 %llu  <=200 %llu  <=400 %llu  <=800 %llu  >800 %llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_gec[0], (unsigned long long)g_spin_gec[1], (unsigned long long)g_spin_gec[2],
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_gec[3], (unsigned long long)g_spin_gec[4], (unsigned long long)g_spin_gec[5],
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_gec[6]);
    extern uint64_t g_sleep_late_ns, g_sleep_gil_ns, g_sleep_n;
    if (g_sleep_n) fprintf(stderr, "  ortalama: nanosleep gecikmesi %.0f us, uyanista kilit bekleme %.0f us\n",
                           g_sleep_late_ns / 1e3 / g_sleep_n, g_sleep_gil_ns / 1e3 / g_sleep_n);
}
uint64_t spin_slept_us(void){ return g_spin_us; }   /* perflog: kare sinirlayici uykusu */
static void qpc_spin_sleep(CPU *c){
    if (MR32(c->esp + 0xcu) != 0x57eb79u) return;
    if (g_spin_pay < 0){ const char *e = getenv("SPINSLEEP"); g_spin_pay = e ? atoi(e) : 200;
                         if (g_spin_pay && ENVC("QPCWHO")) atexit(spin_report); }
    if (!g_spin_pay) return;
    /* oyunun birimi: F = [0x828028] QPC tiki basina (olculen 0.001 = ms,
     * k = [0x784550] = 1000), X = [0x865558] = 1/120 sn kare hedefi */
    uint32_t S = MR32(0x8284e4u) & 31u;
    float F = MRF32(0x828028u), hedef = MRF32(c->esp + 0x20u);
    if (!(F > 0.0f) || !(hedef > 0.0f)) return;
    uint64_t now = host_qpc();
    int32_t d = (int32_t)((uint32_t)(now >> S) - c->ebx); if (d < 0) d = 0;
    double kalan = (double)hedef - (double)d * (double)(1u << S) * (double)F;
    double us = kalan / (double)F - (double)g_spin_pay;      /* QPC tiki = us (QPF 1 MHz) */
    if (us < 50.0 || us > 100000.0) return;                  /* kisa: don; >0.1 sn: beklenmedik */
    void guest_sleep_ns(long ns);
    guest_sleep_ns((long)(us * 1000.0));
    g_spin_n++; g_spin_us += (uint64_t)us;
    { double gec = (double)(host_qpc() - now) - us;          /* istenenden fazla uyunan us */
      int b = gec <= 25 ? 0 : gec <= 50 ? 1 : gec <= 100 ? 2 : gec <= 200 ? 3 : gec <= 400 ? 4 : gec <= 800 ? 5 : 6;
      g_spin_gec[b]++; }
}
static void qpc_who(CPU *c){
    static int init = 0; static uint64_t tot = 0;
    if (!init){ init = 1; atexit(qpc_report); }
    if ((++tot & 0xFFFFFu) == 0){ long metal_frames(void);
        fprintf(stderr, "  [qpc] %llu M cagri, kare %ld\n", (unsigned long long)(tot >> 20), metal_frames()); }
    uint32_t tid = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x24u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24u) : 0u;
    uint32_t ra = c->eip;                       /* POP32 sonrasi: donus adresi */
    /* sub_0043bdf0 (oyunun zaman sarmalayicisi): sub esp,8; push arg; call.
     * POP32 sonrasi [esp]=arg, [esp+4..0xb]=yerel, [esp+0xc]=onu cagiran. */
    uint32_t ra2 = ra == 0x43bdfeu ? MR32(c->esp+0xcu)
                 : (c->ebp && mem_is_committed(c->ebp+4u)) ? MR32(c->ebp+4u) : 0u;
    uint32_t h = (tid * 2654435761u ^ ra * 40503u ^ ra2) & 127u;
    for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++, h = (h + 1) & 127u){
        QpcWho *w = &g_qw[h];
        if (!w->n){ w->tid = tid; w->ra = ra; w->ra2 = ra2; w->n = 1; return; }
        if (w->tid == tid && w->ra == ra && w->ra2 == ra2){ w->n++; return; }
    }
}

int win32_call(CPU *c, uint32_t idx){
    if (idx >= g_imp_count) return 0;
    const ImpEnt *e = &g_imp[idx];
    stat_[idx].calls++; g_win32_calls++;
    guest_fair_yield();          /* diger guest thread'lerine sira ver */
    POP32(c->eip);                      /* donus adresini al */
    int handled = 1;
    const char *n = e->name;
    uint32_t r = 0;

    /* QueryPerformanceCounter en sik cagri (kare sinirlayici); ad zincirinin
     * ~20 strcmp'ini atlamak icin import indisi ilk eslesmede onbellege alinir. */
    static uint32_t qpc_idx = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    if (idx == qpc_idx || (qpc_idx == 0xFFFFFFFFu && !strcmp(n,"QueryPerformanceCounter") && (qpc_idx = idx, 1))){
        if (ENVC("QPCWHO")) qpc_who(c);
        if (c->eip == 0x43bdfeu) qpc_spin_sleep(c);
        uint64_t v = host_qpc(); uint32_t p=ARG(c,0);
        if(p){ MR32(p)=(uint32_t)v; MR32(p+4)=(uint32_t)(v>>32); } r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetVersion"))            r = 0x0A280105u;      /* 5.1.2600 */
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetModuleHandleA"))      r = 0x00400000u;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetProcessHeap"))        r = 0x00000001u;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapCreate"))            r = 0x00000002u;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapDestroy"))           r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapAlloc")){
        uint32_t sz=ARG(c,2); r = galloc(sz, ARG(c,1) & 8u);
        { const char *w = ENVC("TRACE_ALLOC");
          if (w){ uint32_t want = (uint32_t)strtoul(w,0,0);
            if (sz == want){ extern uint32_t g_watch_prev_ip;
              fprintf(stderr,"      [alloc] HeapAlloc(%u) -> 0x%08x   cagiran guest komut: 0x%08x\n",
                      sz, r, g_watch_prev_ip);
              guest_backtrace(c, 12); } } }
        /* WATCHALLOC=<boyut>: o boyuttaki ilk ayirmanin +16'sina watchpoint kur.
         * Sabit blogu yalnizca bir kez yazildigi icin yazmayi ancak boyle
         * yakalayabiliyoruz. */
        /* WATCHAT=<adres>: tam o adresi donduren ayirmada watchpoint kur */
        { const char *wa = ENVC("WATCHAT");
          if (wa && r){ static int armed2 = 0;
            uint32_t want3 = (uint32_t)strtoul(wa,0,0);
            if (!armed2 && r == want3){ armed2 = 1;
              void watch_arm(uint32_t);
              const char *wo = ENVC("WATCHOFF");
              uint32_t off3 = wo ? (uint32_t)strtoul(wo,0,0) : 0u;
              fprintf(stderr,"      [alloc] hedef blok 0x%08x (%u bayt) ayrildi, izlenen +%u\n",
                      r, sz, off3);
              watch_arm(r + off3);
              if (ENVC("MPROT")){ void mprot_arm(uint32_t); mprot_arm(r + off3); }
            } } }
        { const char *w2 = ENVC("WATCHALLOC");
          if (w2 && r){ static int armed = 0; static int seen = 0;
            uint32_t want2 = (uint32_t)strtoul(w2,0,0);
            const char *ws = ENVC("WATCHALLOC_N");
            int wantn = ws ? atoi(ws) : 1;
            if (!armed && sz == want2 && ++seen == wantn){ armed = 1;
              void watch_arm(uint32_t);
              fprintf(stderr,"      [alloc] %u baytlik blok 0x%08x ayrildi; +16'ya watchpoint\n", sz, r);
              watch_arm(r); } } }
        static int shown=0;
        if (ENVC("VERBOSE") && shown<2 && sz>0x100000u){ shown++;
            fprintf(stderr,"      [heap] HeapAlloc(size=0x%08x) SUPHELI. ebp=0x%08x esp=0x%08x\n", sz, c->ebp, c->esp);
            fprintf(stderr,"        yigin (esp'den):");
            for(int k=0;k<14;k++) fprintf(stderr," %s%08x", k?"":"", MR32(c->esp+4u*k));
            fprintf(stderr,"\n        ebp cevresi   :");
            for(int k=-4;k<=6;k++) fprintf(stderr," %s%08x", k==0?">":"", MR32(c->ebp+4u*(uint32_t)k));
            fprintf(stderr,"\n        esi=%08x edi=%08x ebx=%08x\n", c->esi,c->edi,c->ebx); }
    }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapReAlloc")){
        uint32_t o=ARG(c,2), ns=ARG(c,3), os=gsize(o);
        uint32_t p=galloc(ns, ARG(c,1)&8u);
        if(p&&o){ uint32_t cp = os && os<ns ? os : ns; memcpy(g_mem+p, g_mem+o, cp); }
        r=p; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapFree"))              r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapSize")){
        uint32_t lp=ARG(c,2); r = gsize(lp);
        static int shown=0;
        if (ENVC("VERBOSE") && shown<8){ shown++;
            fprintf(stderr,"      [heap] HeapSize(h=0x%08x,f=0x%08x,p=0x%08x) hdr.size=0x%08x hdr.sig=0x%08x -> 0x%08x\n",
                    ARG(c,0),ARG(c,1),lp,
                    (lp>=HEAP_BASE+HDR&&lp<HEAP_MAX)?MR32(lp-HDR):0xDEAD0000u,
                    (lp>=HEAP_BASE+HDR&&lp<HEAP_MAX)?MR32(lp-HDR+4):0xDEAD0000u, r); }
    }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"VirtualAlloc"))          r = galloc(ARG(c,1), 1);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GlobalAlloc"))            r = galloc(ARG(c,1), ARG(c,0)&0x40u);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"LocalAlloc"))             r = galloc(ARG(c,1), ARG(c,0)&0x40u);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GlobalFree")||!strcmp(n,"LocalFree")) r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GlobalLock")||!strcmp(n,"LocalLock")) r = ARG(c,0);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GlobalUnlock"))           r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"VirtualFree"))           r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCommandLineA"))       r = g_cmdline;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetEnvironmentStrings")||!strcmp(n,"GetEnvironmentStringsW")){
        uint32_t p=galloc(8,1); r=p; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"FreeEnvironmentStringsA")||!strcmp(n,"FreeEnvironmentStringsW")) r=1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetStartupInfoA")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); if(p){ mem_commit(p,68); memset(g_mem+p,0,68); MR32(p)=68; } r=0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetStdHandle"))          r = 0x10u + (ARG(c,0) & 3u);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetFileType"))           r = 2;   /* FILE_TYPE_CHAR */
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetHandleCount"))        r = ARG(c,0);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetVersionExA")||!strcmp(n,"GetVersionExW")){
        uint32_t p=ARG(c,0);
        if(p){ MR32(p+4)=5; MR32(p+8)=1; MR32(p+12)=2600; MR32(p+16)=2; }
        r = 1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetACP"))                r = 1252;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetOEMCP"))              r = 437;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCPInfo")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,1); if(p){ mem_commit(p,20); memset(g_mem+p,0,20); MR32(p)=1; } r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"IsValidCodePage"))       r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsAlloc"))              r = (tls_next<128)? (uint32_t)tls_next++ : 0xffffffffu;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsSetValue")){
        uint32_t i=ARG(c,0), v=ARG(c,1);
        uint32_t arr = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x2cu)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x2cu) : 0;
        if (arr && i<256u && mem_is_committed(arr+4u*i)){ MR32(arr+4u*i)=v; r=1; }
        else { if(i<128) tls_slot[i]=v; r=1; } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsGetValue")){
        uint32_t i=ARG(c,0);
        uint32_t arr = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x2cu)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x2cu) : 0;
        if (arr && i<256u && mem_is_committed(arr+4u*i)) r = MR32(arr+4u*i);
        else r = (i<128)?tls_slot[i]:0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsFree"))               r = 1;
    /* Kritik bolumler burada ELE ALINMAZ; win32_ext.c'de GERCEK
     * ozyinelemeli kilitlerle uygulaniyor (bkz. cs_for).  Etkisiz stub
     * birakilirsa GIL'in adil paylasimi karsilikli dislamayi bozuyor. */
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCurrentThreadId")){
        /* TEB'den gercek thread kimligi (fs:[0x24]); her thread benzersiz olmali */
        r = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x24u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24u) : 1u;
        if (!r) r = 1u; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCurrentProcessId"))   r = 100;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCurrentProcess"))     r = 0xffffffffu;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetLastError"))          r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetLastError"))          r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetTickCount")) r = host_ms();
    else if (!strcmp(n,"QueryPerformanceFrequency")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); if(p){MR32(p)=1000000;MR32(p+4)=0;} r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetUnhandledExceptionFilter")) r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"UnhandledExceptionFilter"))    r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"IsProcessorFeaturePresent"))   r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetModuleFileNameA")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,1),sz=ARG(c,2);
        const char*s="C:\\\\NFSU2\\\\SPEED2.EXE"; uint32_t l=(uint32_t)strlen(s);
        if(p&&sz){ if(l>=sz) l=sz-1; memcpy(g_mem+p,s,l); MR8(p+l)=0; } r=l; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"ExitProcess")){ g_exit_code=(int)ARG(c,0);
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** guest ExitProcess(%u) - sonlandiriliyor\n",ARG(c,0));
        if(g_exit_armed) longjmp(g_exit_jmp,1); return -1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"LoadLibraryA")||!strcmp(n,"LoadLibraryW")){
        r = 0x20000000u;
        { static int sh=0; uint32_t p2=ARG(c,0);
          if (ENVC("VERBOSE") && sh<12){ sh++; fprintf(stderr,"      [dll] LoadLibrary(ptr=0x%08x) \"%s\"\n", p2, p2?(char*)(g_mem+p2):"(NULL)"); } } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetProcAddress")){
        uint32_t pname = ARG(c,1); r = 0;
        if (pname > 0xffff){                       /* isimle (ordinal degil) */
            const char *want = (const char*)(g_mem + pname);
            for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_imp_count;i++)
                if (!strcmp(g_imp[i].name, want)){ r = IMP_MAGIC + i; break; }
            { static int sh=0;
              if (ENVC("VERBOSE") && !r && sh<12){ sh++; fprintf(stderr,"      [dll] GetProcAddress(\"%s\") BULUNAMADI\n", want); } }
        } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"FreeLibrary"))           r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"InterlockedIncrement")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); r=++MR32(p); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"InterlockedDecrement")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); r=--MR32(p); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"InterlockedExchange")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); r=MR32(p); MR32(p)=ARG(c,1); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"MultiByteToWideChar")){ uint32_t src=ARG(c,2); int sl=(int)ARG(c,3);
        uint32_t dst=ARG(c,4); int dl=(int)ARG(c,5);
        if(sl<0) sl=(int)strlen((char*)(g_mem+src))+1;
        if(dl==0){ r=(uint32_t)sl; } else { int k=0; for(;k<sl&&k<dl;k++) MR16(dst+2u*k)=MR8(src+k); r=(uint32_t)k; } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"WideCharToMultiByte")){ uint32_t src=ARG(c,2); int sl=(int)ARG(c,3);
        uint32_t dst=ARG(c,4); int dl=(int)ARG(c,5);
        if(sl<0){ sl=0; while(MR16(src+2u*sl)) sl++; sl++; }
        if(dl==0){ r=(uint32_t)sl; } else { int k=0; for(;k<sl&&k<dl;k++) MR8(dst+k)=(uint8_t)MR16(src+2u*k); r=(uint32_t)k; } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetStringTypeW")||!strcmp(n,"GetStringTypeA")){
        /* A: (LCID,dwInfoType,src,cch,out)  W: (dwInfoType,src,cch,out) */
        int aform = (n[13]=='A');
        uint32_t info = ARG(c, aform?1:0);
        uint32_t src  = ARG(c, aform?2:1);
        int      cch  = (int)ARG(c, aform?3:2);
        uint32_t out  = ARG(c, aform?4:3);
        int wide = !aform;
        if (cch < 0){ cch = 0; if(wide){ while(MR16(src+2u*cch)) cch++; } else { while(MR8(src+cch)) cch++; } cch++; }
        if (info == 1 && out){                       /* CT_CTYPE1 */
            for (int k=0;k<cch;k++){
                uint32_t ch = wide ? MR16(src+2u*k) : MR8(src+k);
                uint16_t f = 0x0200;                 /* C1_DEFINED */
                if (ch<128){
                    if (ch>='A'&&ch<='Z') f |= 0x0001|0x0100;
                    if (ch>='a'&&ch<='z') f |= 0x0002|0x0100;
                    if (ch>='0'&&ch<='9') f |= 0x0004|0x0080;
                    if ((ch>='a'&&ch<='f')||(ch>='A'&&ch<='F')) f |= 0x0080;
                    if (ch==' ') f |= 0x0008|0x0040;
                    if (ch=='\t'||ch=='\n'||ch=='\r'||ch==0x0b||ch==0x0c) f |= 0x0008;
                    if (ch<0x20||ch==0x7f) f |= 0x0020;
                    if (ch>0x20&&ch<0x7f&&!(f&(0x0100|0x0004))) f |= 0x0010;
                } else f |= 0x0100;
                MR16(out+2u*k) = f;
            }
        }
        r = 1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"LCMapStringW")||!strcmp(n,"LCMapStringA")){
        int wide = (n[11]=='W');
        uint32_t flags = ARG(c,1), src = ARG(c,2); int cch = (int)ARG(c,3);
        uint32_t dst = ARG(c,4); int cchd = (int)ARG(c,5);
        if (cch < 0){ cch = 0; if(wide){ while(MR16(src+2u*cch)) cch++; } else { while(MR8(src+cch)) cch++; } cch++; }
        if (cchd == 0){ r = (uint32_t)cch; }
        else {
            int k=0;
            for (;k<cch && k<cchd;k++){
                uint32_t ch = wide ? MR16(src+2u*k) : MR8(src+k);
                if ((flags & 0x00000100u) && ch<128 && ch>='A' && ch<='Z') ch += 32;   /* LOWERCASE */
                if ((flags & 0x00000200u) && ch<128 && ch>='a' && ch<='z') ch -= 32;   /* UPPERCASE */
                if (wide) MR16(dst+2u*k)=(uint16_t)ch; else MR8(dst+k)=(uint8_t)ch;
            }
            r = (uint32_t)k;
        } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetLocaleInfoA")||!strcmp(n,"GetLocaleInfoW")){
        int wide = (n[13]=='W');
        uint32_t lct = ARG(c,1) & 0xffffu, p = ARG(c,2); int cch = (int)ARG(c,3);
        const char *v = 0; char num[16];
        switch (lct){
        case 0x0001: v="0409"; break;                 /* ILANGUAGE            */
        case 0x0002: v="English"; break;              /* SLANGUAGE            */
        case 0x1001: v="English"; break;              /* SENGLANGUAGE         */
        case 0x1002: v="United States"; break;        /* SENGCOUNTRY          */
        case 0x0003: v="ENU"; break;                  /* SABBREVLANGNAME      */
        case 0x0005: v="US"; break;                   /* SABBREVCTRYNAME      */
        case 0x000E: v="."; break;                    /* SDECIMAL             */
        case 0x000F: v=","; break;                    /* STHOUSAND            */
        case 0x0014: v="2"; break;                    /* IDIGITS              */
        case 0x000B: snprintf(num,sizeof num,"%d",437);  v=num; break; /* IDEFAULTCODEPAGE */
        case 0x1004: snprintf(num,sizeof num,"%d",1252); v=num; break; /* IDEFAULTANSICODEPAGE */
        case 0x0019: v="$"; break;                    /* SCURRENCY            */
        case 0x001D: v="/"; break;                    /* SDATE                */
        case 0x001E: v=":"; break;                    /* STIME                */
        default:     v="";  break;
        }
        uint32_t len = (uint32_t)strlen(v) + 1;
        if (cch == 0) r = wide ? len : len;
        else if (p){ uint32_t k=0; for(;k<len-1 && k<(uint32_t)cch-1;k++){ if(wide) MR16(p+2u*k)=v[k]; else MR8(p+k)=v[k]; }
                     if(wide) MR16(p+2u*k)=0; else MR8(p+k)=0; r=k+1; }
        else r = 0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"MessageBoxA")){
        uint32_t txt=ARG(c,1), cap=ARG(c,2);
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** GUEST MESSAGEBOX ***\n  baslik: %s\n  metin : %s\n***\n",
                cap?(char*)(g_mem+cap):"(yok)", txt?(char*)(g_mem+txt):"(yok)");
        r = 1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"Direct3DCreate9")) r = com_direct3dcreate9();
    else if (!strcmp(n,"DirectInput8Create")) r = com_directinput8create(ARG(c,3));
    else if (!strcmp(n,"DirectSoundCreate") || (!strcmp(n,"#1") && !strcmp(e->dll,"DSOUND.dll")))
        r = com_directsoundcreate(ARG(c,1));
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetConsoleCtrlHandler")) r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RtlUnwind"))             r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TerminateProcess")){ g_exit_code=(int)ARG(c,1);
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** guest TerminateProcess(%u) - sonlandiriliyor\n",ARG(c,1));
        if(g_exit_armed) longjmp(g_exit_jmp,1); return -1; }
    else if (fileio_call(c, n, &r)) { /* dosya G/C */ }
    else if (win32_ext_call(c, n, &r)) { /* 2. tur katman */ }
    else { handled = 0; g_win32_unimpl++; stat_[idx].unimpl++;
           if (unimpl_first==0xffffffffu){ unimpl_first=idx; unimpl_name=n; } }

    if (g_bt_on && (!strcmp(n,"GetModuleFileNameA")||!strcmp(n,"ExitProcess")||!strcmp(n,"RaiseException")))
        guest_backtrace(c, 14);
    if (trace_n < trace_max)
        fprintf(stderr, "  [%4u] %-14s %-32s (%d arg) %s-> 0x%08x\n",
                ++trace_n, e->dll, n, e->nargs, handled?"":"[STUB] ", r);
    else trace_n++;

    c->eax = r;
    c->esp += 4u * (uint32_t)e->nargs;      /* stdcall: callee argumanlari temizler */
    return 1;
}

void win32_init(void){
    stat_ = calloc(g_imp_count, sizeof *stat_);
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&ts);
    tick0 = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000 + ts.tv_nsec/1000000;
    mem_commit(HEAP_BASE, 0x10000);
    g_cmdline = galloc(64,1);
    strcpy((char*)(g_mem+g_cmdline), "SPEED2.EXE");
    /* IAT'i sihirli adreslerle doldur */
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_imp_count;i++) MR32(g_imp[i].iat) = IMP_MAGIC + i;
    com_init();
    /* CRT heap modu tanilamasi icin sonradan okunacak adresler */
    fprintf(stderr,"win32: %u import IAT'e baglandi, heap 0x%08x\n", g_imp_count, HEAP_BASE);
}

void win32_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr,"\n=== WIN32 KATMANI ===\n");
    fprintf(stderr,"  toplam import cagrisi : %llu\n",(unsigned long long)g_win32_calls);
    fprintf(stderr,"  implemente edilmemis  : %llu\n",(unsigned long long)g_win32_unimpl);
    fprintf(stderr,"  heap kullanimi        : %u KB   basarisiz ayirma: %llu\n",
            win32_heap_used()/1024u, (unsigned long long)g_alloc_fail);
    /* en cok cagrilan implemente edilmemisler */
    fprintf(stderr,"  guest thread : %llu baslatildi, %llu sonlandi\n",
            (unsigned long long)win32_ext_threads(),(unsigned long long)win32_ext_threads_exited());
    fileio_report();
    { extern void res_report(void); res_report(); }
    { extern void overrides_report(void); overrides_report(); }
    enh_report();
    { extern void d3dx_hle_report(void); d3dx_hle_report(); }
    fprintf(stderr,"  --- IMPLEMENTE EDILMEMIS (cagrildi, stub dondu) ---\n");
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_imp_count;i++)
        if (stat_[i].unimpl)
            fprintf(stderr,"    %-14s %-32s %u kez\n", g_imp[i].dll, g_imp[i].name, stat_[i].unimpl);
    fprintf(stderr,"  --- EN COK CAGRILAN 15 ---\n");
    for (int k=0;k<15;k++){
        uint32_t best=0, bi=0;
        for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_imp_count;i++) if (stat_[i].calls>best){ best=stat_[i].calls; bi=i; }
        if(!best) break;
        fprintf(stderr,"    %-14s %-32s %u\n", g_imp[bi].dll, g_imp[bi].name, best);
        stat_[bi].calls = 0;
    }
    int shown=0;
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_imp_count && shown<15;i++)
        if (stat_[i].calls){
            /* handled olup olmadigini bilmiyoruz; sadece sik cagrilanlari goster */
        }
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_imp_count;i++)
        if (stat_[i].calls>1 && shown<15){ fprintf(stderr,"    %-30s %u kez\n", g_imp[i].name, stat_[i].calls); shown++; }
}
```

`runtime/win32_ext.c`:

```c
/* Win32 katmani - 2. tur: registry, pencere, senkronizasyon, thread */
#include <strings.h>
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/event.h>
#include <sched.h>

void dispatch_indirect(CPU*,uint32_t);
void mem_commit(uint32_t,uint32_t);
uint32_t win32_alloc(uint32_t n, int zero);
uint32_t res_find(uint32_t,uint32_t,int);
uint32_t res_data(uint32_t);
uint32_t res_size(uint32_t);

/* ---- nesne tablosu (HANDLE -> tur/durum) ---- */
#define H_BASE 0x00A00000u
typedef enum { OB_NONE=0, OB_EVENT, OB_MUTEX, OB_THREAD, OB_FILE, OB_KEY, OB_SEM } ObKind;
typedef struct {
    ObKind kind; int signaled; int manual;
    pthread_mutex_t mtx; pthread_cond_t cv;
    uint32_t guest_arg, guest_entry, tid;
    uint32_t owner_tid; int rec;      /* MUTEX: sahiplik + ozyineleme */
    pthread_t th; int started; void *pending;
    char name[64];
} Obj;
#define OBJ_MAX 512
static Obj g_obj[OBJ_MAX];
static int g_obj_n = 1;
static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
typedef struct { uint64_t waits, sets; uint32_t waiter_tid, setter_tid; } WStat;
static WStat g_wstat[64];

/* ---- BUYUK GUEST KILIDI ------------------------------------------------
 * Guest kodu ayni anda tek thread calistirir. Boylece hem lift edilmis kodun
 * paylastigi guest bellek/allocator'lar guvenli olur, hem de komut izi tutarli
 * kalir. Kilit yalnizca bloklayan cagrilarda (Sleep/Wait*) birakilir.      */
static pthread_mutex_t g_guest = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
extern CPU *g_cur_cpu;
static _Thread_local CPU *tl_cpu = 0;
static _Thread_local void *tl_obj = 0;   /* bu thread'in nesnesi */
/* Tum guest thread'lerinin CPU durumu: takilma aninda HEPSININ yigin izini
 * dokebilmek icin (tek thread'inki yaniltici olabiliyor). */
#define MAXCPUS 32
CPU *g_all_cpus[MAXCPUS];
uint32_t g_all_tids[MAXCPUS];
int g_all_n = 0;
static void reg_cpu(CPU *c){
    for (int i=0;i<g_all_n;i++) if (g_all_cpus[i]==c) return;
    if (g_all_n < MAXCPUS){
        g_all_cpus[g_all_n] = c;
        g_all_tids[g_all_n] = c->fs_base ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24) : 0;
        g_all_n++;
    }
}
/* --- buyuk kilidin (GIL) TUTMA SURESI olcumu --------------------------
 * Guest thread'i Win32 cagrisi yapmadigi surece GIL'i birakmaz; uzun bir
 * hesaplama (ornek: ses akisi cozme) diger thread'leri aclikta birakir.
 * Ses her 30 sn'de bir ~50 ms sessizlik yaziyor -- suclunun bu olup
 * olmadigini olcuyoruz.  GILLOG=<ms> esigi asan her tutusu bildirir. */
static uint64_t gil_now_us(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec/1000ull;
}
static _Thread_local uint64_t tl_gil_t0 = 0;
uint64_t g_gil_max_us = 0, g_gil_long = 0;
static int gil_thr_us(void){
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0){ const char *e = getenv("GILLOG"); v = (e && *e) ? atoi(e)*1000 : 0; }
    return v;
}
static void gil_took(void){ tl_gil_t0 = gil_now_us(); }
static void gil_gave(void){
    if (!tl_gil_t0) return;
    uint64_t d = gil_now_us() - tl_gil_t0;
    tl_gil_t0 = 0;
    if (d > g_gil_max_us) g_gil_max_us = d;
    int thr = gil_thr_us();
    if (thr && d > (uint64_t)thr){
        g_gil_long++;
        static int shown = 0;
        if (shown < 80){ shown++;
            double audio_time(void);
            fprintf(stderr, "  [GIL] t=%.3f sn  kilit %.1f ms tutuldu  guest eip=%08x\n",
                    audio_time(), d/1000.0, tl_cpu ? tl_cpu->eip : 0u);
        }
    }
}
void guest_lock(CPU *c){ pthread_mutex_lock(&g_guest); tl_cpu=c; g_cur_cpu=c; reg_cpu(c); gil_took(); }
void guest_unlock(void){ gil_gave(); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_guest); }
static void guest_yield_begin(void){ gil_gave(); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_guest); }
static void guest_yield_end(void){ pthread_mutex_lock(&g_guest); g_cur_cpu = tl_cpu; gil_took(); }
/* Buyuk kilidi birakarak uyu (win32.c: oyunun kare bekleme dongusu). */
uint64_t g_sleep_late_ns, g_sleep_gil_ns, g_sleep_n;    /* tani: uyku gecikmesi / kilit bekleme */
/* nanosleep macOS'ta zamanlayici birlestirme payiyla uyaniyor: oyunda 3 ms
 * istekte ortalama 447 us gec (ayri olcum: medyan ~770 us, QoS fark etmiyor).
 * kevent zamanlayicisi NOTE_CRITICAL ile birlestirilmez: medyan ~45 us. */
static void sleep_precise_ns(long ns){
    static _Thread_local int kq = -1;
    if (kq < 0) kq = kqueue();
    if (kq >= 0){
        struct kevent ev, out;
        EV_SET(&ev, 1, EVFILT_TIMER, EV_ADD | EV_ONESHOT, NOTE_NSECONDS | NOTE_CRITICAL, ns, 0);
        if (kevent(kq, &ev, 1, &out, 1, NULL) == 1) return;
    }
    struct timespec ts = { (time_t)(ns / 1000000000L), ns % 1000000000L };
    nanosleep(&ts, 0);
}
void guest_sleep_ns(long ns){
    struct timespec a, b, d;
    guest_yield_begin();
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &a); sleep_precise_ns(ns); clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &b);
    guest_yield_end();
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &d);
    int64_t sl = (int64_t)(b.tv_sec - a.tv_sec) * 1000000000LL + (b.tv_nsec - a.tv_nsec) - ns;
    int64_t gl = (int64_t)(d.tv_sec - b.tv_sec) * 1000000000LL + (d.tv_nsec - b.tv_nsec);
    g_sleep_late_ns += sl > 0 ? (uint64_t)sl : 0; g_sleep_gil_ns += (uint64_t)gl; g_sleep_n++;
}

/* --- kare hizi sabitleme (60 Hz) ------------------------------------
 * Sanal saat kare basina TAM 16.667 ms ilerliyor, yani oyunun hizi =
 * (gercek fps / 60).  Emulator 117 fps yapinca oyun %195 hizda
 * kosuyordu.  Kareyi 60 Hz'e sabitlemek hizi FPS'ten bagimsiz kilar.
 * Uyku sirasinda buyuk kilit BIRAKILIR, yoksa isci thread'ler durur. */
/* TIMELOG=1: saniyede bir sanal/gercek zaman orani ve kare sayisi.
 * "Oyun ara sahnelerde gereksiz hizlaniyor" sikayetini olcmek icin --
 * oran 1.0'in uzerine cikiyorsa oyun gercekten hizli kosuyor demektir. */
static void timelog_tick(void){
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0){ const char *e = getenv("TIMELOG"); on = (e && *e && *e != '0'); }
    if (!on) return;
    uint64_t host_us(void);
    static uint64_t lr = 0, lv = 0; static long lf = 0;
    long metal_frames(void);
    uint64_t r = gil_now_us(), v = host_us();
    long f = metal_frames();
    if (!lr){ lr = r; lv = v; lf = f; return; }
    if (r - lr < 1000000ull) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "  [zaman] gercek %.2f sn, sanal %.2f sn, oran %.3f, %ld kare (%.1f fps)\n",
            (r-lr)/1e6, (v-lv)/1e6, (double)(v-lv)/(double)(r-lr),
            f-lf, (f-lf)*1e6/(double)(r-lr));
    lr = r; lv = v; lf = f;
}

void frame_pace(void){
    timelog_tick();
    /* VARSAYILAN: FREN YOK.  Yukaridaki 60 Hz gerekcesi ARTIK GECERSIZ --
     * sanal saat VCLOCK=real'e gectiginden oyun hizi gercek fps'ten
     * bagimsiz (olculdu: 63.7 fps'te de 99 fps'te de sanal/gercek =
     * 0.999).  Fren acikken yaris karesinin %61'i nanosleep'ti; kapaninca
     * yaris 63.7 -> 79.4 fps, menuler 120 fps (ekran tazeleme siniri).
     * PACE60=1 eski davranisi geri getirir.  Kacak fps'i vsync zaten
     * kesiyor; sanal saat kare basi artisi 4 ms'de (250 fps) tabanli. */
    static int off = -1;
    if (off < 0){ const char *e = getenv("PACE60");
                  off = !(e && *e && *e != '0'); }
    if (off) return;
    static uint64_t deadline = 0;
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    uint64_t now = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec/1000ull;
    if (!deadline || now > deadline + 200000ull) deadline = now;   /* cok geride: sifirla */
    deadline += 16667ull;
    if (now < deadline){
        uint64_t d = deadline - now;
        struct timespec sl = { (time_t)(d/1000000ull), (long)((d%1000000ull)*1000ull) };
        guest_yield_begin();
        nanosleep(&sl, 0);
        guest_yield_end();
    }
}

/* Adil GIL: guest kodu bloklamayan Win32 cagrilarinda da donebilir
 * (ornek: EnterCriticalSection ile donen bekleme dongusu). Periyodik
 * olarak kilidi birakip diger guest thread'lerine sira veriyoruz.     */
/* ---- GERCEK kritik bolumler ------------------------------------------
 * Onceden EnterCriticalSection/LeaveCriticalSection etkisiz stub'di.  Tek
 * buyuk kilit (GIL) cogu zaman ortuyordu AMA guest_fair_yield her 1024
 * Win32 cagrisinda GIL'i birakiyor: bir thread kritik bolumun ICINDEYKEN
 * kilidi kaybedebiliyor ve baska bir thread ayni bolume girebiliyordu.
 * Oyunun yukleyici/ses/video kuyruklari boyle sessizce bozulur.
 *
 * Kilidi beklerken GIL BIRAKILMALI, yoksa kilitlenme olur.              */
#define MAXCS 512
static struct { uint32_t key; pthread_mutex_t m; int used; } g_cs[MAXCS];
static pthread_mutex_t g_cs_tab = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static _Thread_local int tl_cs_depth = 0;
uint64_t g_cs_enter = 0, g_cs_contended = 0;

static int cs_disabled(void){
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NOCS"); v = (e && *e && *e != '0') ? 1 : 0; }
    return v;
}
static pthread_mutex_t *cs_for(uint32_t key){
    if (cs_disabled()) return 0;          /* eski davranis: etkisiz stub */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_cs_tab);
    unsigned h = (key >> 2) % MAXCS;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < MAXCS; i++){
        unsigned j = (h + i) % MAXCS;
        if (g_cs[j].used && g_cs[j].key == key){
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cs_tab); return &g_cs[j].m;
        }
        if (!g_cs[j].used){
            pthread_mutexattr_t a;
            pthread_mutexattr_init(&a);
            pthread_mutexattr_settype(&a, PTHREAD_MUTEX_RECURSIVE);
            pthread_mutex_init(&g_cs[j].m, &a);
            pthread_mutexattr_destroy(&a);
            g_cs[j].key = key; g_cs[j].used = 1;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cs_tab); return &g_cs[j].m;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cs_tab);
    return 0;                      /* tablo doldu: eski davranisa don */
}

uint32_t call_guest(CPU *c, uint32_t fn, int nargs, const uint32_t *args);
static uint32_t g_wndproc = 0;
static uint32_t g_hwnd    = 0x00B00001u;
#define WMQ 8
static struct { uint32_t msg, wp, lp; } g_wmq[WMQ];
static int g_wmq_head = 0, g_wmq_tail = 0;
static int g_wm_activated = 0;
uint64_t g_wm_sent = 0, g_wm_dispatched = 0;

static void wm_push(uint32_t m, uint32_t wp, uint32_t lp){
    int nx = (g_wmq_tail + 1) % WMQ;
    if (nx == g_wmq_head) return;
    g_wmq[g_wmq_tail].msg = m; g_wmq[g_wmq_tail].wp = wp; g_wmq[g_wmq_tail].lp = lp;
    g_wmq_tail = nx;
}
static int wm_pop(uint32_t *m, uint32_t *wp, uint32_t *lp){
    if (g_wmq_head == g_wmq_tail) return 0;
    *m = g_wmq[g_wmq_head].msg; *wp = g_wmq[g_wmq_head].wp; *lp = g_wmq[g_wmq_head].lp;
    g_wmq_head = (g_wmq_head + 1) % WMQ;
    return 1;
}

static uint32_t cur_tid(CPU *c){
    return (c && c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x24u))
           ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24u) : 0u;
}

void guest_fair_yield(void){
    if (tl_cs_depth) return;          /* kritik bolum icinde sira verme */
    static _Thread_local uint32_t n = 0;
    if ((++n & 0x3FFu) != 0) return;          /* her 1024 cagrida bir */
    guest_yield_begin();
    sched_yield();
    /* DIKKAT: burada her seferinde nanosleep(50us) vardi.  macOS'ta 50 us
     * istenen bir uyku gercekte ~1-2 ms surer (zamanlayici kuantumu +
     * timer coalescing).  Yarisdan onceki ara sahnede guest bir Win32
     * fonksiyonunu kare basina ~110 bin kez cagiriyor; bu da kare basina
     * ~110 uyku = ~165 ms demekti.  Olculdu: guest is parcaciginin %70'i
     * __semwait_signal icinde, yani hesap degil UYKU.  Kare suresi 235 ms
     * (4.6 fps).  sched_yield adilligi zaten sagliyor; uykuyu seyreltiyoruz
     * (yalnizca diger is parcaciklarinin ilerlemesini garantilemek icin). */
    if ((n & 0x7FFFu) == 0){
        struct timespec ts = {0, 50000L}; nanosleep(&ts, 0);
    }
    guest_yield_end();
}

static uint32_t obj_new(ObKind k){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    int i = g_obj_n < OBJ_MAX ? g_obj_n++ : 0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    if (!i) return 0;
    Obj *o=&g_obj[i]; memset(o,0,sizeof *o); o->kind=k;
    pthread_mutex_init(&o->mtx,0); pthread_cond_init(&o->cv,0);
    return H_BASE + (uint32_t)i;
}
/* fileio.c'nin overlapped tamamlanma olayini sinyallemesi icin. */
void win32_signal_event(uint32_t h);

static Obj *obj_get(uint32_t h){
    if (h < H_BASE || h >= H_BASE+OBJ_MAX) return 0;
    uint32_t i = h - H_BASE;
    return g_obj[i].kind ? &g_obj[i] : 0;
}

/* ---- guest thread ---- */
#define GTHREAD_STACK 0x00100000u          /* 1 MB */
static uint32_t g_tstack_next = 0x60000000u;
uint64_t g_threads_started = 0, g_threads_exited = 0;

typedef struct { uint32_t entry, arg, teb; Obj *ob; } TArg;

void mem_altstack_install(void);
/* Konuk thread'leri BUYUK yigin ister: lift edilmis kodda her konuk cagrisi
 * bir host C cagrisi, ve lifted cerceveler genis.  Ana konuk thread'e
 * (tests/boot.c) 1 GB veriliyordu ama oyunun CreateThread ile actigi isci
 * thread'leri `pthread_create(...,0,...)` ile macOS varsayilani 512 KB
 * aliyordu -> derin ozyinelemede HOST YIGIN TASMASI (SIGSEGV, guest alani
 * disinda bir adres).  Rezervasyon sanal adres alani; ancak kullanildikca
 * commit edilir. */
static int guest_pthread_create(pthread_t *th, void *(*fn)(void*), void *arg){
    pthread_attr_t at;
    if (pthread_attr_init(&at) != 0) return pthread_create(th, 0, fn, arg);
    pthread_attr_setstacksize(&at, 256ull*1024ull*1024ull);
    int rc = pthread_create(th, &at, fn, arg);
    pthread_attr_destroy(&at);
    if (rc != 0) rc = pthread_create(th, 0, fn, arg);   /* son care */
    return rc;
}

static void *guest_thread_main(void *p){
    mem_altstack_install();
    TArg *t = (TArg*)p;
    CPU cpu; memset(&cpu,0,sizeof cpu);
    uint32_t stack_lo, stack_hi;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    stack_lo = g_tstack_next; g_tstack_next += GTHREAD_STACK; stack_hi = g_tstack_next;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    mem_commit(stack_lo, GTHREAD_STACK);
    cpu.esp = stack_hi - 0x1000u;
    cpu.top = 0; cpu.fcw = 0x037f;
    cpu.fs_base = t->teb; cpu.gs_base = t->teb;
    /* TEB */
    MR32(t->teb+0x00)=0xFFFFFFFFu; MR32(t->teb+0x04)=stack_hi; MR32(t->teb+0x08)=stack_lo;
    MR32(t->teb+0x18)=t->teb; MR32(t->teb+0x24)=t->ob?t->ob->tid:0;
    MR32(t->teb+0x2C)=t->teb+0x1000u; MR32(t->teb+0x30)=0x00C10000u;
    /* stdcall: arg, sonra donus adresi */
    { CPU *c=&cpu; PUSH32(t->arg); PUSH32(0xDEAD7EADu); }
    __sync_fetch_and_add(&g_threads_started, 1);
    { static int sh=0; if (getenv("VERBOSE") && sh<40){ sh++;
        fprintf(stderr,"      [thread] BASLADI entry=0x%08x arg=0x%08x teb=0x%08x tid=%u\n",
                t->entry, t->arg, t->teb, t->ob?t->ob->tid:0); } }
    tl_obj = t->ob;
    /* tani: thread listelerinde (perflog thread.csv, sample) taninsin */
    { char nm[32]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "konuk %u @%06x", t->ob ? t->ob->tid : 0u, t->entry & 0xFFFFFFu);
      pthread_setname_np(nm); }
    guest_lock(&cpu);
    dispatch_indirect(&cpu, t->entry);
    guest_unlock();
    if (t->ob){ pthread_mutex_lock(&t->ob->mtx); t->ob->signaled=1;
                pthread_cond_broadcast(&t->ob->cv); pthread_mutex_unlock(&t->ob->mtx); }
    free(t);
    return 0;
}

void win32_signal_event(uint32_t h){
    Obj *o = obj_get(h);
    if (!o || o->kind != OB_EVENT) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&o->mtx);
    o->signaled = 1;
    pthread_cond_broadcast(&o->cv);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&o->mtx);
}

/* ---- WINMM coklu ortam zamanlayicisi -----------------------------------
 * NFSU2 on yuzunun guncelleme dongusunu timeSetEvent geri cagirmasindan
 * suruyor; stub birakilirsa menu animasyonlari ilerlemez ve girdi
 * islenmez.  Oyun tek-seferlik zamanlayiciyi geri cagirma icinde yeniden
 * kuruyor, bu yuzden zamanlayici basina thread acmak olmaz: TEK bir
 * zamanlayici thread'i tum kayitlari sirayla isler.                     */
#define MAXTIMER 32
typedef struct {
    uint32_t proc, user, id;
    uint64_t due_us;          /* 0 = bos */
    uint32_t period_us;       /* 0 = tek seferlik */
} Timer;

static Timer    g_tm[MAXTIMER];
static uint32_t g_timer_next_id = 1;
static int      g_timer_running = 0;
uint64_t        g_timer_ticks = 0;

/* Zamanlayicilar da OYUN zamanini kullanmali; yoksa emulator yavas
 * oldugunda geri cagirmalar oyunun kendi zamanina gore cok sik calisir. */
uint64_t host_us(void);
static uint64_t now_us(void){ return host_us(); }

static void *timer_thread_main(void *p){
    (void)p;
    mem_altstack_install();
    CPU cpu; memset(&cpu,0,sizeof cpu);
    uint32_t stack_lo, stack_hi, teb;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    stack_lo = g_tstack_next; g_tstack_next += GTHREAD_STACK; stack_hi = g_tstack_next;
    teb = 0x00C60000u;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    mem_commit(stack_lo, GTHREAD_STACK);
    mem_commit(teb, 0x2000);
    cpu.top = 0; cpu.fcw = 0x037f;
    cpu.fs_base = teb; cpu.gs_base = teb;
    MR32(teb+0x00)=0xFFFFFFFFu; MR32(teb+0x04)=stack_hi; MR32(teb+0x08)=stack_lo;
    MR32(teb+0x18)=teb; MR32(teb+0x24)=999u;
    MR32(teb+0x2C)=teb+0x1000u; MR32(teb+0x30)=0x00C10000u;

    for (;;){
        struct timespec ts = {0, 1000000L};      /* 1 ms */
        nanosleep(&ts, 0);
        uint64_t now = now_us();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXTIMER; i++){
            uint32_t proc, user, id;
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
            if (!g_tm[i].due_us || g_tm[i].due_us > now){ pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); continue; }
            proc = g_tm[i].proc; user = g_tm[i].user; id = g_tm[i].id;
            if (g_tm[i].period_us) g_tm[i].due_us = now + g_tm[i].period_us;
            else                   g_tm[i].due_us = 0;      /* tek seferlik biter */
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);

            cpu.esp = stack_hi - 0x1000u;
            { CPU *c=&cpu;
              /* stdcall: dw2, dw1, dwUser, uMsg, uTimerID  (sagdan sola) */
              PUSH32(0u); PUSH32(0u); PUSH32(user); PUSH32(0u); PUSH32(id);
              PUSH32(0xDEAD7EADu); }
            guest_lock(&cpu);
            dispatch_indirect(&cpu, proc);
            guest_unlock();
            g_timer_ticks++;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- registry: bellek ici, "bulunamadi" varsayilani ---- */
/* Oyun degeri bulamazsa kendi varsayilanini kullanir - istedigimiz bu. */
#define ERROR_SUCCESS         0u
#define ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND  2u

/* ---- disari acilan API ---- */
static uint32_t A(CPU *c, int i){ return MR32(c->esp + 4u*(uint32_t)i); }

/* --- basit kalici kayit defteri ---------------------------------------
 * Oyunun yazdigi ayarlar (grafik detayi, cozunurluk, ses) eskiden
 * atiliyordu.  Burada tutulup ~/.nfsu2_registry dosyasina yaziliyor. */
#define MAXREG 128
static struct { char name[64]; int is_str; uint32_t dw; char sv[128]; } g_reg[MAXREG];
static int g_regn = 0;
static int g_reg_loaded = 0;

static const char *reg_path(void){
    static char pth[512];
    const char *h = getenv("HOME");
    snprintf(pth, sizeof pth, "%s/.nfsu2_registry", h ? h : ".");
    return pth;
}
static void reg_load(void){
    if (g_reg_loaded) return;
    g_reg_loaded = 1;
    FILE *f = fopen(reg_path(), "r");
    if (!f) return;
    char line[256];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f) && g_regn < MAXREG){
        char nm[64], val[128]; int isstr = 0; unsigned dw = 0;
        if (sscanf(line, "d %63[^=]=%u", nm, &dw) == 2){
            snprintf(g_reg[g_regn].name, 64, "%s", nm);
            g_reg[g_regn].is_str = 0; g_reg[g_regn].dw = dw; g_regn++;
        } else if (sscanf(line, "s %63[^=]=%127[^\n]", nm, val) == 2){
            snprintf(g_reg[g_regn].name, 64, "%s", nm);
            snprintf(g_reg[g_regn].sv, 128, "%s", val);
            g_reg[g_regn].is_str = 1; g_regn++;
        }
        (void)isstr;
    }
    fclose(f);
}
static void reg_save(void){
    FILE *f = fopen(reg_path(), "w");
    if (!f) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_regn; i++){
        if (g_reg[i].is_str) fprintf(f, "s %s=%s\n", g_reg[i].name, g_reg[i].sv);
        else                 fprintf(f, "d %s=%u\n", g_reg[i].name, g_reg[i].dw);
    }
    fclose(f);
}
static int reg_find(const char *nm){
    reg_load();
    for (int i = 0; i < g_regn; i++)
        if (!strcasecmp(g_reg[i].name, nm)) return i;
    return -1;
}
static void reg_put_dword(const char *nm, uint32_t v){
    int i = reg_find(nm);
    if (i < 0){ if (g_regn >= MAXREG) return; i = g_regn++;
                snprintf(g_reg[i].name, 64, "%s", nm); }
    g_reg[i].is_str = 0; g_reg[i].dw = v; reg_save();
}
static void reg_put_string(const char *nm, const char *v){
    int i = reg_find(nm);
    if (i < 0){ if (g_regn >= MAXREG) return; i = g_regn++;
                snprintf(g_reg[i].name, 64, "%s", nm); }
    g_reg[i].is_str = 1; snprintf(g_reg[i].sv, 128, "%s", v); reg_save();
}

int win32_ext_call(CPU *c, const char *n, uint32_t *out){
    uint32_t r = 0;
    /* --- Registry --- */
    if (!strcmp(n,"RegOpenKeyA")){ uint32_t p=A(c,2); if(p) MR32(p)=obj_new(OB_KEY); r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegOpenKeyExA")){
        if (getenv("REGLOG")){ uint32_t sp=A(c,1);
            fprintf(stderr,"  [kayit] OpenKeyEx(\"%s\")\n",
                    (sp && mem_is_committed(sp)) ? (const char*)(g_mem+sp) : "(null)"); }
        uint32_t p=A(c,4); if(p) MR32(p)=obj_new(OB_KEY); r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegCreateKeyA")){ uint32_t p=A(c,2); if(p) MR32(p)=obj_new(OB_KEY); r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegCreateKeyExA")){ uint32_t p=A(c,7); if(p) MR32(p)=obj_new(OB_KEY); r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegQueryValueExA")){
        /* Bos bir kayit defteri oyunu HER ACILISTA "ilk kurulum" yoluna
         * sokuyor (NotFirstTime bulunamiyor) ve kurulum bilgisi olmadan
         * on yuz akisi ilerlemiyor.  Makul bir kurulmus-oyun profili
         * donduruyoruz. */
        uint32_t nameptr=A(c,1), ptype=A(c,3), pdata=A(c,4), pcb=A(c,5);
        const char *vn = (nameptr && mem_is_committed(nameptr))
                         ? (const char*)(g_mem+nameptr) : "";
        if (getenv("REGLOG"))
            fprintf(stderr,"  [kayit] QueryValue(\"%s\")\n", vn);

        const char *sval = 0; uint32_t dval = 0; int have_d = 0;
        { int ri = reg_find(vn);            /* once KAYITLI degere bak */
          if (ri >= 0){
              if (g_reg[ri].is_str) sval = g_reg[ri].sv;
              else { dval = g_reg[ri].dw; have_d = 1; }
          } }
        if (sval || have_d) { /* kayitli deger kullanilacak */ }
        else if (!strcasecmp(vn,"NotFirstTime")){ dval=1; have_d=1; }
        else if (!strcasecmp(vn,"Language"))      sval="English";
        else if (!strcasecmp(vn,"Install Dir"))   sval="C:\\NFSU2";
        else if (!strcasecmp(vn,"CD Drive"))      sval="C:\\NFSU2";
        else if (!strcasecmp(vn,"StreamingInstall")){ dval=0; have_d=1; }
        else if (!strcasecmp(vn,"VERSION"))       sval="1.2.0.0";
        else if (!strcasecmp(vn,"SIZE")){ dval=0; have_d=1; }

        if (sval){
            uint32_t need = (uint32_t)strlen(sval) + 1u;
            if (ptype){ mem_commit(ptype,4); MR32(ptype)=1u; }      /* REG_SZ */
            if (!pdata){ if(pcb){ mem_commit(pcb,4); MR32(pcb)=need; } r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
            else {
                uint32_t cap = pcb ? MR32(pcb) : need;
                if (cap < need){ if(pcb) MR32(pcb)=need; r=234u; } /* ERROR_MORE_DATA */
                else { mem_commit(pdata,need); memcpy(g_mem+pdata, sval, need);
                       if(pcb) MR32(pcb)=need; r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
            }
        } else if (have_d){
            if (ptype){ mem_commit(ptype,4); MR32(ptype)=4u; }      /* REG_DWORD */
            if (!pdata){ if(pcb){ mem_commit(pcb,4); MR32(pcb)=4u; } r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
            else {
                uint32_t cap = pcb ? MR32(pcb) : 4u;
                if (cap < 4u){ if(pcb) MR32(pcb)=4u; r=234u; }
                else { mem_commit(pdata,4); MR32(pdata)=dval;
                       if(pcb) MR32(pcb)=4u; r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
            }
        } else {
            if(pcb){ mem_commit(pcb,4); MR32(pcb)=0; }
            r=ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND;
        }
    }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegQueryValueA")){ r=ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegSetValueExA")||!strcmp(n,"RegSetValueA")){
        /* Eskiden yazilanlar SESSIZCE ATILIYORDU: oyunun kaydettigi
         * grafik/ses ayarlari her acilista sifirlaniyordu.  Artik
         * saklaniyor ve diske yaziliyor. */
        uint32_t nameptr=A(c,1), type=A(c,3), pdata=A(c,4), cb=A(c,5);
        const char *vn = (nameptr && mem_is_committed(nameptr))
                         ? (const char*)(g_mem+nameptr) : "";
        if (*vn){
            if (type == 4u && pdata && mem_is_committed(pdata+3))
                reg_put_dword(vn, MR32(pdata));
            else if (type == 1u && pdata && mem_is_committed(pdata))
                reg_put_string(vn, (const char*)(g_mem+pdata));
            if (getenv("REGLOG"))
                fprintf(stderr,"  [kayit] SetValue(\"%s\") tur=%u boyut=%u\n", vn, type, cb);
        }
        r=ERROR_SUCCESS; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegCloseKey")) r=ERROR_SUCCESS;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegDeleteKeyA")||!strcmp(n,"RegDeleteValueA")) r=ERROR_SUCCESS;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegEnumKeyExA")||!strcmp(n,"RegEnumValueA")) r=259u; /* ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS */
    /* --- pencere / USER32 --- */
    /* Pencere mesaj yolu.  DirectInput cihazlari yalnizca uygulama ODAK
     * aldiginda Acquire ediliyor; oyun bunu WM_ACTIVATEAPP/WM_SETFOCUS
     * mesajlarindan anliyor.  PeekMessage hep 0 dondugu ve DispatchMessage
     * pencere yordamini hic cagirmadigi icin oyun hicbir zaman "aktifim"
     * demiyordu -> klavye hic Acquire edilmiyordu.                      */

    else if (!strcmp(n,"RegisterClassExA")||!strcmp(n,"RegisterClassA")){
        /* WNDCLASSEXA: +8 lpfnWndProc | WNDCLASSA: +4 lpfnWndProc */
        uint32_t wc=A(c,0);
        if (wc && mem_is_committed(wc+11)){
            uint32_t off = !strcmp(n,"RegisterClassExA") ? 8u : 4u;
            uint32_t wp = MR32(wc+off);
            if (wp) { g_wndproc = wp;
                fprintf(stderr,"  [pencere] sinif kaydi, yordam=0x%08x\n", wp); }
        }
        r=0xC001u; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"UnregisterClassA")) r=1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"CreateWindowExA")){
        r = g_hwnd;
        if (!g_wm_activated){ g_wm_activated = 1;
            wm_push(0x0018u, 1u, 0u);   /* WM_SHOWWINDOW  */
            wm_push(0x001Cu, 1u, 0u);   /* WM_ACTIVATEAPP  aktif */
            wm_push(0x0006u, 1u, 0u);   /* WM_ACTIVATE     WA_ACTIVE */
            wm_push(0x0007u, 0u, 0u);   /* WM_SETFOCUS     */
            wm_push(0x000Fu, 0u, 0u);   /* WM_PAINT        */
        } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"DestroyWindow")) r=1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetDesktopWindow")) r=0x00B00000u;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetActiveWindow")||!strcmp(n,"GetForegroundWindow")) r=0x00B00001u;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"LoadIconA")||!strcmp(n,"LoadCursorA")) r=0x00B10001u;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetCursor")) r=0x00B10001u;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"ShowCursor")){ static int cnt=0; r=(uint32_t)(A(c,0)?++cnt:--cnt); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCursorPos")){ uint32_t p=A(c,0);
        if(p){ int mx=0,my=0; void metal_get_cursor(int*,int*); metal_get_cursor(&mx,&my);
               mem_commit(p,8); MR32(p)=(uint32_t)mx; MR32(p+4)=(uint32_t)my; } r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetCursorPos")) r=1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetSystemMetrics")){
        unsigned gw = 1280, gh = 720; void metal_game_size(unsigned*,unsigned*); metal_game_size(&gw,&gh);
        switch(A(c,0)){ case 0: r=gw; break; case 1: r=gh; break;
                        case 4: r=19; break; case 5: r=1; break; case 6: r=1; break;
                        case 32: r=4; case 33: r=4; break; default: r=0; } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"AdjustWindowRect")){ r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetClientRect")||!strcmp(n,"GetWindowRect")){
        /* Oyunun gercek cozunurlugu: imlec eslemesi buna gore (bkz.
         * metal_game_size). */
        unsigned gw = 1280, gh = 720; void metal_game_size(unsigned*,unsigned*); metal_game_size(&gw,&gh);
        uint32_t p=A(c,1); if(p){mem_commit(p,16);MR32(p)=0;MR32(p+4)=0;MR32(p+8)=gw;MR32(p+12)=gh;} r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"ShowWindow")||!strcmp(n,"UpdateWindow")||!strcmp(n,"SetFocus")
           ||!strcmp(n,"SetForegroundWindow")||!strcmp(n,"SetWindowPos")
           ||!strcmp(n,"InvalidateRect")||!strcmp(n,"SetWindowTextA")) r=1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetWindowLongA")||!strcmp(n,"GetWindowLongA")) r=0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"PeekMessageA")||!strcmp(n,"GetMessageA")){
        /* MSG: +0 hwnd +4 message +8 wParam +12 lParam +16 time +20 pt */
        uint32_t pm=A(c,0), m=0, wp=0, lp=0;
        int remove = !strcmp(n,"GetMessageA") ? 1 : (A(c,4) & 1u);
        if (g_wmq_head != g_wmq_tail){
            if (remove) wm_pop(&m,&wp,&lp);
            else { m=g_wmq[g_wmq_head].msg; wp=g_wmq[g_wmq_head].wp; lp=g_wmq[g_wmq_head].lp; }
            if (pm){ mem_commit(pm,28);
                MR32(pm)=g_hwnd; MR32(pm+4)=m; MR32(pm+8)=wp; MR32(pm+12)=lp;
                MR32(pm+16)=0; MR32(pm+20)=0; MR32(pm+24)=0; }
            g_wm_sent++;
            r=1;
        } else {
            if (pm){ mem_commit(pm,28); memset(g_mem+pm,0,28); MR32(pm)=g_hwnd; }
            r = !strcmp(n,"GetMessageA") ? 1u : 0u;   /* GetMessage 0 = WM_QUIT */
        }

                    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME,&ts);
                    uint32_t wait = (ms==0xFFFFFFFFu)? 2000u : (ms>2000u?2000u:ms);
                    ts.tv_sec += wait/1000; ts.tv_nsec += (long)(wait%1000)*1000000L;

                else r = 0x102u;                        /* WAIT_TIMEOUT */
            }
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&o->mtx);
            guest_yield_end();
        }

                pthread_cond_timedwait(&o->cv,&o->mtx,&ts);

            }

        }
        r=1; }

    else if (!strcmp(n,"ExitThread")){

    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetProcessAffinityMask")){

     * Etkisiz stub birakilirsa GIL'in adil paylasimi (her 1024 Win32

    else if (!strcmp(n,"InitializeCriticalSection")||

                pthread_mutex_lock(m);
                guest_yield_end();
            }

        }
        r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TryEnterCriticalSection")){
        pthread_mutex_t *m = cs_for(A(c,0));

        if (m){ if (pthread_mutex_trylock(m)==0) tl_cs_depth++; else r=0; } }

        pthread_mutex_t *m = cs_for(A(c,0));
        if (m && tl_cs_depth > 0){ tl_cs_depth--; pthread_mutex_unlock(m); }
        r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"DeleteCriticalSection")) r=1;
    else return 0;                       /* bu katman ilgilenmiyor */
    *out = r;
    return 1;
}
uint64_t win32_ext_threads(void){ return g_threads_started; }
uint64_t win32_ext_threads_exited(void){ return g_threads_exited; }
```

```html
<div class="wrap">
<header class="top">
  <p class="eyebrow">Bitirme projesi · Çalışma kaydı</p>
  <h1>Need for Speed: Underground 2'yi Apple Silicon'da yerel çalıştırmak</h1>
  <p class="lede">2004 tarihli, 32-bit Windows oyununun makine kodunu kaynak kod olmadan C'ye çevirip macOS için ARM64 olarak yeniden derleyen bir statik rekompilasyon projesi. Arada Wine, sanal makine ya da emülatör yok. Bu sayfa, projenin hangi noktadan başladığını, tarih sırasıyla neler yapıldığını, nelerin fark edildiğini ve kararların neye dayandığını anlatıyor.</p>
  <div class="meta">
    <span>Dönem <b>24 Ağustos – 27 Eylül 2026</b></span>
    <span>Donanım <b>MacBook Pro 14", Apple M1 Pro</b></span>
    <span>Hedef ikili <b>SPEED2.EXE · PE32 · Intel 80386</b></span>
  </div>
  <div class="stats">
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">23.278</div><div class="l">x86 fonksiyonu otomatik olarak C'ye çevrilip ARM64'e derlendi</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">~3 milyon</div><div class="l">satır üretilmiş C kodu; elle yazılan katman 13.166 satır, araçlar 4.121 satır</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">13.000+</div><div class="l">rastgele komut vakası gerçek x86 işlemciye karşı birebir doğrulandı (sıfır fark)</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">43 → 119</div><div class="l">yarışta kare hızı (fps). 120, ekranın yenileme sınırı</div></div>
  </div>
</header>
```
